fah-227.culturalNotes: Make sure the water is warm, not too hot, as it may kill the yeast. You can store the bread in a tightly sealed plastic bag for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and dried milk in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the warm water and mix the ingredients well until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise until it doubles in size.
instructions.5: Lightly dust the work surface with flour and roll out the dough to a thickness of less than half a centimeter.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into circles using a cup mold.
instructions.7: Lightly grease the baking tray and place the cut circles on it.
instructions.8: Bake the bread in a preheated oven at high heat until golden brown.

fah-228.title: Quick Fahita
fah-228.culturalNotes: Fahita can be stored in an airtight container. It can be served with breakfast or dinner alongside cheese and tea or any other dish.

instructions.1: Mix the dry ingredients (flour, sugar, salt, saffron, turmeric, cardamom) in a bowl.
instructions.2: Activate the yeast: Mix the yeast with a quarter cup of warm water and a small amount of sugar, then let it sit for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the activated yeast, vinegar, and oil to the dry ingredients.
instructions.4: Gradually add the warm milk and knead the dough until soft and not sticky.
instructions.5: Let the dough rise for 1-1.5 hours until it doubles in size.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into 3 parts and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each piece into a flat sheet about half a centimeter thick, then roll them up like a log.
instructions.8: Place the rolls in a greased baking pan or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.9: Brush the fahita with beaten egg mixed with a pinch of sugar.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 10-15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let the fahita cool before slicing into 1-2 centimeter thick pieces.
instructions.12: Bake the slices in a preheated oven at 150 degrees Celsius until crisp.

fah-229.title: Eggplant with Béchamel
fah-229.culturalNotes: This eggplant with béchamel can be served with flatbread or rice. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for 2–3 days.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and slice them into thin rounds.
instructions.2: Sprinkle salt over the potatoes, toss, then fry in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.3: Peel the eggplant and cut it into large long strips. Sprinkle with salt and let sit in a colander for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Rinse the eggplant under water, rub with flour, then fry in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.5: Fry the bell peppers in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.6: In a large pan, sauté the onion, garlic, and spices, then add the ground meat and stir until browned.
instructions.7: Add the tomato juice and hot water, then let the mixture boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: In another bowl, mix the butter and flour, then gradually add the milk while stirring continuously until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.9: Add salt, instant stock, and black pepper, then stir well until the béchamel boils.
instructions.10: In a baking dish, layer a layer of eggplant, bell pepper, and potato slices, then add the meat mixture.
instructions.11: Add a second layer of eggplant, bell pepper, and potato slices, then pour the béchamel over the top.
instructions.12: Place the dish in a preheated oven at 220°C (428°F) for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

fah-230.title: Macaroni with Béchamel and Kofta
fah-230.culturalNotes: You can sprinkle some chopped parsley on top of the dish before serving for a more appealing look. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the ground beef with the Knorr kofta mix and half a cup of water, and knead thoroughly.
instructions.2: Shape the kofta into small balls and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.3: In a pan, heat 2 tablespoons of butter and 1 tablespoon of oil, then fry the kofta until browned on all sides.
instructions.4: In another bowl, combine 1 liter of milk and 1 packet of Knorr béchamel mix, and stir over low heat until it boils and thickens.
instructions.5: Add half a cup of cream to the béchamel for a richer flavor.
instructions.6: Cook the macaroni until it is half done.
instructions.7: Place two spoonfuls of béchamel at the bottom of the baking dish, then add the macaroni and mix well.
instructions.8: Layer the macaroni in the dish, then place the fried kofta on top.
instructions.9: Pour the remaining béchamel over the kofta.
instructions.10: Bake in the oven at 200 degrees Celsius until golden brown.
instructions.11: Remove from the oven, sprinkle mozzarella and cheddar cheese on top, then return to the oven until the cheese melts and turns golden.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-231.title: Spiced Pasta
fah-231.culturalNotes: You can sprinkle some chopped parsley on top before serving for garnish. You can also use different types of pasta according to preference.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the tomatoes and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.3: Add 1 cup of water and let it boil.
instructions.4: Add the uncooked pasta and stir well.
instructions.5: Cover the saucepan and let it simmer for 10 minutes until the pasta is firm.
instructions.6: Add the spices (salt, black pepper, cumin, dried parsley) and stir thoroughly.
instructions.7: Cover the saucepan again and let it cook for another 10 minutes until the pasta is fully cooked.
instructions.8: Remove the lid and stir the pasta well to prevent sticking.
instructions.9: Serve the pasta hot with grilled chicken.

fah-232.title: Spaghetti with Red Sauce
fah-232.culturalNotes: You can add pieces of cooked chicken or meat to the sauce for extra flavor. The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Slice the onion into thin rings.
instructions.2: Heat the oil and ghee in a saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.3: Add the onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.4: Add the sugar and cook until it turns golden.
instructions.5: Add the chopped tomatoes or tomato juice along with the tomato paste.
instructions.6: Stir in the salt, black pepper, cumin, chili powder, and cilantro. Mix well.
instructions.7: Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water until tender.
instructions.8: Add the cooked spaghetti to the sauce and toss thoroughly.
instructions.9: Serve hot, topped with the sauce.

fah-233.title: Kofta with Pasta
fah-233.culturalNotes: You can add more pasta cooking water if the sauce is too thick. You can also shape the kofta in advance and store them in the refrigerator for later use.

instructions.1: Mix ground beef with finely chopped onion, crushed breadcrumbs, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.2: Shape the kofta into small balls.
instructions.3: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the kofta and fry until browned on all sides.
instructions.4: Add finely chopped onion and sliced chili to the pan and stir for one minute.
instructions.5: Add strained fresh tomato juice and tomato sauce, then mix all ingredients together.
instructions.6: Add salt, black pepper, cumin, and parsley, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add a pinch of sugar and stir.
instructions.8: Add boiling water and salt, then add pasta and stir.
instructions.9: Let the pasta boil for 10 minutes until cooked.
instructions.10: Add the kofta to the sauce and stir for two minutes until well combined.
instructions.11: Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of parsley.

fah-234.title: Winter Vegetable and Noodle Soup
fah-234.culturalNotes: Serve the soup with toasted bread slices for a warmer and more satisfying meal.

instructions.1: Melt the butter or oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion and garlic, and sauté until golden.
instructions.3: Add the diced carrots, ground cumin, laurel leaves, and green beans.
instructions.4: Cover and simmer on low heat until vegetables soften.
instructions.5: Add the cubed zucchini, boiling water, and vegetable bouillon cube. Stir well.
instructions.6: Continue cooking until the soup is well blended and the vegetables are tender.
instructions.7: In a separate pot, brown the noodles in a tablespoon of butter or oil.
instructions.8: Add the noodles to the soup pot and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
instructions.9: Stir in the chopped celery, cover, and let it simmer for 10 minutes on low heat.
instructions.10: Serve hot, garnished with fresh lemon juice.

fah-235.title: Chicken Soup with Mushrooms and Cream
fah-235.culturalNotes: Canned mushrooms can be used instead of fresh mushrooms. You can also use instant broth instead of water for a stronger flavor. The soup can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the chicken pieces and sauté with the onion until they begin to cook through.
instructions.4: Add the pepper, sugar, salt, and ground cinnamon, and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the mushrooms and sauté with the chicken and onion for 1 minute.
instructions.6: Add the flour and stir the mixture thoroughly.
instructions.7: Pour in 1 liter of water and let it boil for 2 minutes.
instructions.8: Add the cream and let it boil for 1 minute, then turn off the heat.
instructions.9: Strain the cream if you wish to use a substitute for cream

fah-236.title: Chicken and Carrot Barley Soup
fah-236.culturalNotes: You can serve the soup with toasted bread or sweet biscuits for a complete meal. The soup can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes.
instructions.2: Rinse the barley and soak it for half an hour, then drain.
instructions.3: Chop the carrots and cut the celery and onion into small pieces.
instructions.4: Heat the butter and oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.5: Add two cloves of garlic and sauté the chicken until browned.
instructions.6: Add a pinch of sugar and stir the chicken well.
instructions.7: Add the onion and stir for one minute.
instructions.8: Add the celery and carrots and stir for one minute.
instructions.9: Add salt, pepper, ground cinnamon, and barley.
instructions.10: Pour in hot water or instant stock.
instructions.11: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-237.title: Mushroom and Cream Soup
fah-237.culturalNotes: You can add a broth cube to the soup for a stronger flavor. Serve the soup with lemon juice for a distinctive taste.

instructions.1: Cut the mushrooms into small cubes.
instructions.2: Open the can of mushrooms and drain them.
instructions.3: Heat the butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the chopped mushrooms and sauté until they change color.
instructions.5: Add the chopped onion and sauté with the mushrooms.
instructions.6: Add the chopped garlic and stir with the mixture.
instructions.7: Add the celeriac and sauté.
instructions.8: Add the mushrooms and stir well with the mixture.
instructions.9: Add the flour and stir thoroughly.
instructions.10: Add salt and black pepper.
instructions.11: Pour in the boiling water and let the mixture boil.
instructions.12: Add the cream and stir well.
instructions.13: Simmer the soup on low heat until it boils and thickens.
instructions.14: Serve hot with toasted bread and chopped parsley.

fah-238.title: Macaroni Soup
fah-238.culturalNotes: This soup can be served hot and makes a complete, nutrient-rich meal. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces and stir until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and stir until the onion turns golden.
instructions.4: Add the carrots, peas, and corn, and mix well.
instructions.5: Pour in the boiling water (about 2 liters), add the broth cube, salt, pepper, and sugar. Bring to a boil.
instructions.6: Cover the pot and simmer on low heat until vegetables are tender.
instructions.7: In a separate pan, heat 1 teaspoon of ghee and 1 tablespoon of oil. Add the macaroni and stir until golden brown.
instructions.8: Add the browned macaroni to the pot with the vegetables and chicken.
instructions.9: Add the celery, corn, and tomato sauce. Mix all ingredients together.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and simmer on low heat for 2 minutes until boiling.
instructions.11: Turn off the heat and let the soup rest for 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

fah-239.title: Bird's Tongue Soup with Vegetables and Chicken
fah-239.culturalNotes: This soup can be served hot with bread or as a main course for breakfast.

fah-239-i5.name: Chicken
fah-239-i5.standardAmount: one tablespoon of roasted bird's tongue

instructions.1: Heat the semolina in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces and sauté with pepper, cumin, and cinnamon powder.
instructions.3: Add the finely chopped onion and stir until softened.
instructions.4: Add the peas and carrots and mix together.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and let the vegetables steam for 2 to 3 minutes.
instructions.6: Add the zucchini and potatoes and stir.
instructions.7: Add water or broth and the instant stock cube, then cover the pot.
instructions.8: Simmer until vegetables are tender but not mushy.
instructions.9: Add salt and bird's tongue, then cover the pot.
instructions.10: Let the soup boil, then turn off the heat.
instructions.11: Add the celery and cover the pot for one minute.

fah-240.title: Homemade Cooking Cream
fah-240.culturalNotes: This cream can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 10 days. It is used to prepare sauces, soups, and pasta dishes.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, flour, clotted cream, and sugar in a blender until smooth.
instructions.2: Pour the mixture into a saucepan and place over medium heat, stirring constantly until it comes to a boil.
instructions.3: Strain the mixture thoroughly through a fine sieve to remove any lumps.
instructions.4: Pour the cream into a storage container and refrigerate.

fah-241.title: Homemade Instant Stock
fah-241.culturalNotes: Store the mixture in an airtight container in a dark, cool place to preserve its aroma and flavor for a long time.

instructions.1: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Heat the bowl over low heat and stir the ingredients for 5 minutes until moisture evaporates.
instructions.3: Let the mixture cool completely.
instructions.4: Grind the mixture in a spice grinder until smooth.
instructions.5: Store the mixture in an airtight container in a dark, cool place.
instructions.6: You can store excess in sealed bags in the freezer.
instructions.7: Use one teaspoon of the mixture as needed.
instructions.8: This mixture can be used in soups, molokhia, sauces, and other dishes.

fah-242.title: Dakka
fah-242.culturalNotes: Dakka can be used to marinate fish, added to fava beans, or served with pickles. It stays fresh for a long time, whether stored in the refrigerator or at room temperature.

instructions.1: Wash the peppers and garlic thoroughly, then chop the peppers into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the peppers and garlic in the food processor and chop them finely.
instructions.3: Add vinegar, lemon juice, salt, dried parsley, and cumin.
instructions.4: Mix all ingredients well in the food processor until fully combined.
instructions.5: Transfer the dakka to a clean, dry jar and store in the refrigerator or at room temperature as desired.

fah-243.title: Pickled Potatoes
fah-243.culturalNotes: This salad can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. It can be served alongside breakfast, falafel, tamaya, or any other meal.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in boiling water for 3-4 minutes until partially cooked.
instructions.2: Prepare
instructions.3: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small cubes.
instructions.4: Mix 2 tablespoons of the dressing (containing lemon, cumin, vinegar, and garlic) with 1 tablespoon of oil and 1 teaspoon of turmeric.
instructions.5: Add the cubed potatoes to the dressing and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the minced garlic and chopped parsley, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.7: Serve the salad cold alongside any meal.

fah-244.title: Fish and Poultry Marinade
fah-244.culturalNotes: This marinade can be used for eggplant stuffing or marinating fish and poultry. It can be stored for a long time without refrigeration due to the salt and vinegar.

instructions.1: Mix the hot, cold, and red peppers with vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cilantro, and cumin in a blender until the marinade becomes smooth.
instructions.2: Add oil to the marinade and stir well.
instructions.3: Add chopped parsley and grated carrot, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.4: Store the marinade in clean, dry jars in a cool, dry place.

fah-245.title: Spicy Tomato Sauce
fah-245.culturalNotes: You can store the tomato sauce in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Serve the sauce with grilled chicken, roasted potatoes, or fragrant rice.

instructions.1: Mix 2 cups water with 4 tablespoons cornstarch in a bowl and stir well at room temperature.
instructions.2: Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and bring to heat. Add 7 garlic cloves and stir until the starch thickens and turns clear white.
instructions.3: Let the mixture cool slightly, then transfer it to a blender.
instructions.4: Add 1 cup plain yogurt, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, a pinch of salt, and 2 tablespoons vinegar. Cover the blender and blend until smooth.
instructions.5: Slowly pour in 1/2 cup oil while the blender is running, until the mixture is fully emulsified.
instructions.6: Add 3 tablespoons harissa and blend again until completely smooth.

fah-246.title: Pepper and Vinegar Relish
fah-246.culturalNotes: This mixture can be used in many dishes such as shawarma, tahini salad, baba ghanoush salad, fish marinade, and pickled eggplant. It can be stored in an airtight container without refrigeration.

instructions.1: Wash the green and red peppers thoroughly.
instructions.2: Remove the stems and seeds from the peppers and cut them into large pieces.
instructions.3: Place the peppers into the food processor.
instructions.4: Add the peeled and prepared onion.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and lemon juice.
instructions.6: Add the cumin, parsley, and salt.
instructions.7: Cover the processor and pulse until ingredients are well blended.
instructions.8: After blending, transfer the mixture to a suitable storage container.

fah-247.title: Pepper and Cilantro Dipping Sauce
fah-247.culturalNotes: This sauce can be used to marinate fish, shrimp, and grilled eggplant, among other dishes. It can be stored for up to a month at room temperature.

instructions.1: Wash the hot and sweet peppers, red pepper, and green pepper thoroughly.
instructions.2: Chop the peppers, fresh cilantro, and garlic into small pieces.
instructions.3: Mix all ingredients in a deep bowl.
instructions.4: Add vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin, dried cilantro, and chili pepper.
instructions.5: Whisk the mixture well until fully combined.
instructions.6: Store the sauce in an airtight container in the refrigerator or at room temperature for up to a month.

fah-248.title: Parsley and Onion Salad
fah-248.culturalNotes: You can add some olives or feta to serve a more varied dish. The salad can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Chop the parsley finely.
instructions.2: Slice the onion thinly.
instructions.3: Cut the cucumber into small pieces.
instructions.4: Cut the tomatoes into medium-sized pieces.
instructions.5: Place all ingredients in a serving bowl.
instructions.6: Add salt, black pepper, cumin, cilantro, paprika, and chili paste to taste.
instructions.7: Mix the ingredients well.
instructions.8: Add lemon juice and water, and mix again.
instructions.9: Serve chilled with kofta and roasted potatoes.

fah-249.title: Tuna Salad
fah-249.culturalNotes: You can add chili pepper or green bell pepper according to preference. Tuna salad can be served with toasted bread or in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mash the tuna well in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the chopped colored bell peppers into small cubes.
instructions.3: Add the finely chopped onion.
instructions.4: Add 4 tablespoons of yellow corn (optional).
instructions.5: Add a pinch of salt.
instructions.6: Add the lemon juice.
instructions.7: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.8: Add 4 tablespoons of mayonnaise.
instructions.9: Stir the ingredients again to ensure they are well combined.

fah-250.title: Hattee Salad
fah-250.culturalNotes: You can add ice cubes to the salad to make it cooler and more refreshing. It can also be served with grilled chicken or pasta with sauce.

instructions.1: Chop the red onion into small pieces and place in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add cumin, black pepper, dried coriander, salt, lemon juice, vinegar, and ground chili. Mix all ingredients well.
instructions.3: Chop the cucumber, tomato, bell pepper, and hot pepper into small pieces and add to the bowl.
instructions.4: Grate the carrot and add it to the bowl.
instructions.5: Add parsley, basil, and fresh coriander. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.6: Serve the salad in a serving dish.

fah-251.title: Herring Salad
fah-251.culturalNotes: Herring salad can be served as a light meal or as part of a festive holiday meal. The dressing can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix tahini with 1/4 cup water and blend thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add mayonnaise, lemon juice, vinegar, hot pepper, cumin, and salt. Blend all ingredients together.
instructions.3: Add finely sliced white onion, green and red peppers, and parsley. Mix well.
instructions.4: Place cubed herring on top of the dressing and mix everything together.
instructions.5: Garnish the dish with herring cubes, herring rosettes, and cherry tomatoes.
instructions.6: Add cubed boiled or roasted potatoes, cubed herring, and mix everything together.
instructions.7: Mix tahini with mayonnaise, lemon juice, oil, and cream. Blend thoroughly.
instructions.8: Add green onions, peppers, and dill. Mix all ingredients together.
instructions.9: Garnish the dish with cubed boiled potatoes, green onions, dill, and lemon slices.
instructions.10: Boil water and add herring. Let it cook for 1 minute until the skin peels off and saltiness reduces.
instructions.11: Skin the herring and remove the bones and belly.
instructions.12: Add fried herring with lemon juice, tahini, crushed pepper, and oil.

fah-252.title: Yogurt Salad with Rice and Dried Chicken
fah-252.culturalNotes: You can add some freshly ground black pepper to taste for a sharper flavor. The salad can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Chop the cucumber into small cubes.
instructions.2: Mash the garlic thoroughly.
instructions.3: Chop the mint leaves into small pieces.
instructions.4: Mix all ingredients in a deep bowl.
instructions.5: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, salt, and lemon juice.
instructions.6: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.7: Serve the salad alongside rice and dried chicken.

fah-253.title: Harsha Salad
fah-253.culturalNotes: You can add some grated carrots or diced cucumber to enhance flavor and nutritional value. The salad can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Dice the red onion into small cubes.
instructions.2: Dice the tomatoes, red bell pepper, and green bell pepper into small cubes.
instructions.3: Chop the parsley and cilantro into small pieces.
instructions.4: Slice the garlic thinly.
instructions.5: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
instructions.6: Add the vinegar and lemon juice, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add salt, black pepper, cumin, chili, pomegranate molasses, and stir well.
instructions.8: Add olive oil and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.9: Serve the salad cold as a side dish or light meal.

fah-254.title: Sweet and Chili Sauce
fah-254.culturalNotes: This sauce can be used with grilled meats, kebabs, and stews. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Wash the hot red peppers and chop them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the peppers, sugar, vinegar, and salt in a bowl and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the water and let the mixture simmer over medium heat until it boils.
instructions.4: In a small bowl, mix the cornstarch with 4 cups of water until smooth.
instructions.5: Gradually add the cornstarch mixture to the boiling mixture and stir well until thickened.
instructions.6: Add the black honey and tomato sauce, and stir well until fully combined.
instructions.7: Simmer the mixture on low heat for an additional 5 minutes until thickened.
instructions.8: Pour into a container and let cool before storing in the refrigerator.

fah-255.title: Chili Sauce
fah-255.culturalNotes: Serve the sauce with roasted potatoes, burgers, and sandwiches. Adjust the spiciness to taste.

instructions.1: Wash the hot red pepper and chop it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the hot red pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and ginger powder in a blender and blend thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add 1/2 cup of water to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into a saucepan and add 1/2 cup vinegar, 1/2 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons black honey, salt, and ground black pepper. Mix ingredients well.
instructions.5: Add the remaining 1 cup of water and let the mixture boil.
instructions.6: In a small bowl, mix 2 tablespoons cornstarch with the remaining 1/2 cup of water and stir well.
instructions.7: Pour the cornstarch mixture into the saucepan on the stove and stir well until the sauce thickens.
instructions.8: Let the sauce cool completely.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce into a clean, dry jar and store in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 months.

fah-256.title: Spicy Shattaya with Grilled Eggplant
fah-256.culturalNotes: Shattaya can be served as a dip, salad, or side dish with fava beans, tamieya, roasted potatoes, or boiled eggs. It can also be served with koshari or as a side dish at a barbecue gathering.

instructions.1: Wash the eggplant and dry it, then make small incisions on it with a knife.
instructions.2: Grill the eggplant on all sides over medium heat on a griddle.
instructions.3: Wash the red and green peppers and chop them into small pieces.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the garlic and sauté until lightly golden.
instructions.5: Add the peppers and sauté with the garlic until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the chopped tomatoes and seasonings (cumin, parsley, salt), and mix well.
instructions.7: Add the vinegar and honey, and let the mixture boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: Squeeze the lemons and add the juice to the mixture.
instructions.9: Let the mixture simmer until thickened.
instructions.10: Peel the grilled eggplant easily and wrap it in plastic wrap, leaving the bottom uncovered.
instructions.11: Add the grilled eggplant to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.12: Drizzle with a little olive oil and sprinkle with fresh parsley or coriander.

fah-257.title: Sahli Soupy
fah-257.culturalNotes: Chili can be added for those who prefer a spicy taste. This dish can be served as an appetizer or side dish.

fah-257-i1.name: Garlic
fah-257-i1.standardAmount: Half a head of garlic (about 1 tablespoon minced)

instructions.1: Peel the garlic and mince it until it reaches about 1 tablespoon.
instructions.2: Take 1 teaspoon of cumin and 1 teaspoon of dried parsley.
instructions.3: Chop the hot green pepper.
instructions.4: Mix the garlic, cumin, dried parsley, and hot pepper in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the grated tomatoes and lemons, and mix all ingredients well.
instructions.6: Add the dried molokhia and stir everything together.
instructions.7: Pour in the water and stir the mixture until it reaches the desired consistency.
instructions.8: Taste the mixture and add salt to your preference.
instructions.9: Serve the sahli soup in a serving bowl, garnished with fresh sliced onions, hot peppers, and lemon slices.

fah-258.title: Regular Tomato Sauce
fah-258.culturalNotes: The sauce can be stored in plastic bags in the refrigerator for up to one week or in the freezer for up to one month.

instructions.1: Prepare the tomatoes: Squeeze the tomatoes and strain them well.
instructions.2: Sauté the garlic and onion.
instructions.3: Add the strained tomatoes and stir with the onion and garlic.
instructions.4: Add salt and sugar, and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.5: Simmer the sauce on low heat, partially covering the pot to allow steam to escape.
instructions.6: Add the spices (cumin, parsley, black pepper) and 3 instant stock cubes.
instructions.7: Let the sauce boil for about 10 minutes until the ingredients are well blended.
instructions.8: Add the sauce to your dish as needed.

fah-259.title: Koshari Sauce
fah-259.culturalNotes: The sauce can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one week. It can be used to prepare koshari or pasta.

instructions.1: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add garlic and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add onion and stir together until the onion turns light golden.
instructions.4: Add strained tomato juice and stir with onion and garlic.
instructions.5: Add salt and sugar, and stir well.
instructions.6: Add cumin, parsley, and black pepper, and stir into the sauce.
instructions.7: Add instant stock cubes and stir well.
instructions.8: Simmer the sauce on low heat, partially covered, to prevent splattering.
instructions.9: Let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes until ingredients are well combined.
instructions.10: Turn off the heat and let the sauce cool slightly before using.

fah-260.title: Pasta Sauce
fah-260.culturalNotes: This sauce can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one week. It can be used with pasta, koshari, and other dishes.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the garlic and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the onion and sauté until lightly golden.
instructions.4: Add the tomato juice and stir well with the onion and garlic.
instructions.5: Add the salt and sugar and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the cumin, parsley, and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the broth cubes and stir well.
instructions.8: Simmer the sauce on low heat, partially covered, to prevent splattering.
instructions.9: Let it simmer for 10 minutes until the ingredients are well combined.
instructions.10: Turn off the heat and let the sauce cool slightly before using.

fah-261.title: Barbecue Sauce
fah-261.culturalNotes: The sauce can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to two weeks. It can be used with grilled meats or as a sauce for chicken or other meats.

instructions.1: Place 1/2 cup water in a saucepan over heat.
instructions.2: Add 2 cups ketchup to the water and stir them together.
instructions.3: Add 1/2 cup vinegar, 1/4 cup sugar, and 1 large spoon black honey.
instructions.4: Add 1 small spoon turmeric, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt.
instructions.5: Add 2 large spoons smoked paprika and stir well.
instructions.6: Add 1 large spoon soy sauce and stir.
instructions.7: Let the mixture boil for 5 minutes over heat, stirring constantly.
instructions.8: Remove from heat and let it cool.

fah-262.title: Creamy Mushroom Sauce
fah-262.culturalNotes: You can use fresh or canned mushrooms according to preference. You can also add a pinch of salt to taste.

instructions.1: Heat the butter or ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the flour and stir until the flour is lightly browned and golden.
instructions.3: Add a pinch of black pepper and stir.
instructions.4: Add the drained mushrooms and stir over heat for a few minutes until the mushrooms are tender.
instructions.5: Add the meat sauce and stir until well combined.
instructions.6: Add the cooking cream and stir until the sauce becomes creamy.
instructions.7: Simmer the sauce on low heat until slightly thickened.

fah-263.title: Ranch Dressing
fah-263.culturalNotes: The dressing can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. It can be used as a spread for sandwiches, a dressing for salads, or a dip for vegetables.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt and mayonnaise in a deep bowl.
instructions.2: Add the lemon juice and finely chopped parsley.
instructions.3: Add a pinch of onion powder, garlic powder, ginger, and black pepper.
instructions.4: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.5: Add one tablespoon of mustard and stir again.
instructions.6: Mix the dressing thoroughly and serve cold.

fah-264.title: Sweet Chili Sauce
fah-264.culturalNotes: The sauce can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to two weeks. It can be served with grilled meats or used as a sauce for chicken or beef.

instructions.1: Add water, sugar, and vinegar to a saucepan and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.2: Add the crushed chili pepper and finely chopped garlic, and stir the ingredients together.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of ketchup and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.4: Bring the mixture to medium heat and let it boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Add salt and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.6: Add the cornstarch dissolved in water to the mixture and stir rapidly until fully combined.
instructions.7: Continue cooking on low heat until the sauce thickens and comes together.
instructions.8: Remove the sauce from the heat and let it cool.

fah-265.title: Homemade Mayonnaise Without Eggs
fah-265.culturalNotes: This mayonnaise can be used in salads, pastries, and other dishes. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one week.

instructions.1: Add the cubed cheese to the sour cream in the blender bowl.
instructions.2: Add the mustard and salt, and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the lemon juice and mix again.
instructions.4: Slowly pour in the vegetable oil in a thin stream while the blender is running.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the white honey and continue blending until the mixture is fully combined and has a thick consistency.

fah-266.title: Shourik
fah-266.culturalNotes: You can use a regular oven instead of a griddle if you don't have a griddle. Make sure the temperature is very high.

instructions.1: Mix 1 cup warm milk with 1 cup warm water, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon yeast, and a pinch of salt.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients well until sugar, salt, and yeast are fully dissolved.
instructions.3: Cover the mixture and let it sit for 10 minutes until the yeast begins to activate.
instructions.4: Add 2 tablespoons of oil and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.5: Add 6 cups of flour and mix until the dough comes together.
instructions.6: Cover the dough with 2 tablespoons of oil and let it rise for 30 minutes in a warm place.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
instructions.8: Cover the balls with a clean cloth and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Roll each ball on a surface lightly dusted with flour.
instructions.10: Place the rolled dough on a greased griddle and brush the top with beaten egg mixed with 1 teaspoon vanilla.
instructions.11: Sprinkle the top with sesame seeds and nigella seeds.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.13: Serve Shourik hot with steamed cauliflower, cress, olives, and black honey.

fah-267.title: Smed and Dukha
fah-267.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is smooth and cohesive before letting it rise. You can add black pepper to the dukha according to preference. The smed can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and all-purpose flour in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add powdered milk, sugar, yeast, salt, and sesame seeds. Mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add oil and warm water. Knead until the dough becomes smooth and cohesive.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes, until doubled in size.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls, about the size of a lemon.
instructions.6: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Mix date molasses with water. Stir well.
instructions.8: Grind the dukha (peanuts, sesame seeds, almonds, cumin, parsley, salt) in a grinder until coarse.
instructions.9: Shape each dough ball into a spiral, dip it into the date molasses mixture, then into sesame seeds.
instructions.10: Place the smed in a greased baking tray and let them rise again for 30 minutes.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 15–20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.12: Serve the smed warm with dukha and a cup of milk tea.

fah-268.title: Kanafah
fah-268.culturalNotes: Kanafah can be served hot or cold, depending on preference. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Brush two phyllo sheets with butter as shown.
instructions.2: Crumple the sheets together.
instructions.3: Place the crumpled sheets into a buttered baking dish.
instructions.4: Repeat the previous steps until all sheets are used.
instructions.5: Cut the crumpled sheets into small pieces.
instructions.6: Mix milk and caramel cream together and pour over the crumpled sheets.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Remove the kanafah from the oven when golden brown.
instructions.9: Pour syrup over the kanafah immediately after removing from the oven.

fah-269.title: Custard-Stuffed Brioche
fah-269.culturalNotes: Make sure the milk used in the dough is warm, not too hot, to avoid killing the yeast. You can add raisins to the custard while preparing it, or sprinkle them on the brioche after baking.

instructions.1: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 3 egg whites and stir well.
instructions.3: Gradually add warm milk and knead the dough.
instructions.4: Add butter and knead for 10 minutes until the dough is smooth.
instructions.5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover it, and let it rise.
instructions.6: In another bowl, combine 3 cups milk and 1/2 cup heavy cream and heat on medium flame.
instructions.7: Add 3 egg yolks, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 cup sugar, and 3 tablespoons cornstarch. Stir well.
instructions.8: Gradually add the cornstarch mixture to the hot milk and stir rapidly until the custard becomes creamy.
instructions.9: Add 1 tablespoon butter to the custard and let it cool.
instructions.10: Divide the dough into equal-sized balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Roll out each ball into a circle using a rolling pin.
instructions.12: Place custard filling in the center of each circle and add a few raisins.
instructions.13: Cover the filling with the other half of the circle and place the brioche on an oiled baking pan.
instructions.14: Brush the brioche with an egg and vanilla mixture.
instructions.15: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 10 minutes, until golden brown.

fah-270.title: Homemade Baksheesh
fah-270.culturalNotes: Make sure the yeast is active and test it before using. You can serve baksheesh with cheese, yogurt with vanilla, and tea.

instructions.1: In a large bowl, mix the flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and yeast.
instructions.2: Gradually add half a cup of oil and mix.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm water and mix until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until soft and elastic.
instructions.5: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small, even pieces.
instructions.7: Roll each piece into a rectangle and seal the edges well.
instructions.8: Place the baksheesh on an oiled baking tray, cover, and let rise for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: In a small bowl, mix water and sugar, then transfer to a spray bottle.
instructions.10: Spray the baksheesh with the sugar water mixture, then sprinkle with sesame and nigella seeds.
instructions.11: Preheat the oven to 160 degrees Celsius.
instructions.12: Bake the baksheesh in the middle rack for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.

fah-271.title: Oven Burek
fah-271.culturalNotes: You can add other ingredients such as pastrami or thyme according to preference. Burek can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Serve burek with tea or coffee for a delicious taste.

fah-271-i14.name: a pinch of instant coffee (for brushing)

instructions.1: Mix the dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, yeast, sugar, salt) in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and powdered milk, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm water until the dough comes together and becomes firm.
instructions.4: Add the oil and knead for 10 minutes until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.5: Add 1 tablespoon of tomato sauce to give it a reddish color.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into 4 parts and shape them into balls.
instructions.8: Roll each ball into a thin sheet, less than half a centimeter thick.
instructions.9: Cut the dough into circles using a cup or a round cutter.
instructions.10: Fill each circle with cheese and your favorite fillings (such as pastrami, thyme, parsley, olives).
instructions.11: Seal the circles tightly into a turnover shape.
instructions.12: Place the burek on an oiled baking tray, leaving space between each piece.
instructions.13: Let the burek rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.14: Brush the tops with a mixture of powdered milk, sugar, coffee, water, and egg.
instructions.15: Sprinkle sesame and nigella seeds on top.
instructions.16: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat (200°C) for 15–20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.17: Remove from the oven and serve warm.

fah-272.title: Spinach Baklava
fah-272.culturalNotes: The filling can be frozen and used later in any pastries. The filling can be changed to include cheese with feta or ground meat or spicy sausage.

instructions.1: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add diced chicken and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add finely chopped onion and stir until softened.
instructions.4: Add salt and pepper and mix well.
instructions.5: Add washed and chopped spinach and stir until wilted and moisture evaporates.
instructions.6: Remove filling from heat and let cool slightly.
instructions.7: Add cream cheese and shredded cheese (mozzarella and cheddar) and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: In another bowl, mix 1/2 cup melted butter, 1 cup yogurt, and 1 teaspoon baking powder until well combined.
instructions.9: Take one phyllo sheet, brush with mixture, place another sheet on top and brush again. Repeat until you have 3–4 layers.
instructions.10: Place filling in the center of the sheet and carefully roll it up.
instructions.11: Repeat until all phyllo sheets are used.
instructions.12: Place baklava in a greased baking dish.
instructions.13: Brush the top with 2 tablespoons of melted butter.
instructions.14: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.15: Cut and serve warm.

fah-273.title: Middle Eastern Pizza
fah-273.culturalNotes: Any available fillings from the fridge can be used, such as cheese, meat, or chicken. Make sure the fillings are evenly spread before placing them into the pastry.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the water and knead until the dough becomes medium consistency.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rest for half an hour.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls.
instructions.6: Grease the table and rolling pin with butter and oil.
instructions.7: Roll out the dough with the rolling pin until it becomes very thin.
instructions.8: Make cuts with a knife every 10 cm.
instructions.9: Place the filling in the center.
instructions.10: Close the pastry from the sides and brush with oil.
instructions.11: Place the pastries onto an oiled baking tray.
instructions.12: Bake in a very hot oven for 10–15 minutes.
instructions.13: Alternatively, cook the pastries on a pan over medium heat until cooked on both sides.

fah-274.title: Assorted Pastries with Different Fillings
fah-274.culturalNotes: Fattah can be frozen after proper wrapping and used later after thawing at room temperature or reheating in the microwave.

instructions.1: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, salt, and dry milk powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add yogurt and egg white, then gradually mix in warm water until the dough comes together.
instructions.3: Knead for 10 minutes, adding butter or oil halfway through.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes to 1 hour in a warm place.
instructions.5: In another bowl, sauté the onion in oil until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add mashed potatoes, spices, parsley, and mozzarella cheese; mix well.
instructions.7: Prepare the other fillings: mix cheese mix with cream cheese and thyme, black olives; combine Stilton cheese with green pepper; mix spiced minced meat with parsley.
instructions.8: Divide the dough into equal-sized balls and cover them.
instructions.9: Roll out each ball and fill with different fillings; shape as desired (crescents, rounds, flatbreads).
instructions.10: Brush the pastries with a mixture of egg yolk and milk.
instructions.11: Place the pastries on an oiled baking tray and let them rise for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated hot oven for 15–20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Cover the pastries immediately after removing from the oven with a clean towel to keep them soft and fluffy.

fah-275.title: Assorted Pastries for Parties and Christmas
fah-275.culturalNotes: You can use different types of cheese and meats according to preference. Make sure the dough is soft and not dry for the best results. The pastries can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with warm water and sugar, and let it sit aside for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with salt, baking powder, and powdered milk.
instructions.3: Add the mayonnaise, yogurt, and risen yeast, and knead all ingredients well.
instructions.4: Gradually add the warm water until you achieve a soft and smooth dough.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise for 1 hour.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into large and small balls.
instructions.7: Shape the small balls into circles and arrange them in an oiled baking tray.
instructions.8: Shape the large balls into various forms such as strips and circles.
instructions.9: Add different fillings such as sausage, tuna, cheese, olives, and colored peppers.
instructions.10: Brush the pastries with a mixture of powdered milk, sugar, and Nescafé.
instructions.11: Sprinkle the pastries with sesame seeds or poppy seeds.
instructions.12: Bake the pastries in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20–30 minutes until golden brown.

fah-276.title: Assortment of Pastries for Parties and Birthdays
fah-276.culturalNotes: You can add different fillings as desired, such as shredded chicken or ground meat. The pastries can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

fah-276-i10.name: 2 large tablespoons powdered milk (for brushing the surface)

fah-276-i11.name: 1 small teaspoon sugar (for brushing the surface)

fah-276-i12.name: a pinch of instant coffee (for brushing the surface)

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with sugar and warm water, and let it sit aside for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with salt, baking powder, and powdered milk.
instructions.3: Add the mayonnaise, yogurt, and risen yeast, and knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.4: Gradually add warm water until you achieve a soft and smooth dough.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise for 1 hour.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into large and small balls.
instructions.7: Shape the large balls into various forms such as mini sandwiches, rolled sausages, layered fillo, and squares.
instructions.8: Fill the pastries with different fillings as desired.
instructions.9: Brush the pastries with a mixture of powdered milk, sugar, and instant coffee.
instructions.10: Arrange the pastries in an oiled baking tray and let them rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 15–20 minutes, until golden brown.

fah-277.title: Chicken and Cheese Glaash
fah-277.culturalNotes: Chicken filling can be frozen for later use. Increase the amount of milk for a softer, more tender glaash.

instructions.1: Prepare the glaash and cut it to fit the baking dish size.
instructions.2: Grease the baking dish with a mixture of butter and oil.
instructions.3: Layer the glaash sheets, brushing each layer with the butter and oil mixture.
instructions.4: Place the cut glaash in the center to prevent cracking.
instructions.5: Spread the chicken filling and cheese in the center.
instructions.6: Cover the dish with the final sheet of glaash.
instructions.7: Cut the dish before placing it in the oven.
instructions.8: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.
instructions.9: Place the dish in the middle rack of the oven until golden brown.
instructions.10: Mix 1/2 teaspoon baking powder with 1/2 cup milk and pour over the dish.
instructions.11: Return the dish to the oven until it turns golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove from oven and serve hot.

fah-278.title: Spicy Cheese and Fruit Baklava
fah-278.culturalNotes: You can sprinkle powdered sugar and crumbled custard on top before serving. You may also use different types of cheese and fruits according to preference.

instructions.1: Take two sheets of phyllo dough and cut them into the desired shape, then roll them to form roses.
instructions.2: Arrange the roses in a greased baking pan.
instructions.3: Prepare the custard mixture: Mix the custard or cornstarch with yogurt, milk, vanilla, melted butter, and powdered sugar.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture over the roses in the pan.
instructions.5: Add one teaspoon of strawberry jam on top of each rose.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.7: Prepare the yogurt and butter mixture: Mix butter, yogurt, and baking powder.
instructions.8: Grease the baking pan with oil or shortening, then line it with phyllo dough, brushing each layer with the mixture.
instructions.9: Place the filling (cheese, bell peppers, olives, and pastirma) in the center.
instructions.10: Close the pan with the remaining phyllo dough and bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.11: Serve the spicy baklava warm with vanilla ice cream.

fah-279.title: Phila Roll with Fajita
fah-279.culturalNotes: You can add chili pepper for a spicy flavor. The roll can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes.
instructions.2: Dice the onion, bell peppers, and tomato into small cubes.
instructions.3: Mix the chicken with salt, chicken seasoning, black pepper, onion powder, ketchup, and seven-spice mix.
instructions.4: Let the mixture rest for one hour to set.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the chicken until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Add the onion, bell peppers, and tomato, and stir for two minutes.
instructions.7: Mix baking powder with ghee or butter and stir well.
instructions.8: Brush a phyllo sheet with the mixture and lay it in a baking tray or dish.
instructions.9: Repeat the previous step until you have stacked about 6-7 sheets.
instructions.10: Place the filling on one end of the phyllo with mixed cheese.
instructions.11: Gently roll the phyllo, and brush the top with the remaining mixture.
instructions.12: Bake in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Cut the roll into slices before serving.

fah-280.title: Turkish Balloon Bread
fah-280.culturalNotes: Turkish balloon bread can be used to make various sandwiches, whether sweet or savory. The loaf can be stored in a sealed plastic bag for up to two days.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix the warm milk with yeast and sugar, and stir well. Let sit for 10 minutes until the yeast begins to activate.
instructions.2: Add the flour and salt to the yeast and milk mixture, then add the oil. Knead the ingredients thoroughly until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes, until doubled in size.
instructions.4: Punch down the dough and divide it into 6 balls. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes to rise again.
instructions.5: Dip each ball into the milk, then into the white sesame seeds.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a floured surface to a thickness of about half a centimeter, then cut into 4 pieces.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the bread until puffed and golden brown on both sides.
instructions.8: Drain the bread on paper towels to absorb excess oil.

fah-281.title: Home Bread
fah-281.culturalNotes: You can use a toaster pan or an English cake pan to make a hollowed toast. You can freeze the bread and use it later to make sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mix the flour thoroughly in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm milk, oil, yeast, salt, egg, egg yolk, sugar, and baking powder.
instructions.3: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.4: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes to rise.
instructions.5: Gradually add more flour and mix until you get a smooth, lump-free dough.
instructions.6: Grease the baking pan with butter and dust it with flour.
instructions.7: Pour the dough into the pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.8: Cover the dough and let it rise for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush the top of the dough with egg white and sprinkle with nigella seeds, sesame seeds, and flax seeds.
instructions.10: Place the pan in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius.
instructions.11: Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.

fah-282.title: Breakfast and Evening Bread
fah-282.culturalNotes: This bread can be served with cheese, eggs, honey, or any other favorite dishes for breakfast or dinner. The bread can be stored in an airtight plastic bag for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, dried milk, sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the egg, vinegar, oil, and warm milk, then knead until the dough is soft and slightly sticky.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it doubles in size.
instructions.4: Press the dough into an oiled baking tray and let it rise again for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Brush the dough with the egg yolk mixed with a little vinegar.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into squares and sprinkle with sesame seeds and nigella seeds.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 15–20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.8: Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool slightly, then cut and serve.

fah-283.title: Eid Pastries
fah-283.culturalNotes: You can add any preferred extras such as nuts, raisins, or cheese. The pastries can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with baking powder, sugar, and salt.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix the ingredients thoroughly until they resemble damp sand.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm water until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough well until it becomes soft and easy to shape.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a surface dusted with cornstarch, and grease each layer with oil.
instructions.7: Place the pastries on a greased baking tray and fry them over medium heat until golden on both sides.
instructions.8: In another pan, sauté the onion in ghee until golden, then add black pepper, cinnamon, dried mint, and clove.
instructions.9: Add the ground meat and stir until fully cooked and dry, then season with salt and sugar.
instructions.10: Prepare the filling mixture using ghee, dried mint, and instant broth.
instructions.11: Place a layer of pastry in a greased baking dish, add 4–5 tablespoons of the filling mixture, and repeat until all pastries are used.
instructions.12: Top with the cooked ground meat and add your preferred extras such as nuts, raisins, and cheese.
instructions.13: Cover with another layer of pastry and repeat until all ingredients are used.
instructions.14: Cut the pastries into squares or rectangles before baking.
instructions.15: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden brown.

fah-284.title: Samosa with Cream
fah-284.culturalNotes: You can add a small stock cube to the broth to give it a stronger flavor. You can also grease the edges with ghee to prevent meat leakage.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the ground beef and stir with the onion until the meat turns golden brown.
instructions.4: Add the cinnamon, black pepper, and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Pour in the broth and yogurt, and stir well to combine.
instructions.6: Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Mix the ghee and baking powder in a small bowl and stir well.
instructions.8: Prepare the baking dish and grease it with ghee.
instructions.9: Lay a layer of samosa pastry into the dish and spread it evenly.
instructions.10: Spread a layer of the meat and broth mixture over the pastry.
instructions.11: Add another layer of samosa pastry and spread it evenly.
instructions.12: Spread another layer of the meat and broth mixture.
instructions.13: Add another layer of samosa pastry and spread it evenly.
instructions.14: Brush the top with the ghee and baking powder mixture.
instructions.15: Place the dish in a preheated oven at 220°C (428°F).
instructions.16: Bake for 20–25 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.17: Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.

fah-285.title: Phyllo Rolls Stuffed with Sausage and Cheese
fah-285.culturalNotes: You can add chili pepper if you prefer a spicy flavor. You can also prepare the rolls in advance and store them in the refrigerator for up to one hour before baking.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Slice the onion and green pepper thinly.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the green pepper and stir together for one minute.
instructions.4: Add the sausage cut into small pieces and stir with the onion and pepper for two minutes.
instructions.5: Add salt, black pepper, seven-spice mix, and sesame paste; stir well.
instructions.6: Add cumin and parsley; stir again.
instructions.7: Remove the filling from heat and let it cool slightly, then mix in the mozzarella cheese.
instructions.8: Prepare the rolls: Brush phyllo sheets with a mixture of butter and oil, or ghee and oil.
instructions.9: Place a portion of the filling in the center of a phyllo sheet, then tightly roll it up and seal the edges.
instructions.10: Arrange the rolls in a greased baking dish.
instructions.11: Brush the tops of the rolls with the remaining fat mixture.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove from oven and cover with aluminum foil for 5 minutes to keep them soft and tender.

fah-286.title: Multilayered Sandwich with Various Fillings
fah-286.culturalNotes: You can use any fillings you prefer, such as ground meat or shawarma. Make sure the dough is soft and slightly sticky to achieve soft, fluffy sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mix the warm milk, warm water, salt, sugar, yeast, and oil in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the flour and mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until soft and slightly sticky.
instructions.4: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and a kitchen towel, and let it rise in a closed oven for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: After the dough has risen, punch it down to release air and divide it into small balls.
instructions.6: Fill each ball with your preferred filling (feta cheese, parmesan cheese, Nutella chocolate).
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a rectangle, place the filling in the center, and shape the sandwiches into a roll.
instructions.8: Place the sandwiches in an oiled baking tray, making sure the seam is facing down.
instructions.9: Let the sandwiches rise again.
instructions.10: Brush the sandwiches with beaten egg mixed with a little vinegar.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at high temperature for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: After removing the sandwiches from the oven, cover them with a damp, wrung-out towel to keep them soft and fluffy.

fah-287.title: Soft Cheese and Parsley Sandwiches
fah-287.culturalNotes: You can change the filling as desired, such as adding ground meat or scrambled eggs. The sandwiches can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the warm water and knead until the dough is well combined.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix thoroughly until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with a plastic bag and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Fill the sandwiches with cheese, parsley, and chopped green pepper.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into equal-sized balls and roll them out with a rolling pin.
instructions.7: Place the filling in the center of each dough piece and seal the edges by pressing them together with your hands and tines of a fork.
instructions.8: Lightly dust a baking tray with flour and place the sandwiches on it.
instructions.9: Heat a pan over medium heat and add one tablespoon of oil.
instructions.10: Fry the sandwiches until golden brown on both sides.

fah-288.title: Crispy and Soft Kishke Sandwiches
fah-288.culturalNotes: You can change the filling as desired, such as cheese and sausage or cheese and sugar. You can also freeze the sandwiches and use them later.

instructions.1: Mix 1/2 cup warm water with 1/2 cup warm milk, 1 large spoon sugar, and 1 large spoon yeast. Cover the mixture and let it sit for 10 minutes to activate the yeast.
instructions.2: In a large bowl, mix 3 cups baking flour, 4 tablespoons milk powder, and 1 small spoon baking powder.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mixture to the flour, then add 1/2 cup oil and 1/2 small spoon salt. Knead the ingredients well.
instructions.4: If the dough needs more water, add warm water gradually, a little at a time, until the dough becomes smooth and soft.
instructions.5: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour until it rises.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into 18 balls the size of a large lemon.
instructions.7: Fill each ball with pastrami and cheese, and seal them tightly.
instructions.8: Place the sandwiches in a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.9: Cover the sandwiches and let them rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.11: Bake the sandwiches for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove the sandwiches from the oven and let them cool slightly before serving.

fah-289.title: Shaboura
fah-289.culturalNotes: Shaboura can be served in the traditional way or crispy after dipping in milk tea or plain tea. The aroma of baked goods creates a wonderful atmosphere at home, especially during winter.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and baking powder in a bowl and sift them well.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, oil, ghee, vanilla, and salt to a mixer and blend thoroughly until the color lightens.
instructions.3: Gradually add the flour and baking powder mixture to the liquid mixture and mix well.
instructions.4: Slowly add the warm milk and mix until the batter is smooth and uniform.
instructions.5: Grease a baking tray with ghee and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into the tray and bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 45 minutes.
instructions.7: Remove from the oven and check for doneness.
instructions.8: Serve hot, or cut in half and dip into milk tea or plain tea.

fah-290.title: Quick Bread Slices
fah-290.culturalNotes: You can serve these slices for breakfast or dinner, and they're perfect for students in a lunchbox. You can also stuff them with butter and cheese or any filling you prefer.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1 cup warm milk with 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 tablespoon active dry yeast. Stir well and let sit for 10 minutes until frothy.
instructions.2: In another bowl, combine 3 1/2 cups baking flour with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon baking powder.
instructions.3: Add the frothy milk mixture to the flour along with 1 tablespoon vinegar and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Knead until the dough is soft and smooth.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel. Let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
instructions.5: After the dough has risen, roll it out on a floured surface to about 1 cm thickness.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into suitable-sized squares.
instructions.7: Heat a greased griddle over medium heat. Place the slices on it, cover, and let them rise again for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: Prepare the brushing mixture by combining 1/4 cup olive oil with 1 teaspoon chopped garlic, 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, and 1 teaspoon smoked paprika.
instructions.9: Brush the slices with the mixture, then bake in a preheated oven at the highest temperature for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve the slices warm. You can stuff them with butter and cheese or any filling you prefer.

fah-291.title: Light and Soft Flaky Dough
fah-291.culturalNotes: This dough can be used to make sweet and savory pastries. The pastries can be frozen for long-term storage. You can shape the dough into any form you like and fill it with any filling you prefer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg white, yogurt, and oil, and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the baking soda, a little at a time, until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes soft and smooth.
instructions.5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover it, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour until risen.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into small balls and arrange them on a flour-dusted tray.
instructions.7: Roll each ball with a rolling pin until it is about 0.5 cm thick, and shape as desired.
instructions.8: Brush the tops of the pastries with diluted vinegar mixed with water, then bake in a preheated oven at 220°C.
instructions.9: Bake for 10–15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.10: Let the pastries cool before freezing or serving.

fah-292.title: Light and Crispy Dough for Breads and Baked Goods
fah-292.culturalNotes: You can use this dough to make various baked goods such as pizza and manakeesh. To store the dough, place it in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix 3 cups warm water with 2 tablespoons yeast, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon salt, and 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients well and cover the bowl. Let it sit for 10 minutes until the yeast activates and bubbles appear.
instructions.3: Gradually add 1 kilogram of flour and mix until the dough comes together and feels soft.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes until it rises and doubles in size.
instructions.5: After 30 minutes, wash your hands with water and begin folding the dough from all four sides. Cover again and let it rest for another 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Repeat the folding and covering process two more times, each time letting it rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: After the third fold, wash your hands with water and fold the dough one final time. Cover and let it rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: After 30 minutes, wash your hands with water and fold the dough one last time. Cover and let it rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Lightly dust your work surface with flour and semolina. Roll out the dough.
instructions.10: Cut the dough into equal portions and fill each with thyme and olives, or cheese, labneh, parsley, and cherry tomatoes.
instructions.11: Place the portions onto an oiled baking tray and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees Celsius. Bake the portions for 10–15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.

fah-293.title: Japanese Crispy and Puffed Dough
fah-293.culturalNotes: You can shape the dough into any form you like and fill it with various fillings. The dough becomes crispy and puffed after cooking, making it perfect for serving at different occasions.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 6 cups warm milk with 3 tablespoons flour and stir well while cooling.
instructions.2: Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the flour is fully cooked and the consistency becomes creamy.
instructions.3: Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the yeast with 3 tablespoons sugar, 1 tablespoon milk powder, and 1.5 teaspoons salt.
instructions.5: Add the egg and yogurt, and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.6: Gradually add the cooled dough mixture to the bowl and knead until well combined.
instructions.7: Add 80 grams soft butter and knead the dough until smooth and not sticky.
instructions.8: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: After rising, divide the dough into small balls and shape them into muffin or cupcake forms.
instructions.10: Add your preferred filling, either sweet or savory.
instructions.11: Place the dough cups into muffin tins and bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Serve warm or cold, according to preference.

fah-294.title: Sponge Bread Without Oven
fah-294.culturalNotes: Fatta can be served with white cheese or honey or any filling you prefer. Make sure the dough is slightly sticky when kneading to achieve light and fluffy fatta.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in the warm yogurt and warm water, and stir together.
instructions.2: Leave the mixture in a warm place for 10 minutes until the yeast is activated.
instructions.3: Add the salt and egg, and stir into the mixture.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour and knead the dough with the warm water.
instructions.5: Add the oil and knead for 5 minutes until the dough becomes elastic and sticky.
instructions.6: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes until risen.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into 6 parts and brush each with oil.
instructions.8: Let the pieces rest for 10 minutes to relax.
instructions.9: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.10: Take a piece of dough and roll it out on an oiled surface.
instructions.11: Place the fatta in the pan and cover until the bottom is golden, then flip.
instructions.12: Repeat the process with the remaining dough pieces.

fah-295.title: Pita Bread
fah-295.culturalNotes: Pita bread can be served with honey, butter, feta cheese, or garlic paste. It can also be served alongside any other dish you prefer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the water while kneading until the dough becomes firm and no longer sticks to your hands.
instructions.3: Knead the dough thoroughly until it becomes smooth.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into equal-sized balls (about 10-14 balls).
instructions.5: Cover the balls with a plastic bag and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Lightly grease the pan with oil and roll each ball with a rolling pin until thin.
instructions.7: Place the rolled dough onto the hot pan over medium heat.
instructions.8: Flip and cook until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.9: Repeat the process until all the balls are used.

fah-296.title: Bakakine Bread
fah-296.culturalNotes: Bakakine bread can be baked on a griddle if available. The bread becomes soft and delicious when baked in a hot oven.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with sugar and warm water, and let it sit for 10 minutes until it becomes frothy.
instructions.2: Add the flour, butter oil, and vinegar, and knead thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add Dream yeast and knead well until the dough becomes soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Gradually add dried yogurt or yogurt, a little at a time, until the dough forms a ball.
instructions.5: Add salt 5 minutes after kneading, and knead again.
instructions.6: Let the dough rise until it doubles in size.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into small balls and let them rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll each ball with flour until thin.
instructions.9: Arrange the bread on a baking tray, leaving space between them.
instructions.10: Bake in a hot oven (top and bottom heat) until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let the bread cool slightly before serving.

fah-297.title: Baladi Bread
fah-297.culturalNotes: Can be stored in a sealed plastic bag for up to 3 days. Can be served with cheese, hummus, or any filling of your choice.

instructions.1: Heat the water very hot and pour it over the semolina flour, then mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add the all-purpose flour, sugar, yeast, salt, butter, and cottage cheese to the mixer and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the semolina dough to the rest of the ingredients in the mixer and knead for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Grease a deep bowl with oil, place the dough inside, then grease the top and cover with plastic wrap and a clean towel.
instructions.5: Let the dough rise until it doubles in size.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small balls (about the size of a small grapefruit).
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a log or a circle.
instructions.8: Let the dough rise again until it doubles in size.
instructions.9: Brush the dough with a mixture of powdered milk, instant coffee, and sugar.
instructions.10: Make incisions on the dough using a fluted rolling pin.
instructions.11: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Bake the bread in a preheated oven at 220°C for 10 minutes on the lower rack.
instructions.13: After removing from the oven, sprinkle the bread with water and cover it with a clean towel.

fah-298.title: Light and Delicious Turkish Bread
fah-298.culturalNotes: Serve the bread with cheese and a cup of tea for a delicious breakfast. Homemade bread has a completely different taste and aroma compared to store-bought versions.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder, yeast, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg white, warm milk, and warm water. Knead the ingredients for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the oil and knead for an additional 5 minutes until the dough becomes soft and elastic.
instructions.4: Place the dough in an oiled bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and a clean towel. Let it rise until doubled in size.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into 4 equal-sized balls and place them on an oiled baking tray, leaving space between them.
instructions.6: Cover the balls and let them rest.
instructions.7: Mix the egg yolk with 1 large spoon of yogurt and brush this mixture onto the tops of the loaves.
instructions.8: Sprinkle poppy seeds or sesame seeds on top as desired.
instructions.9: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature. Place the loaves on the bottom rack and bake until cooked through.
instructions.10: Leave the loaves in the oven until they turn golden brown.

fah-299.title: Arabic Bread
fah-299.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough rises well in a warm place. You can use the oven or a skillet for baking, depending on your preference.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the powdered milk, butter, and yogurt, and knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Use a mixer to combine the ingredients for at least 10 minutes until the dough is smooth and doesn't stick to your hands.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until puffed.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls, about the size of an egg.
instructions.6: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each ball in flour until it reaches a thickness of 3–4 mm.
instructions.8: Arrange the loaves on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.9: Bake the loaves in the oven for 30 seconds on each side over medium heat.
instructions.10: If using a skillet, cook each loaf for 30 seconds on each side.
instructions.11: Bake the loaves in the oven for 10 minutes until golden brown.

fah-300.title: Baladi Bread Without Yeast
fah-300.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is firm and thin when rolled out. You can store the Baladi bread in a tightly sealed plastic bag for a few days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and yogurt, then knead the ingredients together with warm water until the dough is well combined.
instructions.3: Knead the dough thoroughly until it becomes firm and smooth.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into equal-sized small balls.
instructions.5: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a floured surface until very thin.
instructions.7: Heat a skillet over high heat and place the bread flat on it.
instructions.8: Cook the bread until it puffs and turns slightly brown, then flip and cook the other side.
instructions.9: Cover the bread after cooking to keep it soft and warm.

fah-301.title: Fino bread with potatoes
fah-301.culturalNotes: You can use Fino bread to make sandwiches for breakfast or lunch. Store the bread in a sealed plastic bag for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the mashed potatoes, warm milk or water, and egg white. Knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: If the dough needs more moisture, add warm water, one tablespoon at a time, until smooth.
instructions.4: Let the dough knead for 5 minutes, then add the oil and knead for an additional 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled in size.
