instructions.7: Place the mixture on the stove and continue stirring until it thickens.
instructions.8: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, and vinegar to the thickened mixture and stir well.
instructions.9: Add 1/2 cup of oil to the mixture and stir thoroughly.
instructions.10: Let the tahini cool, then transfer it to a bowl.
instructions.11: Take the risen dough and roll it out on a baking tray or griddle.
instructions.12: Shape the dough into rounds and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.13: Roll out the dough thoroughly until it becomes translucent.
instructions.14: Bake the dough on a hot griddle until puffed and golden brown.
instructions.15: Place the hot bread in a clean cloth to keep it soft and fluffy.
instructions.16: Prepare the filling: Cut the potatoes, pickled cucumber, and jalapeño peppers.
instructions.17: Take the bread and spread the tahini on it, then add the potatoes, pickled cucumber, jalapeño peppers, and cheese.
instructions.19: Place the sandwich on a hot griddle and add a little oil.
instructions.20: Flip the sandwich until both sides are golden brown.

fah-371.title: Samin Sandwich
fah-371.culturalNotes: You can adjust the quantities to taste. You can also add more spices according to preference. Samin can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Wash the tripe and liver thoroughly, then soak them in vinegar water for a short while. Rinse and drain them.
instructions.2: Place the tripe and liver in boiling water with garlic, carrots, onions, tomatoes, laurel leaves, cinnamon, cumin, sugar, salt, and black pepper. Cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes to one hour.
instructions.3: Boil the head meat and its offal, then drain and cut into small pieces.
instructions.4: Prepare the kofta using half a kilogram of ground meat, salt, and pepper. Shape into small balls and refrigerate.
instructions.5: Slice the heart, kidneys, and liver thinly.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the tripe until cooked through, then remove from the pan.
instructions.7: Add the heart and kidneys, and sauté until browned. Remove and set aside.
instructions.8: Add the onions and sauté briefly, then set aside.
instructions.9: Add the liver and garlic, and sauté until the liver is cooked through. Remove and set aside.
instructions.10: Add the kofta and sauté until browned. Remove and set aside.
instructions.11: Return all ingredients to the pan. Add the hot and mild peppers, salt, black pepper, cumin, and cilantro. Mix well over heat until flavors are well blended.
instructions.12: Prepare a serving dish and line it with cress. Arrange all cooked ingredients on top.
instructions.13: Serve the samin with hot baladi bread, pickles, and flour sauce. You can also add the pre-made dukha made from salt, cumin, cilantro, pepper, and chili.
instructions.14: Serve the samin hot and enjoy the delicious flavor.

fah-372.title: Sausage Sandwich
fah-372.culturalNotes: You can use homemade or store-bought sausages. You can also add French fries or caprese for garnish.

instructions.1: Mix sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add dried milk, oil, warm water, and egg whites; mix well.
instructions.3: Add sifted flour, baking powder, and vinegar; mix until dough is well combined.
instructions.4: Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
instructions.5: Add melted butter and knead for 2 more minutes.
instructions.6: Cover dough and let rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Divide dough into small pieces; weigh each piece between 25 to 30 grams.
instructions.8: Shape each piece into a ball and place in an oiled baking tray.
instructions.9: Cover and let rise for another 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush bread with beaten egg mixed with milk and vanilla.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at high temperature for 15–20 minutes.
instructions.12: Prepare filling: chop bell peppers, onion, and sausage; sauté together.
instructions.13: Add ketchup and hot sauce; mix well.
instructions.14: Fill bread with the mixture and serve hot.

fah-373.title: Grilled Chicken Sandwich
fah-373.culturalNotes: You can use potatoes only if you don't want to add chicken. You can also serve the sandwich with tahini sauce for an extra flavor.

instructions.1: Mix grilling spices, salt, lemon juice, vinegar, yogurt, barbecue sauce, hot sauce, and honey in a bowl.
instructions.2: Cut the chicken into small cubes and place in a marinating bowl. Mix well and let sit for a few minutes.
instructions.3: Cut the potatoes into small cubes and place in a bowl. Add salt and mix well.
instructions.4: Fry the potatoes in a pan with a little oil until golden brown.
instructions.5: Grill the chicken in a hot pan or in the oven until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Mix onion, salt, lemon juice, ketchup, hot sauce, parsley, and cilantro in a bowl.
instructions.7: Place the fried potatoes in a colander to drain excess oil.
instructions.8: Place the grilled chicken, fried potatoes, and the sauce mixture into a serving dish.
instructions.9: Fill the pita bread with grilled chicken, potatoes, and the sauce mixture. Sprinkle with a little parsley on top.
instructions.10: Close the sandwich on both sides and roll it up.
instructions.11: Fry the sandwich in a sandwich maker or on a griddle until golden and crispy.

fah-374.title: Waffle Toast Sandwich
fah-374.culturalNotes: You can use any type of cheese or meat you prefer. You can also add vegetables like tomatoes or parsley for a more varied flavor.

instructions.1: Preheat the waffle maker and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.2: Place one slice of toast into the waffle maker.
instructions.3: Spread cream cheese on the sandwich.
instructions.4: Add any other ingredients such as Romano cheese, cheddar, or turkey pastrami, to taste.
instructions.5: Place another slice of toast on top of the ingredients.
instructions.6: Spread cream cheese on the top side of the toast.
instructions.7: Close the waffle maker and cook until the sandwich is golden brown.
instructions.8: Remove the sandwich from the machine and serve hot with your favorite drink.

fah-375.title: Smoked Chicken Sandwich
fah-375.culturalNotes: Sandwiches can be frozen and used as needed. Serve warm or cold according to preference.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into thin slices.
instructions.2: Sprinkle the chicken with salt, paprika, chicken seasoning, black pepper, oregano, garlic powder, and onion powder.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of olive oil and a quarter cup of barbecue sauce, and mix the chicken well.
instructions.4: Let the chicken marinate for 10 minutes to absorb the flavors.
instructions.5: Bake the chicken in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.6: Prepare the sauce by mixing 1 cup of mayonnaise, a quarter cup of barbecue sauce, a quarter cup of hot sauce, and 1 tablespoon of white honey.
instructions.7: Mix the sauce thoroughly until smooth and well combined.
instructions.8: Cut the small Syrian bread in half.
instructions.9: Spread a spoonful of sauce onto each bread half.
instructions.10: Add slices of smoked chicken, roasted potatoes, and pickled cucumber.
instructions.11: Carefully roll the sandwich.
instructions.12: Bake the sandwich in the oven for 5 minutes until golden brown.

fah-376.title: Mini Burgers Sandwiches
fah-376.culturalNotes: Different types of cheese and vegetables can be used according to preference. The burger can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days before use.

fah-376-i9.name: Bread dough
fah-376-i9.standardAmount: 4 cups flour, a quarter cup yeast, a large spoonful sugar, half a small spoonful salt, a cup of warm milk, a cup of yogurt

instructions.1: Mix the ground beef with breadcrumbs, sugar, salt, and pepper thoroughly.
instructions.2: Shape the mixture into small balls and flatten them into patties.
instructions.3: Grill the patties on the barbecue until cooked through on both sides.
instructions.4: Prepare the dough using flour, yeast, sugar, salt, milk, and yogurt; let it rise.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small balls and roll them out.
instructions.6: Fill the dough with cheese, pickled cucumber, and burger patty, then seal it.
instructions.7: Grill the sandwiches on the barbecue until the bread is cooked through and golden brown.

fah-377.title: Syrian Potato Sandwiches with Tahini
fah-377.culturalNotes: Tahini can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Serve the sandwiches with a light salad or tomato slices.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and wash them thoroughly.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into long, thin slices.
instructions.3: Add a pinch of salt to the potatoes and mix well.
instructions.4: Fry the potatoes in hot oil until crispy and golden brown.
instructions.5: In a bowl, mix 1 cup of water with 3 tablespoons of crushed cornstarch and 6 cloves of garlic.
instructions.6: Stir the mixture until the cornstarch turns translucent.
instructions.7: Add 1 cup of yogurt, 1 teaspoon of sugar, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 1/4 cup of oil.
instructions.8: Blend all ingredients in a blender until you achieve a smooth tahini consistency.
instructions.9: Drain the fried potatoes and let them cool slightly.
instructions.10: Take pita bread and spread 1 tablespoon of tahini on each piece.
instructions.11: Add the fried potatoes, pickled cucumber, and ketchup.
instructions.12: Add cheese if available.
instructions.13: Wrap the sandwiches tightly and brush with oil.
instructions.14: Fry the sandwiches in a griddle or frying pan until golden and crispy.
instructions.15: Let the sandwiches cool slightly, then cut and serve warm.

fah-378.title: Cheese, Pepper, and Turkish Sausage Sandwiches
fah-378.culturalNotes: You can add minced meat or any other filling of your choice. This recipe works well for breakfast, lunch, or even as a midnight snack.

instructions.1: Mix flour, water, vinegar, baking powder, sugar, salt, and oil in a bowl until the dough is smooth and even.
instructions.2: Chop the cottage cheese, pepper, Turkish sausage, and olives, then mix them together.
instructions.3: Heat the griddle over medium heat and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.4: Take a spoonful of dough and place it on the griddle; cook until golden brown.
instructions.5: Flip the dough to the other side and cook until golden brown as well.
instructions.6: Place the filling on half of the dough and fold it in half.
instructions.7: Brush the sandwich with oil or ghee and cook until the other side turns golden.
instructions.8: Flip the sandwich until it develops a beautiful color and the cheese is fully melted.

fah-379.title: Shawarma and Beef Kofta Sandwiches with Cheese
fah-379.culturalNotes: Make sure not to leave the toast slices in the milk for too long, or they may become overly wet. You can serve the sandwiches with a light salad or fried potatoes.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to high temperature.
instructions.2: Brush the baking tray with olive oil.
instructions.3: Dip the toast slices into the yogurt.
instructions.4: Place a slice of cheese on each yogurt-dipped toast slice.
instructions.5: Add a slice of shawarma and a slice of beef kofta on top of the cheese.
instructions.6: Arrange the sandwiches on the tray.
instructions.7: Sprinkle instant broth over the sandwiches to taste.
instructions.8: Place the tray in the oven and bake until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve the sandwiches hot.

fah-380.title: Ten-Minute Sandwiches Without Yeast or Oven
fah-380.culturalNotes: You can change the fillings as desired, such as salami, green pepper, grated cheese, olives, and mint. The sandwiches can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and vinegar and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add warm water until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 2-3 minutes.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into balls the size of large lemons.
instructions.6: Roll out each ball and place the filling in the center.
instructions.7: Seal the sandwiches tightly and shape them.
instructions.8: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Fry the sandwiches until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.10: Serve hot.

fah-381.title: Stuffed Fatayer Sandwiches
fah-381.culturalNotes: Sandwiches can be stored in the refrigerator and reheated before serving. Any leftover ingredients from the fridge can be used as fillings.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the warm water and knead until you get a soft and smooth dough.
instructions.3: Cover the dough with a clean cloth and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into small balls the size of an egg.
instructions.5: Roll each ball using a little flour until it becomes thin.
instructions.6: Add your favorite fillings (cheese, pastirma, pepper, olives, parsley, dried figs, minced meat, boiled chicken, eggs) in the center of the dough.
instructions.7: Seal the edges well and shape them into sandwiches.
instructions.8: Heat a pan on medium-low heat and add two drops of oil.
instructions.9: Place the sandwiches in the pan and fry them until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.10: Serve hot with milk tea or mint tea.

fah-382.title: Crispy School Sandwiches
fah-382.culturalNotes: Sandwiches can be frozen after cooling and stored in bags. Remove the desired amount one day before use to return to room temperature.

instructions.1: Mix the dry ingredients (flour, powdered milk, sugar, yeast, salt, baking powder) in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water, sugar, salt, and baking powder, and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the butter or oil and mix until fully combined.
instructions.4: Add the yogurt, or thick yogurt, or regular milk with vinegar, and knead into a dough.
instructions.5: Gradually add water until the dough forms and knead for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
instructions.7: Shape the dough into small balls, about the size of a large lemon, and cover for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll out each ball and fill with your favorite fillings (mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, pastirma).
instructions.9: Seal the sandwiches tightly.
instructions.10: Brush the sandwiches with a mixture of flour, pomegranate molasses, and water.
instructions.11: Sprinkle the sandwiches with toasted sesame seeds.
instructions.12: Arrange the sandwiches on an oiled baking tray or one lined with parchment paper, leaving space between them.
instructions.13: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.14: Let the sandwiches cool before freezing.

fah-383.title: Restaurant-Style Sandwiches at Home
fah-383.culturalNotes: Make sure to chill the potatoes and coleslaw in the refrigerator before serving to keep them crispy. You can add cheese sauce if desired.

instructions.1: Mix 4 cups of flour with black pepper, smoked paprika, instant broth, chicken seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder, ginger, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Whisk half of the seasoned flour with eggs, ricotta or regular yogurt, baking powder, and honey until the consistency resembles pancake batter.
instructions.3: Wash the chicken breasts and pat them dry. Cut them into thick pieces, season with the dry mixture, and refrigerate.
instructions.4: In a bowl, combine yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, chopped parsley, onion powder, garlic powder, ginger, and black pepper. Add mustard and mix well.
instructions.5: Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly. Place in a deep bowl and add vinegar, salt, and boiling water. Let them soak until cooled.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the potatoes until golden and crispy.
instructions.7: Slice the cabbage thinly and place in a bowl. Add grated carrots, mayonnaise, yogurt, honey, vinegar, orange juice, and salt. Mix well.
instructions.8: Dip the seasoned chicken in the wet batter, then coat in the dry mixture. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve the sandwiches with coleslaw, crispy chicken, crispy potatoes, ranch sauce, habanero peppers, and tomatoes.

fah-384.title: Golden Nuggets Sandwiches
fah-384.culturalNotes: The nuggets can be stored in the freezer for up to one month. Serve the sandwiches with fried potatoes or chips.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts and wings into small pieces.
instructions.2: Mix the salt, spiced paprika, black pepper, red pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder with the chopped chicken.
instructions.3: Pound the chicken mixture thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add the flour, ready-made breadcrumbs, and dried breadcrumbs to the ground chicken and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the water quickly and mix until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.6: Coat the chicken with the mixture and mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Place the nuggets in a freezer bag and coat them with a layer of dried breadcrumbs.
instructions.8: Store the nuggets in the freezer.
instructions.9: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.10: Fry the nuggets until golden brown.
instructions.11: Prepare the sauce by mixing the mayonnaise, ketchup, and honey.
instructions.12: Place a small amount of sauce on lettuce and tomato slices.
instructions.13: Add the nuggets to the sandwiches and serve hot.

fah-385.title: Potato and Cheese Sandwiches
fah-385.culturalNotes: You can add basterma to the filling as desired. These sandwiches can be stored in a lunchbox and served cold or warm.

instructions.1: Add 2.5 cups of water to a pot and bring to a boil.
instructions.2: Add 1 tablespoon of oil and 1/2 teaspoon of salt, then stir well.
instructions.3: Add 1.5 cups of sifted flour and mix until the dough fully absorbs the water.
instructions.4: Let the dough rest for a few minutes, then knead it with your hands until smooth.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small balls about the size of a lemon, ensuring all balls are evenly sized.
instructions.6: Mash the boiled potatoes and chop them into small pieces. Add the grated cheese, seasonings (salt, paprika, black pepper, chili, cumin), and parsley. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Take one dough ball and roll it in flour, then fill it with the potato-cheese mixture and seal tightly.
instructions.8: Repeat the previous step until all balls are filled.
instructions.9: Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the sandwiches on both sides until golden brown.
instructions.10: Let the sandwiches cool slightly before serving.

fah-386.title: Cheese and Romano Rolls with Fatayer
fah-386.culturalNotes: You can add any other fillings you prefer, such as sweet peppers or parsley. The sandwiches can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days, or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in the mixer bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, vinegar, and oil, and mix the dry ingredients together.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm milk until you get a soft dough.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, and let it rise in a warm place until it doubles in size.
instructions.6: After rising, roll out the dough into a rectangle.
instructions.7: Spread the cream cheese over the dough, then add slices of cheddar and smoked Romano cheese.
instructions.8: Tightly roll up the dough, then cut it into equal pieces.
instructions.9: Place the pieces in an oiled baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.10: Prepare the Nescafe mixture with sugar, milk powder, and water, and brush the sandwiches with it.
instructions.11: Sprinkle sesame and poppy seeds over the sandwiches.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve the sandwiches warm with a cup of tea or any drink you like.

fah-387.title: Quick Sandwiches for the Club, Beach, and School
fah-387.culturalNotes: You can use any filling you prefer, such as cheese, basturma, cooked chicken, olives, and parsley. These sandwiches can be frozen after cooling and served as needed.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, vinegar, oil, and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Add the egg and stir again.
instructions.4: Gradually add the warm milk and knead the dough until soft and not sticky.
instructions.5: Knead the dough for 7–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30–60 minutes until doubled in size.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into small balls and roll each into the desired thickness.
instructions.8: Add the filling to the center of each sandwich and seal tightly.
instructions.9: Place the sandwiches on an oiled baking tray, making sure the seam is facing down.
instructions.10: Let the sandwiches rise again for 10–15 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush the sandwiches with a mixture of powdered milk, Nescafé, sugar, and water.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove the sandwiches from the oven and let them cool before serving.

fah-388.title: Stuffed Sandwiches Without Oven
fah-388.culturalNotes: The stuffed sandwiches can be frozen in freezer bags and used later. The fillings can also be used in other recipes such as pizza and pancakes.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with baking powder, yeast, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the warm water and mix until the dough becomes firm.
instructions.3: Add the oil after half the kneading time and knead thoroughly for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls (about 20 balls).
instructions.6: Roll each ball flat, stuff with your preferred filling, then seal tightly.
instructions.7: Let the sandwiches rest briefly, then roll them out again.
instructions.8: Heat a pan over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.9: Fry the sandwiches until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.10: Cover the sandwiches while frying for better results.

fah-389.title: Molto Sandwiches
fah-389.culturalNotes: You can avoid using sesame if you don't like it. These sandwiches are perfect for trips and summer outings since they don't require an oven.

instructions.1: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 1/2 cup milk and 1/2 cup warm water, then stir ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add water until the dough comes together evenly.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Add 1/4 cup oil and mix well, then knead for an additional 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place.
instructions.7: Prepare the filling by mixing bramley cheese, mozzarella cheese, sweet pepper, and olives.
instructions.8: When the dough has risen, roll it out on a floured surface.
instructions.9: Take small portions of dough and shape them into balls.
instructions.10: Roll each ball flat, fill with the mixture, then seal tightly.
instructions.11: Shape the sandwiches into long forms.
instructions.12: Let the sandwiches rise again.
instructions.13: Heat oil in a pan over high heat.
instructions.14: Dip the sandwiches in yogurt, then in sesame.
instructions.15: Fry the sandwiches until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.16: Drain the sandwiches on paper towels.

fah-390.title: School Sandwich
fah-390.culturalNotes: You can use any filling you prefer based on what's available in your fridge. You may garnish the sandwiches with sesame seeds, flax seeds, or poppy seeds as desired. The sandwiches can be stored in a sealed plastic bag in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix warm water, oil, warm yogurt, sugar, salt, and egg white in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add yeast and stir ingredients thoroughly until sugar dissolves.
instructions.3: Let the mixture rest for 10 minutes until foam appears on the surface.
instructions.4: Gradually add flour and knead until you get a soft dough.
instructions.5: Let the dough rest for at least 7 minutes.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into 15 small balls.
instructions.7: Cover the balls with plastic wrap to prevent drying.
instructions.8: Fill each ball with your preferred filling (cheese, olives, pepper, poppy seeds, thyme, parsley).
instructions.9: Roll out the dough and seal the edges well.
instructions.10: Let the sandwiches rise again.
instructions.11: Brush the sandwiches with a mixture of egg yolk, yogurt, sugar, and Nescafe.
instructions.12: Bake the sandwiches in a preheated oven at 200 degrees for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Alternatively, fry the sandwiches in a pan over low heat, covering the pan until cooked evenly on all sides.

fah-391.title: Eastern Sausage Sandwiches
fah-391.culturalNotes: The sausage can be served with boiled pasta, green beans, white rice, roasted potatoes, and salad. The sausage sauce can also be used as a side dipping sauce.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped garlic and sauté until fragrant.
instructions.3: Add the sausage and stir with the garlic until the color changes.
instructions.4: Add sliced onions and stir until softened.
instructions.5: Add the peppers and tomatoes and mix well with the sausage and onions.
instructions.6: Add the ketchup, seven-spice mix, black pepper, and salt. Stir to combine.
instructions.7: Add a pinch of sugar to taste.
instructions.8: Mix all ingredients together, cover the pan, and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Stir in the pomegranate molasses.
instructions.10: Turn off the heat and let the mixture cool slightly.
instructions.11: Serve the sausage in sandwiches with Egyptian flatbread (baladi) or French bread (fino), as desired.

fah-392.title: Eggplant Strips
fah-392.culturalNotes: Serve the strips with ketchup or mayonnaise and caprese tomatoes. They can also be used in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Peel the eggplant and cut it into thick, long strips.
instructions.2: Place the cut eggplant in a deep bowl, season with salt and Knorr 11 Spice Mix, then toss well.
instructions.3: Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, baking powder, and Knorr 11 Spice Mix in a bowl.
instructions.4: Divide the mixture in half; leave the first half as is, and gradually add water to the second half until it reaches a medium consistency similar to pancake batter.
instructions.5: Dip the eggplant pieces into the dry mixture, then into the wet mixture, and shake them in your hands to give them a crinkly shape.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the eggplant pieces until golden brown.
instructions.7: Drain the strips from excess oil using a colander.

fah-393.title: Street Sausage
fah-393.culturalNotes: You can sprinkle some chopped parsley on top for garnish and extra flavor. You can also serve the sausage with fried potatoes or a light salad.

instructions.1: Chop the pepper and onion into small pieces.
instructions.2: Cut the sausage into small pieces.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the sausage and stir until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the onion and pepper and stir for 2-3 minutes until golden.
instructions.6: Add the minced garlic and tomatoes and mix well.
instructions.7: Add salt and hot pepper and stir well.
instructions.8: Simmer the mixture on low heat for 5-7 minutes until ready.
instructions.9: Serve the sausage with tahini sauce in sandwiches.

fah-394.title: Smasa Burger
fah-394.culturalNotes: You can adjust the size of the patties according to the size of the bread. You can also add other ingredients such as sweet peppers or parsley as desired.

instructions.1: Mix the ground beef with the fat and Knorr burger mix.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Shape the meat into equal-sized balls (about 50 grams each).
instructions.4: Place the balls in the refrigerator to rest.
instructions.5: In a pan over heat, add two tablespoons of butter.
instructions.6: Add the chopped onion and sauté until caramelized.
instructions.7: Add the sugar, salt, and black pepper, and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the sliced mushrooms and stir until cooked through.
instructions.9: Add the soy sauce and stir well.
instructions.10: In a bowl, mix the ketchup, mayonnaise, and mustard.
instructions.11: In a pan over heat, add a piece of butter.
instructions.12: Add a meat ball and press firmly to flatten into a patty.
instructions.13: Cook until browned on both sides, then place a slice of cheese on top.
instructions.14: Toast the kaiser bread in the pan.
instructions.15: Spread the sauce on the bread, then add the tomato, caramelized onion with mushrooms, and the burger with cheese.
instructions.16: You can add the habanero and pickled cucumber as desired.

fah-395.title: Crispy Potato Snacks
fah-395.culturalNotes: You can use red potatoes for the best browning results. You can also experiment with adding different flavors to the spices according to preference.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into thin slices.
instructions.2: Add the cold water, vinegar, baking powder, and salt to a bowl and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Soak the potatoes in the solution for half an hour.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.5: Add the potatoes to the oil one piece at a time to prevent sticking.
instructions.6: Fry the potatoes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and crispy.
instructions.7: Drain the potatoes on paper towels to absorb excess oil.
instructions.8: Mix the spices together in a bowl and store in an airtight container.
instructions.9: Repeat steps 1-7 to make both thin-cut and spiral-cut potatoes.
instructions.10: Serve the snacks with a side of mayonnaise and ketchup sauce.

fah-396.title: Waffle and Pancake Sandwiches
fah-396.culturalNotes: Serve the sandwiches with fresh fruits and vegetables for a balanced meal. You can store the sandwiches in a lunchbox and serve them cold.

instructions.1: Prepare the pancake: Lightly grease the sandwich maker with oil and pour in the pancake mix.
instructions.2: Close the lid and cook for 2–3 minutes until golden and fully set.
instructions.3: Remove the pancake and serve with fresh fruit, honey, or powdered sugar.
instructions.4: Prepare the sandwiches: Lightly grease the sandwich maker and add the pancake mix.
instructions.5: Layer in tomato, olives, Turkish sausage, and cheese.
instructions.6: Close the lid and cook for 2–3 minutes until golden and heated through.
instructions.7: Prepare the sandwich bread: Spread labneh on the bread and add your favorite filling.
instructions.8: Fold the sandwich in half and cut it in half diagonally.
instructions.9: Place a stick on the sandwich and stuff it with the filling.
instructions.10: Prepare the hash brown: Boil water and cook grated potatoes for 3 minutes.
instructions.11: Drain and thoroughly dry the potatoes.
instructions.12: Add spices, cornstarch, and eggs; mix well.
instructions.13: Place the potato mixture into the sandwich maker and cook until golden and crispy.

fah-397.title: Kofta Burger Sandwiches with Secret Sauce and Soft Bread
fah-397.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is firm and doesn't crack during kneading. You can freeze leftover bread for later use.

instructions.1: Prepare burger bread:
instructions.2: Mix flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add egg whites, vinegar, and yogurt, and mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.4: Gradually add warm water and knead the dough for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Add butter and oil mixture and knead for an additional 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover it, and let it rise for 1 hour.
instructions.7: Prepare kofta burger:
instructions.8: Chop onion, red pepper, green pepper, and garlic, then blend until smooth.
instructions.9: Add burger seasoning mix, salt, black pepper, and ground beef, and mix well.
instructions.10: Shape into patties and grill on a baking tray over medium heat until cooked through.
instructions.11: Prepare caramelized onion:
instructions.12: Fry onion in oil until golden brown.
instructions.13: Add sugar, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir until onion is soft.
instructions.14: Shape the bread:
instructions.15: Divide the dough into balls the size of a large lemon.
instructions.16: Grease the griddle with oil and roll each ball with softened butter into an oval shape.
instructions.17: Bake the buns in the oven at high heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.19: Place sauce, special vegetables, kofta burger, caramelized onion, tomato, and cheese between two pieces of bread.

fah-398.title: Delicious and Crispy Sandwiches with Various Fillings
fah-398.culturalNotes: You can use any fillings you prefer, such as minced meat, pizza, or your favorite vegetables. You can also store the sandwiches in the refrigerator for up to two days or freeze them for longer storage.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water and dry yogurt or yogurt, and knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise until it doubles in size.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls and cover them.
instructions.6: Roll each dough ball on a floured surface until it becomes round and medium-thick.
instructions.7: Brush the dough surface with butter and fold it in half.
instructions.8: Cover the dough again and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush the sandwiches with egg or cream and sprinkle with breadcrumbs if desired.
instructions.10: Fry the sandwiches in hot oil or bake them in a preheated oven at high heat until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let the sandwiches cool slightly, then serve with your favorite fillings.

fah-399.title: Fake Dough Sandwiches
fah-399.culturalNotes: You can use any fillings you prefer, such as cooked meat or chopped vegetables. The dough can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days and used as needed.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in warm water and let it sit aside for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: In a bowl, combine the flour, dried milk powder, baking powder, and salt.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, and the previously prepared mixture (yeast, sugar, and water) to the flour and knead until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes or until it doubles in size.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into two parts; divide the first part into small pieces for making sandwiches, and use the second part to make large pizzas.
instructions.6: Roll out the dough into thin circles and place your preferred fillings (cheese, chicken, pepper, tomato, olives) on them.
instructions.7: Seal the sandwiches well and place them on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.8: Brush the sandwiches with a mixture of yogurt, sugar, and salt, and sprinkle with nigella and sesame seeds.
instructions.9: Bake the sandwiches in a preheated oven at high heat (about 200 degrees Celsius) for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

fah-400.title: Hurry-Up Pan (Kofta with Vegetables)
fah-400.culturalNotes: You can add charcoal for a grilled flavor by placing charcoal in a small dish and covering the pan with it for 10 minutes before serving.

instructions.1: Mix the ground beef with finely chopped onion, salt, pepper, seven-spice mix, and garlic.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture thoroughly until the meat textures are well combined.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers according to preference.
instructions.4: Toss the sliced onion with salt, pepper, and cumin.
instructions.5: Place the onion in the baking pan, then add the carrots, potatoes, and bell peppers, and mix well.
instructions.6: Arrange the kofta on top of the vegetables.
instructions.7: Add the tomato sauce and boiling water, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Reduce the heat to 180°C and continue cooking until the kofta and vegetables are fully cooked.
instructions.10: Serve with white rice and salad.

fah-401.title: Chicken and Vegetable Casserole with Baladi Rice and Doura
fah-401.culturalNotes: Serve the casserole and rice with pickles and olives for a complete meal. You can also extend the cooking time for a more tender dish.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes.
instructions.2: Slice the bell pepper, hot pepper, and tomatoes thinly.
instructions.3: Slice the garlic and red pepper.
instructions.4: Cut the onion into rings.
instructions.5: Add the seasonings (potato seasoning from Knorr, salt, cumin) to the onion and garlic and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the onion, garlic, and seasoning mixture to the vegetables and stir well.
instructions.7: Wash the chicken, rinse it, and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.8: Add the chicken to the vegetable mixture and stir well.
instructions.9: Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish, add 3 tablespoons of oil and red pepper, then pour in 1 cup of hot water and 2 tablespoons of Knorr sauce. Mix well.
instructions.10: Place the casserole in the oven and bake at high heat until fully cooked.
instructions.11: Fry the vermicelli in 2 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon of ghee until golden brown.
instructions.12: Rinse the rice and drain it, then add it to the fried vermicelli and mix well.
instructions.13: Add salt and Knorr stock to the rice and mix well.
instructions.14: Add 4 cups of boiling water to the rice and mix well.
instructions.15: Cover the rice and cook over high heat until done, then cover and reduce heat to low.
instructions.16: Blend the doura juice, sugar, ground doura, milk, water, ice, and nuts together in a blender until smooth.
instructions.17: Strain the juice and serve cold.
instructions.18: Serve the casserole and rice hot with the juice.

fah-402.title: Happiness Sauce
fah-402.culturalNotes: You can use any chicken pieces you prefer. Make sure to marinate the chicken well for a distinctive flavor. The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix smoked paprika, onion powder, instant stock, black pepper, garlic powder, chopped garlic, ketchup, lemon juice, vinegar, white honey, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.3: Wash the chicken pieces and open them with a sharp knife.
instructions.4: Coat the chicken pieces evenly with the marinade, especially on the inside.
instructions.5: Place the chicken in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours to firm up.
instructions.6: Preheat the oven to high heat.
instructions.7: Place the chicken on a rack in a baking tray, and pour 2 cups of boiling water into the bottom of the tray.
instructions.8: Put the tray in the oven and bake until fully cooked.
instructions.9: In another pan, melt the butter and sauté the chopped garlic until golden brown.
instructions.10: Add white honey, ketchup, and chopped parsley. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.11: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.12: Pour the sauce over the roasted chicken.
instructions.13: Serve hot with fragrant rice or pasta with sauce, along with a salad and pickles.

fah-403.title: Sausage, Potato, and Mozzarella Bake
fah-403.culturalNotes: This dish can be served with pasta, bread, salad, and pickles. It can also be eaten straight from the baking dish with a spoon.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and wash them, then cut into evenly sized cubes.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the potatoes and stir with a pinch of salt.
instructions.3: Fry the potatoes until golden and crispy.
instructions.4: Slice the onion and bell peppers thinly.
instructions.5: Cut the sausage into medium-sized cubes.
instructions.6: Heat a little oil in another pan over high heat, then add the sausage and stir until golden brown.
instructions.7: Add the onion, bell peppers, and minced garlic to the sausage, and stir together.
instructions.8: Add salt, black pepper, and parsley, and stir well until the aromas are well combined.
instructions.9: Add the barbecue sauce and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.10: Place the fried potatoes into a baking dish, then pour the fried sausage on top.
instructions.11: Mix yogurt, flour, salt, and black pepper in a blender until smooth.
instructions.12: Pour the yogurt mixture over the potatoes and sausage in the baking dish.
instructions.13: Sprinkle mozzarella cheese and cheese blend on top.
instructions.14: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 20–30 minutes, until the cheese is melted and golden brown.

fah-404.title: Alexandrian Sausage and Potato Bake
fah-404.culturalNotes: Make sure the tomatoes are well reduced before adding the potatoes to prevent them from becoming watery. You can serve the dish with rice for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Cut the sausage into medium-sized pieces.
instructions.2: Heat a pan on the stove and add one tablespoon of oil.
instructions.3: Add the sausage and fry until browned and lightly colored.
instructions.4: Add the sliced onion and stir with the sausage.
instructions.5: Add cumin, black pepper, dried parsley, and salt. Mix well.
instructions.6: Add the minced garlic and sieved tomatoes. If the tomato color is not strong enough, add two tablespoons of tomato paste.
instructions.7: Let the mixture simmer, stirring occasionally.
instructions.8: Add the boiling water and stock cube. Let it boil.
instructions.9: Cut the potatoes into medium-sized rings and add them to the mixture.
instructions.10: Let the potatoes absorb the flavor until fully cooked.
instructions.11: Serve the dish in a serving dish. You can serve it with rice.

fah-405.title: Breakfast Omelette Bake
fah-405.culturalNotes: You can add any other ingredients you like, such as mushrooms or spinach. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs and yogurt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the flour, salt, black pepper, paprika, and baking powder. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the bell peppers, onion, parsley, and finely chopped tomatoes. Mix everything together.
instructions.4: Add the feta cheese and stir to combine.
instructions.5: Add a quarter cup of oil and mix the batter well.
instructions.6: Grease the baking dish with ghee and sprinkle a little flour.
instructions.7: Pour the mixture into the baking dish.
instructions.8: Place the salamy and cheese on top of the mixture.
instructions.9: Sprinkle a pinch of thyme on top.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.11: Bake until golden brown.
instructions.12: Cut into pieces and serve hot with a cup of mint tea.

fah-406.title: Potato and Sausage Casserole
fah-406.culturalNotes: Serve the casserole with flatbread and pickles for a delicious and complete meal.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into finger-shaped pieces.
instructions.2: Slice the onion into thin rings.
instructions.3: Chop the bell pepper and hot pepper.
instructions.4: Mash 6 cloves of garlic with a little salt.
instructions.5: Place the potatoes in the casserole dish.
instructions.6: Add the onion and bell pepper, and mix together.
instructions.7: Add salt, black pepper, cumin, parsley, and half of the mashed garlic.
instructions.8: Stir the ingredients until the onion softens and turns translucent.
instructions.9: Place the mixture on top of the potatoes in the casserole.
instructions.10: Arrange the sausage on top of the potatoes.
instructions.11: Place the hot peppers in the center.
instructions.12: In a pan, heat a little oil and sauté the remaining mashed garlic until golden.
instructions.13: Add the sauce and grated tomatoes, and stir well.
instructions.14: Add a pinch of sugar, the stock cube, and 2 cups of boiling water.
instructions.15: Simmer the mixture until it comes to a boil.
instructions.16: Add a pinch of paprika to give it a red color.
instructions.17: Pour the sauce over the casserole and distribute evenly.
instructions.18: Bake in a preheated oven at high temperature for 30 minutes, until the potatoes and sausage are fully cooked.

fah-407.title: Foul Tagine
fah-407.culturalNotes: This tagine can be served for breakfast or iftar. A clay tagine can be used instead of a baking dish.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, without browning.
instructions.3: Add the chopped hot pepper and bell pepper and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.4: Add the diced tomatoes and mix well.
instructions.5: Add salt and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.6: Add the cooked fava beans and mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Mash the beans slightly with a fork and add a little water to prevent drying.
instructions.8: Stir the mixture and let it simmer for 1 minute.
instructions.9: Transfer the mixture to a baking dish suitable for the oven.
instructions.10: Place the eggs on top of the mixture.
instructions.11: Season the eggs with salt and black pepper.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 10 minutes, until the eggs are set.
instructions.13: Garnish the tagine with red bell pepper and parsley.
instructions.14: Serve hot with Egyptian flatbread (baladi).

fah-408.title: Chicken Pasta Casserole
fah-408.culturalNotes: Serve hot with a green salad or fresh bread. The casserole can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat oil in a pan over high heat and add chicken pieces. Sauté until golden brown, being careful not to stir too much.
instructions.2: Add chicken seasoning and black pepper, and stir well.
instructions.3: Add chopped onion and hot pepper, and sauté for 2–3 minutes until the onion softens.
instructions.4: Remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.5: In another pot, heat oil and add tomato juice, sugar, salt, cumin, cilantro, stock cube, and sauce. Stir well and let it come to a boil.
instructions.6: Add boiling water and let the mixture boil again.
instructions.7: Put oil in a casserole dish and coat all sides evenly.
instructions.8: Place a layer of chicken at the bottom of the casserole, then add the uncooked pasta, followed by the sauce.
instructions.9: Add water until the pasta is fully covered.
instructions.10: Cover the casserole with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.11: After 30 minutes, let the casserole sit covered for an additional 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Flip the casserole onto a serving dish and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.

fah-409.title: Spiced Potatoes Pan
fah-409.culturalNotes: This pan can be served with pita bread or any other type of bread. You may also add other spices to taste, such as chopped parsley or chili.

instructions.1: Place a pot on the stove and add water and salt. Cut the potatoes into medium-sized cubes.
instructions.2: Boil the potatoes in the boiling water and cover the pot. Let them cook for 12 minutes, without overcooking.
instructions.3: Drain the potatoes thoroughly.
instructions.4: In a frying pan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter and sauté 2 cloves of garlic.
instructions.5: Add 1 teaspoon of paprika, a pinch of black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Stir the ingredients well.
instructions.6: Add the potatoes to the pan and stir them thoroughly with the mixture.
instructions.7: Add finely chopped red pepper, finely chopped green onion, and chopped parsley. Mix all ingredients together.
instructions.8: Add the crumbled cheese and cover the pan for 5 minutes, until the cheese melts.
instructions.9: Serve the pan hot, alongside pita bread.

fah-410.title: Egg Omelette with Basterma and Vegetables
fah-410.culturalNotes: You can add small diced pieces of chicken instead of basterma if desired. Serve the omelette with toasted bread or a light salad.

instructions.1: Heat the butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the basterma and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the mushrooms and chopped tomatoes and stir for 1–2 minutes until slightly softened.
instructions.4: Add the eggs and gently stir until the eggs are half-set.
instructions.5: Season with black pepper and salt, and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the cheese, reduce heat, and cover the pan until the cheese melts.
instructions.7: Serve hot.

fah-411.title: Fatah Plate (The Bomb)
fah-411.culturalNotes: Serve the plate hot with taoua bread or Egyptian pita. You can also sprinkle some chopped parsley on top for garnish.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the hot pepper and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.4: Add the fava beans and water, and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the cumin, black pepper, and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: In another pan, fry the potatoes until golden brown.
instructions.7: Add the fava bean mixture to the fried potatoes.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture into a baking pan.
instructions.9: Place the eggs on top of the mixture.
instructions.10: Sprinkle the grated cheese over the eggs.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes, until the cheese is golden brown.

fah-412.title: Economic Breakfast Pan
fah-412.culturalNotes: You can add cheese to taste for extra flavor. You can also serve the pan with pickles for a distinctive taste.

instructions.1: In a pot, bring water to boil with a pinch of salt, then soak the potatoes for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: In a frying pan, heat one tablespoon of oil and slice the onion thinly.
instructions.3: Add the onions to the oil and sauté with a pinch of sugar and salt until golden and caramelized.
instructions.4: Remove the potatoes from the boiling water and transfer them to another frying pan with one tablespoon of oil.
instructions.5: Sauté the potatoes over medium heat until they turn a nice golden color.
instructions.6: Add paprika and salt to the potatoes and mix well.
instructions.7: Combine the caramelized onions with the potatoes and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Add the eggs, a pinch of salt, and black pepper. Gently stir to combine.
instructions.9: If desired, sprinkle some cheese and let it melt while the eggs finish cooking.
instructions.10: Garnish with a sprinkle of parsley or cilantro and crushed chili to taste.
instructions.11: Serve hot with flatbread and pickles.

fah-413.title: Egg Omelette with Cheese
fah-413.culturalNotes: You can use different types of cheese according to preference. You can also add other vegetables such as tomatoes or sweet peppers for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the pepper and sumac to taste, and stir with the onion.
instructions.4: Add the cumin and seasonings (salt, paprika, black pepper, thyme), and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the chopped eggs to the mixture and gently stir.
instructions.6: Reduce the heat and place the cheese on top.
instructions.7: Cover the pan and let it simmer on low heat until the cheese melts.
instructions.8: After five minutes, check that the cheese has melted and the eggs have absorbed the sauce flavor.
instructions.9: Serve hot, garnished with an extra sprinkle of thyme.

fah-414.title: Potato and Egg Omelette
fah-414.culturalNotes: Serve the omelette with flatbread and your favorite drinks. Add cheese to taste.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the cubed potatoes and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.3: Add salt and cook until the potatoes are dry.
instructions.4: Cover the pan and let it cook for 2–3 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
instructions.5: Add the chopped sweet bell pepper and mix with the potatoes.
instructions.6: In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with salt and black pepper.
instructions.7: Pour the beaten eggs over the potatoes and peppers.
instructions.8: Sprinkle the grated cheese on top.
instructions.9: Cover the pan and cook on low heat until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted.
instructions.10: Serve hot, topped with a sprinkle of crushed pepper.

fah-415.title: Frittata with Eggs and Labneh Cheese
fah-415.culturalNotes: You can add crushed chili to taste for a spicy flavor. Serve the frittata hot with bread or fried potatoes.

instructions.1: Heat the pan on the stove.
instructions.2: Add 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil or butter, depending on availability.
instructions.3: Cut the boiled meat into small pieces.
instructions.4: Whisk the eggs in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the eggs to the pan and stir well.
instructions.6: Add salt and cumin, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.7: Cut the labneh cheese into small pieces.
instructions.8: Add the labneh cheese to the eggs and stir together.
instructions.9: Chop the green and red bell peppers to your preference.
instructions.10: Add the chopped green and red bell peppers to the pan and mix with the ingredients.
instructions.11: Add black pepper and crushed chili, and stir everything together.
instructions.12: Cook on low heat until fully set and golden in color.

fah-416.title: How to Make French Fries Like the Shops
fah-416.culturalNotes: Do not fry raw potatoes directly; first parboil them until they turn light golden brown before freezing. Use red potatoes for the best results.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into thick fries.
instructions.2: Parboil the potatoes in oil until they turn light golden brown.
instructions.3: Place the potatoes on paper towels to absorb excess oil.
instructions.4: Put the potatoes in sealed bags and freeze them.
instructions.5: When ready to serve, fry them again in oil until golden brown.

fah-417.title: Saffron Bread
fah-417.culturalNotes: Saffron bread can be served with butter, cheese, or honey. It can be stored in an airtight plastic bag for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, powdered milk, yeast, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sesame oil or vegetable oil and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt or labneh and vinegar, then knead the ingredients until the dough becomes soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls and shape them into flat rounds.
instructions.6: Cover the rounds and let them rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to high heat (about 220 degrees Celsius) for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: Place the rounds on an oiled baking tray and bake for 10–15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.9: After removing the bread from the oven, brush it with a mixture of water and sugar to give it a shiny finish.

fah-418.title: Feta and Egg on Pita Bread
fah-418.culturalNotes: You can add any sliced meats such as pastrami or diced chicken if available. This dish can be served for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

instructions.1: Cut the pita bread into small pieces and set aside.
instructions.2: In a bowl, beat the eggs with milk, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.3: Add the chopped tomatoes and bell pepper to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.4: Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and sauté until soft.
instructions.5: Pour the egg mixture (with tomatoes and bell pepper) into the pan with the onion and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the pita bread pieces to the mixture, then top with grated cheese and oregano.
instructions.7: Cover the pan and cook on low heat until the cheese is melted.

fah-419.title: Fajita with Falafel
fah-419.culturalNotes: Serve hot with a green salad or your choice of side dish. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a pan and brush it over pita bread or tortillas. Cut the bread into cubes and bake in the oven at 220°C for 10 minutes until crispy.
instructions.2: In a pot, heat the oil and butter. Add the onion, laurel leaf, cinnamon stick, and cumin. Add the rice and stir well. Pour in the broth or water and chicken stock. Cover and simmer until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.3: In a bowl, mix tahini, yogurt, dill, cumin, parsley, vinegar, and water until smooth and well blended.
instructions.4: Slice the chicken breasts thinly. Mix with minced garlic, hummus, vinegar, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, chili pepper, oregano, cumin, parsley, black pepper, and salt. Let the chicken marinate for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Slice the onion and bell peppers thinly. Sauté in a pan until golden brown.
instructions.6: In the same pan, cook the marinated chicken until golden brown. Add the sautéed onions and peppers and stir together.
instructions.7: In a large serving dish, layer toasted pita, rice, and the chicken with roasted vegetables. Pour the sauce over the top and garnish with dried parsley.
instructions.8: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a small pan. Add chili or paprika and stir. Pour the mixture over the dish.

fah-420.title: Eid Fatta - Mixed Skillet
fah-420.culturalNotes: Additional ingredients can be added as desired. The skillet can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Cut the sujuk in half and separate the pieces.
instructions.2: Slice the hot and sweet peppers and onion thinly.
instructions.3: Mix the kofta and shape into balls.
instructions.4: Heat oil in a skillet.
instructions.5: Add the heart first and fry until golden brown.
instructions.6: Move the heart to the side of the skillet to finish cooking.
instructions.7: Add the kisra and fry until golden brown.
instructions.8: Add the liver and fry until cooked through.
instructions.9: Add the onion and peppers and stir well.
instructions.10: Add salt, black pepper, and cumin, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.11: Serve the skillet hot with desserts.

fah-421.title: Chicken Fatta
fah-421.culturalNotes: You can use any type of bread available instead of Syrian bread. You can also add some chopped parsley to the fatta sauce for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Heat oil and butter in a pot over medium heat, then add cloves and washed, drained rice. Sauté the rice until it glistens and is well heated.
instructions.2: Add salt and stir rice thoroughly. Add boiling water (1 cup water for every 1 cup rice) and instant stock cube. Cover the pot and let the rice boil, then flip it, reduce heat, and simmer until fully cooked.
instructions.3: Toast the Syrian or baladi bread in the oven after brushing it with clarified butter. Cut the bread into small cubes.
instructions.4: Mix the washed and drained chicken with Knorr's kofta mix. Shape the chicken into small balls.
instructions.5: Heat a pot over high heat and add butter. Add the chicken balls and sauté until browned on all sides. Add half a cup of boiling water, cover the pot, and simmer the chicken on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Prepare the fatta sauce: crush garlic with salt, then add tahini, vinegar, lemon juice, cumin, parsley, and yogurt. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.7: Assemble the fatta: place the rice in a serving dish, then arrange the toasted bread around the rice. Place the chicken balls on top of the rice and pour the fatta sauce over everything. Sprinkle with fresh green parsley.
instructions.8: Serve the fatta hot.

fah-422.title: Chicken Kofta Fatta
fah-422.culturalNotes: You can use any type of rice instead of basmati rice. You can also add toasted nuts and chopped parsley as desired for garnish.

instructions.1: Prepare the kofta: Mix ground chicken breast with chopped parsley, chopped coriander, crushed breadcrumbs, chopped onion, minced garlic, paprika, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and salt.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients thoroughly until the mixture becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Shape the mixture into small, evenly sized balls.
instructions.4: Fry the kofta in oil over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add water to the kofta and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Prepare the rice: Rinse the rice thoroughly and drain.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pot and add cinnamon stick, cloves, cassia stick, turmeric, stock, and salt.
instructions.8: Add the rice and stir well to coat with the spices.
instructions.9: Add boiling water (2 cups per 1 cup of rice) and simmer on low heat until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.10: Prepare the sauce: Mix mayonnaise, yogurt, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
instructions.11: Toast the pita bread in the oven until golden and crispy.
instructions.12: Serve the fatta: Place a layer of rice in the serving dish, then add the kofta on top.
instructions.13: Drizzle the sauce over the kofta and rice.
instructions.14: Sprinkle the toasted pita bread on top of the kofta and rice.
instructions.15: You can add toasted nuts and chopped parsley as desired.

fah-423.title: Zahkani Breakfast: Grilled Chicken, Saffron Basmati Rice, and Tamarind Juice with Yogurt
fah-423.culturalNotes: You can add sliced cucumber, tomato, and parsley as a side sauce to serve with the chicken and rice.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Mix the chicken with yogurt, oil, and shish tawook mix, and stir well.
instructions.3: Place the chicken in the refrigerator for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: In a pot on the stove, heat the ghee and oil until hot.
instructions.5: Add the cinnamon sticks, cloves, cassia buds, laurel leaf, and black pepper, and sauté on medium heat until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the washed and drained rice, and stir well over heat until warmed through.
instructions.7: Add the instant stock and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Pour in hot water (4 cups per 1 cup of rice), and stir the rice well.
instructions.9: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low, cover the pot.
instructions.10: After 10 minutes, add the raisins and saffron powder to half of the pot, and stir well.
instructions.11: Cover the pot and let the rice cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.12: Place a hot coal on a heat-resistant plate, add two drops of oil, cover the pot, and let it sit for 5 minutes.
instructions.13: On a grill over heat, place the chicken pieces and grill until golden brown.
instructions.14: Remove seeds from tamarind, add to milk, and mix in tamarind paste.
instructions.15: Blend the mixture until smooth, then pour into glasses.
instructions.16: Serve the grilled chicken and saffron basmati rice with tamarind juice mixed with yogurt.

fah-424.title: Happiness Breakfast Without Bread
fah-424.culturalNotes: Make sure the heat is high and the pan does not stick. You can add other ingredients to the filling as desired.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with salt and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, water, and milk, and knead the ingredients thoroughly until the dough becomes smooth and lump-free.
instructions.3: Strain the dough if it contains lumps.
instructions.4: Heat the pan on high heat and grease it lightly with oil.
instructions.5: Place a scoop of dough into the pan and flip it until both sides are golden brown.
instructions.6: Repeat the process until all the dough is used up.
instructions.7: Prepare the filling by mashing the potatoes with potato spices, feta cheese, colorful peppers, green pepper, and green onion.
instructions.8: Add salt to taste and mix the filling well.
instructions.9: Fill the dough with the mixture and fold it into a pouch shape.
instructions.10: Fry it in a tablespoon of butter until golden brown.
instructions.11: Serve hot.

fah-425.title: Restaurant-Style Breakfast: French Coffee and Cheese Croissant
fah-425.culturalNotes: You can use any type of cheese available at home to garnish the croissant. You can also add some dried fruits or honey to the coffee for extra flavor.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1/2 teaspoon of coffee beans with 1 1/4 teaspoons of coffee.
instructions.2: Add 1/2 cup of water and 1/2 cup of milk, then stir the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Place the mixture on low heat and stir once halfway through cooking.
instructions.4: When the coffee starts to boil, add the caramel chocolate cube and pour the hot coffee over it to help it melt.
instructions.5: Meanwhile, prepare the cheese croissant. Place 1 slice of egg cheese or cream cheese on the croissant.
instructions.6: Serve the croissant with French coffee, and cucumber and tomato slices as garnish.

fah-426.title: Quick Breakfast: Feta Cheese Sandwiches with Yogurt Tea
fah-426.culturalNotes: You can add other ingredients like tomatoes or parsley according to preference. The dough can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one day.

instructions.1: Prepare yogurt tea: In a pot, combine 1 cup water and 1 cup yogurt. Add 2 tea bags and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Simmer on low heat for 5 minutes, then remove from heat.
instructions.2: Prepare the dough: In a bowl, mix half a cup of flour with 1/4 cup of water, a pinch of salt, a pinch of sugar, 1 egg, and 1 tablespoon of oil. Beat thoroughly until the dough is smooth and lump-free.
instructions.3: Heat a pan over medium heat. Add a small amount of oil and spread it evenly. Pour a small amount of dough into the pan and cook until golden and puffed.
instructions.4: Flip the dough when it starts to turn golden, then place feta cheese on one side and fold it over. Cook until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
instructions.5: Serve the sandwiches with yogurt tea, cucumber, and olives.

fah-427.title: Quick Breakfast Fattoush Without Oven or Kneading
fah-427.culturalNotes: Serve the fattoush with any drink, such as tea with milk. Use any type of cheese you have available.

fah-427-i7.name: Feta or cheddar or mozzarella cheese

instructions.1: Place the pan on the stove and add 1 tablespoon of butter.
instructions.2: Add pieces of pastirma and cook until browned.
instructions.3: In another bowl, beat the eggs and add salt and black pepper.
instructions.4: Pour the egg mixture over the pastirma in the pan and let it set slightly.
instructions.5: Place shawarma bread or tortilla on top of the egg mixture.
instructions.6: Add cheese, hot or mild pepper, and olive on top of the bread.
instructions.7: Place another piece of bread on top and press firmly to hold all ingredients together.
instructions.8: Gently flip the fattoush to brown the other side.
instructions.9: Cook until crispy on both sides and the cheese is melted inside.

fah-428.title: Quick Breakfast Feteer
fah-428.culturalNotes: You can use a small skillet and prepare the mixture in two batches if the skillet is too small. You can also add cheese to taste.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes and grate them finely.
instructions.2: Squeeze out excess water from the grated potatoes.
instructions.3: Place the potatoes in a deep bowl.
instructions.4: Add the eggs, milk, salt, pepper, baking powder, and flour.
instructions.5: Mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.6: Heat a 28 cm skillet over medium heat.
instructions.7: Add 1 tablespoon of butter and let it melt and heat up.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture into the skillet and spread it evenly.
instructions.9: Cover the skillet and cook until golden brown on the bottom.
instructions.10: Flip the feteer and cook the other side until golden brown.
instructions.11: Sprinkle grated cheese on top if desired.
instructions.12: Cover again and cook until the cheese melts.
instructions.13: Transfer the feteer to a serving plate.
instructions.14: Garnish with chopped parsley or green onion.
instructions.15: Cut into triangular pieces like pizza.

fah-429.title: Pizza Boats with Economical Dough
fah-429.culturalNotes: The boats can be frozen and used as needed. They can be served for breakfast or dinner.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt or dry yogurt and oil, and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm water until the dough becomes soft and slightly sticky.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.5: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, until doubled in size.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into egg-sized balls and cover them with a clean cloth.
instructions.7: Roll each ball into an oval shape, spread with labneh, then add the filling (cheese, pastirma, olives, tomatoes, peppers).
instructions.8: Seal the edges to form the boats.
instructions.9: Place the boats on an oiled baking tray, lightly dusted with flour.
instructions.10: Brush the boats with the mixture of egg, milk, Nescafe, and sugar.
instructions.11: Let the boats rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve hot with your favorite sauce.

fah-430.title: Kunafa Kebab with Shawarma
fah-430.culturalNotes: Kunafa kebabs with shawarma can be served hot or cold. They can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the shredded chicken with the shawarma seasoning and 3 spoons of oil, then refrigerate for 15 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix half a cup of oil with the kunafa and stir well.
instructions.3: Place the kunafa into muffin molds and brush with ghee.
instructions.4: Bake in the oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.5: Mix tahini with water, lemon juice, and garlic, then add mayonnaise and yogurt. Stir well.
instructions.6: In a pan over heat, add the shawarma with onions, red pepper, yellow pepper, and parsley. Stir well.
instructions.7: Add salt and pepper to taste.
instructions.8: Remove the kunafa from the oven and let it cool slightly.
instructions.9: Fill the kunafa with the sauce, then with the shawarma.
instructions.10: Drizzle with sweet sauce on top.

fah-431.title: Chicken Casserole
fah-431.culturalNotes: You can add yellow beans, red beans, and mushrooms to taste for extra flavor. Serve the casserole with tomato sauce or spicy sauce.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes.
instructions.2: Chop the onion, bell peppers, and tomatoes into small pieces.
instructions.3: Mix salt, black pepper, oregano, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
instructions.4: Place the chicken pieces in the marinade and let sit for 15 minutes.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.6: Add the chicken pieces and stir-fry until fully cooked.
instructions.7: Add the onion and stir until softened.
instructions.8: Add the bell peppers and tomatoes, and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.9: Remove the mixture from heat and set aside.
instructions.10: Reheat the pan and add a small amount of oil.
instructions.11: Place the flatbread in the pan and sprinkle a little cheese on top.
instructions.12: Add a portion of the chicken mixture onto the bread.
instructions.13: Sprinkle more cheese on top.
instructions.14: Press down on the bread and flip it until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.15: Serve the casserole hot.

fah-432.title: Potato Kibbeh
fah-432.culturalNotes: Kibbeh can be frozen after shaping and used later. Kibbeh is perfect for iftar during Ramadan or for lunch.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes thoroughly until fully cooked.
instructions.2: Drain the potatoes and mash them well.
instructions.3: Add cornstarch and salt to the mashed potatoes and mix thoroughly until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Add more cornstarch if the dough is too soft or sticky.
instructions.5: Prepare the filling using the minced meat.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into small balls.
instructions.7: Open each ball and fill it with minced meat.
instructions.8: Seal the kibbeh tightly and shape them.
instructions.9: Fry the kibbeh in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve the kibbeh on a bed of parsley with your preferred sauce.

fah-433.title: Pizza and Chocolate Balls
fah-433.culturalNotes: You can add any fillings you prefer inside the pizza balls. You can also serve the balls with tomato sauce or any other sauce you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, and dry milk powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the yogurt and mayonnaise, and knead the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Slowly add the warm water until you get a firm and soft dough.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Mix the tomato sauce, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, and oregano to prepare the pizza sauce.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small balls and shape them.
instructions.7: Roll each ball on a floured surface and place one teaspoon of pizza sauce in the center.
instructions.8: Add your favorite fillings (such as peppers, tomatoes, olives, cheese, or basturma) and close the balls.
instructions.9: Place the balls on an oiled baking tray and let them rise for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the tops of the balls with the mixture of dry milk powder, sugar, Nescafé, and water.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20-25 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove the balls from the oven and serve hot.

fah-434.title: Crispy Chicken Rolls
fah-434.culturalNotes: The rolls can be frozen after coating with crispy crumbs and before frying. When ready to serve, remove from freezer and fry until golden brown.

instructions.1: Prepare the chicken: Cut chicken breasts into small pieces and place in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the spices: Add onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, smoked paprika, chili flakes, instant stock powder, ginger powder, clove, and 1 tablespoon of salt. Mix well.
instructions.3: Pound the chicken: Place the chicken in a food processor and add half of the spice mix. Pulse until finely minced.
instructions.4: Prepare the rolls: Spread the minced chicken evenly on tortilla bread, forming a thin layer. Roll up tightly.
instructions.5: Cut the rolls: Use a sharp knife to cut the rolls into small pieces.
instructions.6: Prepare the batter: In a bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, remaining spices, ricotta cheese, and salt. Gradually add water until you get a thick consistency.
instructions.7: Coat the rolls: Dip the rolls into the batter, then coat with crispy crumbs.
instructions.8: Fry the rolls: Fry in hot, deep oil until golden brown.
instructions.9: Prepare the sauce: Mix pickled cucumber, mayonnaise, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, sugar, and black pepper.
instructions.10: Serve: Serve the rolls hot with the sauce.

fah-435.title: Shawarma Roll with Crispy Crust
fah-435.culturalNotes: You can use any flatbread instead of tortilla bread. You can also add other vegetables such as tomatoes or fresh cucumber for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the Syrian shawarma mix with 3 tablespoons of oil in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the chicken slices and stir well.
instructions.3: Let the chicken marinate for 1 hour.
instructions.4: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a pan, then add the shawarma once the oil is hot.
instructions.5: Stir the shawarma occasionally until golden brown.
instructions.6: Prepare the sandwich sauce: mix 4 tablespoons of mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons of ketchup, a pinch of onion powder, a pinch of garlic powder, and 2 tablespoons of pickled cucumber.
instructions.7: Place a spoonful of sauce on a tortilla, then add the shawarma, fried potatoes, and cheese.
instructions.8: Roll the tortilla to form a roll and secure with toothpicks.
instructions.9: Prepare the egg and milk mixture, then dip the roll into it.
instructions.10: Dip the roll into breadcrumbs or crushed pita.
instructions.11: Heat oil in a pan over high heat and fry the roll until golden brown.
instructions.12: Drain the roll from excess oil and serve with fried potatoes and leftover sauce.

fah-436.title: Vegetable Crepes
fah-436.culturalNotes: You can add any other vegetables according to preference. Serve the crepes with tomato sauce or white sauce.

instructions.1: Mix the warm milk with sugar and yeast, then let it rest aside for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the potatoes with black pepper, salt, and oregano.
instructions.3: Add the warm milk and yeast mixture to the potatoes and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the flour and baking powder and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add the oil and mix the dough well.
instructions.6: Add the cheese, tomatoes, black olives, pepper, and finely chopped sausage, and mix well.
instructions.7: Heat a pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.8: Scoop a portion of the dough into the pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.9: Cook until golden on one side, then flip and cook the other side.
instructions.10: Place cheese on half of the crepe and fold it closed.
instructions.11: Repeat the process until all the dough is used up.

fah-437.title: Koshari
fah-437.culturalNotes: Make sure the lentils are soaked for one hour before starting to cook. You can reduce the ingredient quantities according to the number of people you wish to serve. Koshari can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Slice the white onion thinly and mix with salt and cornstarch, then toss well.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat, then add the onions and fry until golden brown.
instructions.3: Remove the fried onions and spread them on paper towels, separating them to cool.
instructions.4: In a small pan, add a little oil and sauté the minced garlic until golden.
instructions.5: Add the freshly squeezed tomatoes, red bell pepper, instant stock cube, sugar, tomato paste, cumin, black pepper, and dried parsley, then stir well.
instructions.6: Add one cup of boiling water and let the sauce thicken.
instructions.7: In the same oil, add the vermicelli and fry until lightly browned.
instructions.8: Add the rice and stir with the vermicelli until lightly toasted.
instructions.9: Add the soaked lentils to the boiling water and mix everything together.
instructions.10: Add the small pasta and mix with the rest of the ingredients.
instructions.11: Add boiling water until the ingredients are covered by about 2 cm, then bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.12: Stir well, cover the pot, and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.13: In a separate pan, combine water, minced garlic, chopped chili, cumin, dried parsley, salt, vinegar, and lemon juice, then bring to a boil.
instructions.14: Remove from heat and set aside in a separate bowl.
instructions.15: Serve Koshari hot, topped with the sauce, fried onions, the spicy sauce, and lemon wedges.

fah-438.title: Potato Kofta with Cheese
fah-438.culturalNotes: Kofta can be frozen and used as needed. Leftover chicken or ground meat can be used instead of pastrami.

instructions.1: Boil potatoes with their peels on, then peel and mash them.
instructions.2: Dice the bell peppers into small cubes.
instructions.3: Sauté the pastrami in 1 tablespoon of butter.
instructions.4: Mix the mashed potatoes with the cheeses, diced bell peppers, sautéed pastrami, and seasonings (salt and pepper).
