instructions.4: Add the oil and yogurt to the egg mixture and stir well.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and stir until fully combined.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into the greased pan and bake in the oven for 30 minutes until fully cooked.
instructions.7: Prepare the croquant: Combine sugar with 2 spoons of water on the stove until caramelized and turns light golden.
instructions.8: Add baking soda and nuts to the caramelized mixture and stir well.
instructions.9: Pour the mixture into a greased baking tray and spread it evenly using a silicone spatula.
instructions.10: Let the croquant cool completely, then break it into small pieces.
instructions.11: Prepare the sauce: Mix hot yogurt, sugar, cocoa powder, and oil in a bowl and stir well until sugar dissolves and the mixture is smooth.
instructions.12: Pour the sauce over the cooled cake.
instructions.13: Prepare the ganache: Heat the cream in a bowl over the stove until hot, but do not let it boil.
instructions.14: Add the hot cream to the chopped chocolate and stir well until the chocolate is fully melted.
instructions.15: Pour the ganache over the cake and let it cool completely.
instructions.16: Serve the cake with crushed croquant.

fah-575.title: Chocolate Cake
fah-575.culturalNotes: Any type of nuts can be used according to preference. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. The cake can be served with a cup of tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius. Grease the cake pan and lightly dust it with flour.
instructions.2: Mix the sifted flour, unsweetened cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: In another bowl, beat the eggs, sugar, vanilla extract, and Nescafe together with hot water using an electric mixer until the mixture becomes light and creamy.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg and sugar mixture while continuing to mix.
instructions.5: Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Prepare the crocan: In a saucepan, combine sugar and water and cook over medium heat until it turns light golden brown. Then add baking soda and nuts, mix well, pour into a greased tray, and let it cool completely.
instructions.7: Prepare the sauce: In a bowl, mix hot yogurt, sugar, unsweetened cocoa powder, and oil thoroughly until well blended.
instructions.8: Prepare the ganache: Heat the cream in a saucepan over medium heat until hot, then pour it over the chopped unsweetened chocolate and stir until the chocolate is fully melted.
instructions.9: After removing the cake from the oven, let it cool completely. Then, pour the sauce over the cake, spread the ganache on top, and finally decorate with crushed crocan.

fah-576.title: Fudge Cake
fah-576.culturalNotes: It's best to refrigerate the cake overnight so the frosting becomes firmer and the flavor improves. Serve the cake with a cup of tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Prepare the cake batter: Mix flour, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add eggs, vanilla, oil, butter, and dried milk. Mix well.
instructions.3: Add hot water dissolved with Nescafe. Mix until smooth.
instructions.4: Pour the batter into two greased and floured baking pans.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 40 minutes.
instructions.6: Prepare the frosting: In a bowl, mix frozen milk, powdered sugar, cocoa, oil, cream shanyeh, and milk powder. Beat well.
instructions.7: Gradually add oil and beat until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.8: Refrigerate the frosting for 2 to 3 hours.
instructions.9: Prepare the ganache: Heat cream and add grated chocolate. Mix until chocolate melts and the mixture becomes smooth.
instructions.10: Pour the ganache over the cooled cake.
instructions.11: Garnish the cake with strawberry and cherry pieces.
instructions.12: Refrigerate the cake overnight before serving.

fah-577.title: Malaga Cake
fah-577.culturalNotes: Make sure the oven is preheated to 170 degrees before starting. You can use small bananas if the large ones are too big. After decorating the cake with chocolate, refrigerate it for at least 30 minutes so the chocolate sets properly.

instructions.1: Mix flour, cocoa powder, cornstarch, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: In another bowl, beat eggs with sugar and vanilla until sugar dissolves.
instructions.3: Add oil and milk to the egg mixture and stir well.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and stir until smooth.
instructions.5: Pour the batter into a buttered and floured cake pan.
instructions.6: Bake in the preheated oven at 170 degrees for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: After removing the cake from the oven, poke it with a toothpick and pour cold milk over it.
instructions.8: In a saucepan, mix milk, sugar, cornstarch, flour, butter, and egg yolk. Cook over medium heat until thickened.
instructions.9: Add vanilla and stir well. Transfer to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let cool.
instructions.10: Mix the chilled whipped chantilly cream into the cooled mixture and beat well.
instructions.11: Spread the cream mixture over the cake and arrange bananas on top.
instructions.12: Melt chocolate with 2 tablespoons of cream and pour over the bananas.
instructions.13: Sprinkle crushed pistachios on top.
instructions.14: Refrigerate the cake until completely chilled and the chocolate has set.

fah-578.title: Light Moist Chocolate Cake with Chocolate Sauce
fah-578.culturalNotes: You can increase the biscuit quantity to 200 grams if you prefer a thicker sauce. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the water and prepare the mixer.
instructions.2: Add 3 eggs at room temperature to the mixer.
instructions.3: Add 1 large spoon of vanilla.
instructions.4: Add 1 cup of sugar.
instructions.5: Add 1/2 cup of raw cocoa powder.
instructions.6: Add 1 cup of oil.
instructions.7: Add 1/2 cup of milk and 1 large spoon of vinegar.
instructions.8: Mix the ingredients in the mixer for 3-4 minutes until well combined and sugar dissolves.
instructions.9: In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of flour with 1 large spoon of baking powder and 1 pinch of salt.
instructions.10: Mix dry ingredients well, then add the beaten mixture from the mixer.
instructions.11: Mix thoroughly until fully combined and no flour lumps remain.
instructions.12: Heat 1/2 cup of hot water (about 70°C) and add it to the mixture, stirring well.
instructions.13: Grease the cake pan well and pour the batter into it.
instructions.14: Preheat the oven to 180°C and place the pan in a dark aluminum baking tray.
instructions.15: Place the pan in the middle rack of the oven and bake for 25 minutes.
instructions.16: After 25 minutes, check the cake with a toothpick. If it comes out clean, the cake is done.
instructions.17: To prepare the chocolate sauce, heat 1/2 cup of milk and add 2 squares of dark or milk chocolate.
instructions.18: Remove from heat as soon as it warms up.
instructions.19: Add 150 grams of biscuits, 1 large spoon of butter, and 1 large spoon of raw cocoa powder.
instructions.20: Use a hand mixer to blend ingredients thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.21: Pour the chocolate sauce over the cake.
instructions.22: Serve the cake warm or cold, according to preference.

fah-579.title: Toffee Sauce Cake
fah-579.culturalNotes: You can pour a cup of cold milk over the cake right after removing it from the oven to make it more moist. Any type of nut can be used instead of shredded coconut, according to preference.

instructions.1: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: In another bowl, beat eggs with sugar and vanilla for 3 minutes until pale in color.
instructions.3: Gradually add half a cup of oil while continuing to beat.
instructions.4: Add one cup of yogurt and mix well.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture and mix until smooth.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into a greased and floured cake pan.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 40-50 minutes.
instructions.8: In a separate bowl, mix sugar with a quarter cup of water and let it boil until it turns golden.
instructions.9: Add the whipped cream and beat until well combined.
instructions.10: Add butter, vanilla, and salt and mix thoroughly.
instructions.11: Pour the sauce over the cake after it has cooled slightly.
instructions.12: Sprinkle toasted shredded coconut on top of the cake.

fah-580.title: Saffron Tea Cake
fah-580.culturalNotes: Any flavor of saffron tea can be used according to preference. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Serve the cake with a cup of saffron tea for a distinctive taste.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with sugar and vanilla in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the oil while continuing to beat.
instructions.3: Add 1 cup of yogurt and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add 1 tablespoon of vinegar and mix well.
instructions.5: Sift the flour and baking powder together in a separate bowl.
instructions.6: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg and yogurt mixture while continuing to beat.
instructions.7: Add 2 teaspoons of saffron tea and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Pour the batter into a greased and floured baking pan.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.10: After removing the cake from the oven, let it cool slightly, then serve with sweetened condensed milk sauce.

fah-581.title: Moist Chocolate Cake with Chocolate Sauce
fah-581.culturalNotes: You can use 100% natural raw cocoa for a rich and healthy flavor. You can store the cake in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs, vanilla extract, milk, oil, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the semolina, cornmeal, raw cocoa, flour, and baking powder while continuously stirring.
instructions.3: Beat the ingredients thoroughly in one direction until fully combined.
instructions.4: Pour the cake batter into a greased and floured 26 cm cake pan.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 45 minutes.
instructions.6: In another bowl, mix 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup raw cocoa, and 2 cups water.
instructions.7: Heat the mixture over medium heat until it boils, then pour it over the cooled cake.
instructions.8: In a separate bowl, mix 1 cup sugar, 1/2 cup raw cocoa, and 1 cup warm milk.
instructions.9: Use an electric mixer to blend the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.10: Gradually add 1/2 cup oil while continuing to mix until you achieve a smooth, creamy chocolate sauce.
instructions.11: Pour the syrup over the cake, then spread the chocolate sauce evenly over the surface.
instructions.12: Let the cake cool completely before serving.

fah-582.title: Chocolate Mousse Cake
fah-582.culturalNotes: The cake can be served in individual portions or in a large tray as a dessert. You can decorate the cake with grated chocolate or fresh fruits as desired.

instructions.1: Prepare the cake batter: Mix flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: In another bowl, beat eggs with vanilla and sugar until the mixture turns white.
instructions.3: Add oil and yogurt to the egg mixture and stir well.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and stir until smooth and even.
instructions.5: Pour the batter into a buttered and floured baking pan.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 40–45 minutes.
instructions.7: Check the cake’s doneness with a toothpick or skewer.
instructions.8: Cut off the dry top layer of the cake and set it aside.
instructions.9: Pour the cake into individual portions or a large tray.
instructions.10: Pour the yogurt and Nescafé mixture over the cake to moisten it.
instructions.11: Prepare the mousse: Place 1 kg of yogurt in a pot and heat on low flame.
instructions.12: Add 6 spoons of Nescafé, 6 spoons of chantilly cream, 1/4 cup sugar, 2 packets of crème caramel, 2 dark chocolate pieces, and 2 spoons of cornstarch.
instructions.13: Stir the mixture well until thickened.
instructions.14: Pour the mousse over the cake in the individual portions or tray.
instructions.15: Let the cake cool, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
instructions.16: Serve the cake chilled.

fah-583.title: Yogurt Cake
fah-583.culturalNotes: Serve the cake with a glass of yogurt for a delicious taste. The cake stays fresh for a long time if stored in a dry, cool place.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt, ghee or oil, sugar, eggs, vanilla, and salt in the blender.
instructions.2: Gradually add the sifted flour and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the cake mix package and mix until the batter is smooth.
instructions.4: Grease the baking pan with butter and sprinkle with flour.
instructions.5: Pour the batter into the pan.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 45 minutes.
instructions.7: Let the cake cool before serving.

fah-584.title: Chocolate and Coffee Cake Without Oven
fah-584.culturalNotes: Make sure the cake is completely cooled before pouring the syrup over it to ensure better syrup absorption. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Whisk sugar, oil, milk, and cocoa powder in a blender until well combined.
instructions.2: Add vanilla and whisk again.
instructions.3: Sift flour, baking powder, and salt together and mix them.
instructions.4: Add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and mix thoroughly using a hand mixer.
instructions.5: Grease the cake mold with oil and place it inside a larger pan containing boiling water.
instructions.6: Cover the mold with a towel, then with a lid, and place it on the stove over high heat for 5 minutes, then reduce to low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: After cooking, let the cake cool completely.
instructions.8: Prepare the syrup by mixing coffee, honey, and hot water, then add cold water to cool the mixture.
instructions.9: Pour the syrup over the cake after it has cooled completely.
instructions.10: Cover the cake with chocolate sauce and cocoa powder.
instructions.11: Let the cake cool completely before serving.

fah-585.title: Russian Honey Cake
fah-585.culturalNotes: You can use white or black honey according to preference to enhance color. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add butter and honey and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Place the mixture over medium heat and stir until butter and sugar are fully dissolved.
instructions.4: Add baking soda and mix well.
instructions.5: Gradually add flour and mix until a firm dough forms.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into 8 equal pieces.
instructions.8: Roll each piece out on parchment paper or silicone mat to a thickness of 2 mm.
instructions.9: Cut the dough into circles using a round mold and prick each with a fork.
instructions.10: Place the circles on a baking tray and bake for 7 minutes at 175 degrees Celsius.
instructions.11: Repeat the process until all pieces are baked.
instructions.12: In a bowl, combine confectioners' cream, sour cream, cream cheese, and powdered sugar; beat until smooth.
instructions.13: Layer the cake with alternating layers of cake and cream until all layers are used.
instructions.14: Garnish the cake with crumbled dough and baked slices.
instructions.15: Refrigerate the cake for 30 minutes before serving.

fah-586.title: Coffee Cake
fah-586.culturalNotes: You can use any type of nuts for garnish according to preference. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder in a bowl and sift them together.
instructions.2: In another bowl, beat the eggs with sugar and vanilla using an electric mixer.
instructions.3: Gradually add the oil to the egg and sugar mixture and beat well.
instructions.4: Dissolve the Nescafe in water and add to the milk, then mix well.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture to the liquid mixture and stir until all ingredients are well combined.
instructions.6: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.7: Grease the baking pan with butter and dust it with flour or a flour-cocoa mix.
instructions.8: Pour the cake batter into the pan and bake for 40-50 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.9: In a bowl, beat the milk, powdered sugar, milk powder, chantilly cream, cottage cheese, and Nescafe until the cream becomes smooth and creamy.
instructions.10: After removing the cake from the oven, let it cool slightly, then pour the cream over it.
instructions.11: Garnish the cake with grated chocolate and crushed pistachios.

fah-587.title: Cookie Cake
fah-587.culturalNotes: This cake can be served with ice cream for a delicious taste. The cake can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Melt the butter until it turns golden brown
instructions.2: Add the eggs one at a time and mix them together
instructions.3: Add the brown sugar, white sugar, and vanilla and mix them together
instructions.4: Add the flour along with the baking powder, baking soda, and salt and mix them together
instructions.5: Knead the dough with your hands for 15 minutes
instructions.6: Add the chocolate chips and knead them into the dough
instructions.7: Place the dough in the freezer for 15 minutes
instructions.8: Remove the dough from the freezer and roll it out onto a baking tray
instructions.9: Bake the tray in a preheated oven at 250°C (480°F) for 10-15 minutes
instructions.10: Let the cake cool slightly before cutting it

fah-588.title: Light Lemon Cake
fah-588.culturalNotes: Make sure to mix the ingredients well to achieve a light and spongy cake. You can serve the cake with a cup of tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs, oil, sugar, yogurt, lemon juice, and vanilla in a blender until well combined.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
instructions.3: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture, stirring continuously in one direction.
instructions.4: Add the lemon zest and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Pour the batter into a greased and floured baking pan.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.7: Prepare the glaze by mixing powdered sugar, cream cheese, lemon juice, water, and vanilla in a bowl and stirring well.
instructions.8: Refrigerate the glaze until cooled.
instructions.9: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool slightly before slicing.
instructions.10: Spread the glaze over the cooled cake and garnish with lemon zest and cherries if desired.

fah-589.title: Decadent Cake
fah-589.culturalNotes: Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature before starting. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with sugar, vanilla, and vinegar in a bowl until the consistency becomes creamy.
instructions.2: Add the oil and yogurt and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the flour, baking powder, cocoa powder, and salt and stir until all ingredients are well combined.
instructions.4: Pour the batter into the decadent cake molds and bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Check the cake's doneness with a toothpick.
instructions.6: Mix the yogurt and Nescafé and pour the mixture over the hot cake.
instructions.7: Mix the heavy cream, frozen yogurt, sugar, and cocoa powder and whip for 7 minutes until the cream becomes thick.
instructions.8: Add the Nutella and whip again.
instructions.9: Pour the cream over the cake.
instructions.10: Heat the cream and pour it over the grated chocolate, stirring until the chocolate melts completely.
instructions.11: Pour the ganache over the cake.
instructions.12: Garnish the cake with marshmallows, jelly beans, fudge, or any type of chocolate according to preference.
instructions.13: Place the cake in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

fah-590.title: Marbled Cake
fah-590.culturalNotes: The cake can be served warm or cold. Chocolate sauce or cream can be added for serving.

instructions.1: Mix 4 eggs with 1 cup and 1/4 of sugar and 1 cup and 1/4 of warm yogurt in the mixer.
instructions.2: Add 1 cup of shortening and 1/4 cup of oil.
instructions.3: Add 1 tablespoon of vinegar and a pinch of salt, and knead the ingredients for 4 minutes until sugar dissolves completely.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix 3 cups of flour with 1 pack of baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda.
instructions.5: Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet mixture and mix in one direction until the mixture is smooth and flour disappears.
instructions.6: Divide the mixture into two parts: one-third and two-thirds.
instructions.7: Add 1/4 cup of raw cocoa powder and 1/4 cup of warm yogurt to one-third of the mixture and mix well.
instructions.8: Grease the cake pan with butter and dust it with flour.
instructions.9: Layer the white mixture followed by the dark mixture, alternating until all mixture is used.
instructions.10: Tap the pan twice and place it in the preheated oven at 180°C for 40 minutes.
instructions.11: Remove from oven and test for doneness using a toothpick. If it comes out clean, the cake is ready.

fah-591.title: Marbled Cake (Tiger Cake)
fah-591.culturalNotes: The cake can be served with a cup of plain tea, milk tea, or mint tea. It can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius (bottom heat only).
instructions.2: Beat the eggs, vanilla, salt, and sugar in a mixer until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.3: Gradually add the shortening and oil mixture, and beat well.
instructions.4: Add half a cup of yogurt and beat well.
instructions.5: In a separate bowl, mix the sifted flour and baking powder, then gradually add to the mixture and beat until well combined.
instructions.6: Add the remaining yogurt and beat well.
instructions.7: In a small bowl, mix 1/4 cup of yogurt with 2 tablespoons of vinegar and 3 teaspoons of baking powder. Beat well until frothy.
instructions.8: Add the reactive mixture to the cake batter and beat well.
instructions.9: Beat the mixture until smooth and runny.
instructions.10: Transfer about one-third of the batter to a small bowl, add 1/4 cup of cocoa powder and 1/4 cup of yogurt, and mix well.
instructions.11: Pour the white batter into the cake pan, then alternately add the chocolate batter.
instructions.12: Place the pan in the oven and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the cake is golden brown and cooked through in the center.
instructions.13: Let the cake cool before serving.

fah-592.title: Mini Red Velvet Cake
fah-592.culturalNotes: You can use different flavors such as chocolate or vanilla for the cake and frosting. You can also use leftover cake to make individual trifles.

instructions.1: Prepare the cake batter: Beat the eggs with sugar, vinegar, and vanilla in a bowl until the mixture turns pale white.
instructions.2: Add the butter, oil, and buttermilk while continuing to beat in the same direction.
instructions.3: Mix the cocoa powder, baking powder, and baking soda with the flour, then gradually add the dry mixture to the wet mixture while continuing to beat.
instructions.4: Add the red food coloring and mix thoroughly until the batter reaches the desired red color.
instructions.5: Grease the cake pan with butter and dust with flour, then pour the batter into the pan.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 12-15 minutes, and check for doneness using a toothpick.
instructions.7: Prepare the frosting: Beat the cream cheese with an electric mixer until smooth, then add the melted butter and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.8: Gradually add the powdered sugar while continuing to beat until the frosting becomes creamy and white.
instructions.9: Chill the frosting in the refrigerator for 10 minutes to help it set.
instructions.10: Cut the cake into small pieces, then cut each piece in half.
instructions.11: Take a serving dish, place a layer of cake, then a layer of frosting, and repeat until all ingredients are used.
instructions.12: Garnish the cake with leftover cake pieces, frosting, and strawberries if desired.
instructions.13: Serve the mini cakes warm or cold, according to preference.

fah-593.title: Creamy Cheese
fah-593.culturalNotes: You can garnish the creamy cheese with thyme, nigella seeds, or olive oil according to preference.

instructions.1: When the milk boils, add one tablespoon of vinegar and stir well.
instructions.2: Strain the curdled milk through a fine sieve.
instructions.3: Keep the whey (liquid) obtained and use it in pastries or beverages.
instructions.4: In a bowl, place the solid parts of the curdled milk and strain them.
instructions.5: Add 1/2 cup milk, 2 tablespoons milk powder, and a small pinch of salt.
instructions.6: Mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.7: Gradually add 1/2 cup oil and knead until you achieve a creamy consistency.
instructions.8: Store the creamy cheese in the refrigerator to improve its texture.

fah-594.title: Original Homemade Nutella
fah-594.culturalNotes: Keep the Nutella refrigerated before using to improve texture. You can add an additional quarter cup of oil if you prefer a lighter consistency. Serve it in sandwiches for children.

fah-594-i5.name: Spanish cocoa or raw cocoa powder

instructions.1: Grind the hazelnuts with a small amount of oil in the blender
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk to the ground hazelnuts
instructions.3: Add the Spanish cocoa (or Nescafé) and mix thoroughly
instructions.4: Add the remaining milk and oil and stir until the mixture is well combined
instructions.5: Bake the mixture in small ramekins and store in the refrigerator

fah-595.title: Energy Bars
fah-595.culturalNotes: Bars can be stored in the freezer after cutting, in a freezer-safe container. Serve with a cup of tea or coffee, or pack in a lunchbox for students.

fah-595-i10.name: Dried fruits (dates, figs, dates, raisins, apricots)

instructions.1: Roast the nuts in the oven until lightly toasted, then let them cool.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs with vanilla in a bowl until the mixture becomes pale.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and whisk the ingredients together until well combined.
instructions.4: Add the salt, vinegar, and oil, and whisk all ingredients together.
instructions.5: Mix the flour, baking powder, and cinnamon together, then add to the previous mixture and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the dried fruits and chopped sweets, and mix them into the batter.
instructions.7: Pour the batter into a 30×40 cm greased and floured baking tray.
instructions.8: Spread the batter evenly across the tray.
instructions.9: Bake the bars in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.10: Remove the bars from the oven and let them cool slightly, then cut into small pieces.

fah-596.title: Buttery Shortbread Cookies
fah-596.culturalNotes: You can store the cookies in an airtight container for up to one week. Serve the cookies with tea or coffee for a delicious taste.

instructions.1: Beat the butter with an electric mixer until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the sifted sugar and mix well until the mixture becomes light and fluffy.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and salt, and mix again.
instructions.4: Gradually add the sifted flour and mix until all ingredients are well combined.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Remove the dough from the refrigerator and shape it into your preferred form.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.8: Place the cookies on a baking tray and bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.9: Let the cookies cool before serving.

fah-597.title: Happy Happiness Biscuits
fah-597.culturalNotes: The biscuits can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week. Serve the biscuits with tea or coffee for a delicious taste.

instructions.1: Make sure the butter is soft, not liquid or hard.
instructions.2: Mix the butter with powdered sugar until the texture becomes creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, and mix well until the eggs are completely incorporated.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Sift the flour and starch together, then add them to the butter and sugar mixture. Gently mix with the fingertips until the dough is well combined.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into two equal parts. Add one tablespoon of cocoa to one half and mix well.
instructions.7: Place each half of the dough into a plastic bag. Roll them out with a rolling pin until they form rectangles.
instructions.8: Layer the two dough sheets together in this order: chocolate, vanilla, chocolate, vanilla, chocolate.
instructions.9: Cut the dough into equal-sized rectangular pieces.
instructions.10: Bake the biscuits in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: After baking, let the biscuits cool on a wire rack, then serve.

fah-598.title: Cinnamon Roll Cookies
fah-598.culturalNotes: You can store the cookies in an airtight container for up to one week. You can also dust the cookies with powdered sugar after removing them from the oven for a more attractive appearance.

instructions.1: Cream the butter using an electric mixer until smooth.
instructions.2: Add the sifted powdered sugar and mix well until the texture becomes creamy and the color lightens.
instructions.3: Add the egg and vanilla extract and mix thoroughly until ingredients are well combined.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour and cornstarch while continuing to mix until the dough is fully combined.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Remove the dough from the refrigerator and roll it out between two sheets of parchment paper to a thickness of about 2–3 mm.
instructions.7: Sprinkle cinnamon over the rolled-out dough.
instructions.8: Roll the dough tightly like a cinnamon roll.
instructions.9: Slice the roll into thin pieces.
instructions.10: Place the pieces onto a greased baking tray.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C.
instructions.12: Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove the cookies from the oven and let them cool completely.

fah-599.title: Date Nut Cookies Without Oven
fah-599.culturalNotes: These date nut cookies can be served with milk tea or instant coffee. The cookies can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix semolina and powdered milk in a pan over medium heat, stirring until golden brown.
instructions.2: Add butter and cream, and stir well.
instructions.3: Add chopped dates and knead all ingredients together until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Transfer the dough to a buttered piping bag and spread it into a rectangular shape about 2 mm thick.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into rectangles and wrap each piece completely with tea biscuits on all sides.
instructions.6: Wrap the roll entirely with roasted sesame seeds on all sides.
instructions.7: Refrigerate the roll for 3–4 hours until firm and set.
instructions.8: Slice the roll into small pieces and serve.

fah-600.title: Ten-Minute Biscuits
fah-600.culturalNotes: Any type of jam can be used according to preference, but it should be well-mashed to avoid large chunks. The biscuits can be shaped into any form you like, such as using a cookie cutter or fork.

instructions.1: Mix the egg with sugar, vanilla, milk, oil, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the flour and baking powder, and stir them together.
instructions.3: Gradually pour the liquid mixture over the flour and knead with your hands until you get a smooth, easy-to-shape dough.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rest for several minutes to prevent drying.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into equal-sized balls and place them on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.6: Make a small hole in the center of each biscuit using a wooden spoon or your finger.
instructions.7: Fill each hole with jam.
instructions.8: Bake the biscuits in a preheated oven at 170°C for 10-15 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Prepare a portion of the dough with cocoa and shape it into balls, then coat them with coarse sugar.
instructions.10: Bake these balls as well at 170°C for 10-15 minutes.

fah-601.title: Lancashire Biscuits
fah-601.culturalNotes: You can decorate the biscuits with ground walnuts, jam, chocolate, or any other nuts according to preference. The biscuits can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and shortening thoroughly using a handheld or electric mixer.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla, and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the salt and baking powder, and mix again.
instructions.4: Mix the cornstarch and flour together, then sift them.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture to the shortening and egg mixture, and mix well.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to 160 degrees Celsius.
instructions.8: Line the baking tray with parchment paper.
instructions.9: Shape the dough into small balls and place them on the tray, leaving space between each.
instructions.10: Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.11: Remove the biscuits from the oven and let them cool.
instructions.12: Decorate the biscuits with ground walnuts, jam, chocolate, or any other nuts as desired.

fah-602.title: Orange and Ammonium Biscuits
fah-602.culturalNotes: Store the biscuits in an airtight container to keep them crisp. You can adjust the ingredient quantities to your preference.

instructions.1: Cut the butter and ghee into small cubes and beat them together until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the sifted powdered sugar and beat the mixture for 10 minutes until smooth and creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, continuing to beat until fully combined.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla and a pinch of salt, then beat again until well mixed.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour while mixing on low speed until the dough comes together.
instructions.6: Slowly add the warm milk and ammonium, stirring until fully blended.
instructions.7: Divide the dough in half. Add the orange extract and orange zest to the first half.
instructions.8: Shape the biscuits using a pastry bag and place them on a greased baking tray.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at 160-170°C for 15-20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.10: Remove the biscuits from the oven and immediately transfer them from the tray to prevent sticking.

fah-603.title: Butter Nougat Cookies
fah-603.culturalNotes: Use flour specifically made for kahk and cookies for the best results. Make sure the butter is cold before starting. Mix the sugar and butter thoroughly to achieve a creamy texture. Bake the cookies on the middle rack in a preheated oven.

fah-603-i1.name: Flour specifically for kahk and cookies

instructions.1: Make sure the butter is cold, meaning it's chilled and holds its shape.
instructions.2: Cut 400 grams of butter and place it in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add 160 grams of sifted powdered sugar and mix thoroughly until you achieve a creamy texture.
instructions.4: Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla and a pinch of salt, and mix again.
instructions.5: Add 1 kilogram of flour specifically for kahk and cookies, and sift it well before adding.
instructions.6: Knead the ingredients together until the dough becomes soft and smooth.
instructions.7: Place the dough into a pastry bag and shape the cookies onto an aluminum baking tray.
instructions.8: Make sure to leave space between each cookie.
instructions.9: Bake the cookies in a preheated oven at 170°C for 12-15 minutes.
instructions.10: Let the cookies cool before serving.

fah-604.title: Diet Chocolate Pudding
fah-604.culturalNotes: You can store the pudding in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. You can also add some fresh fruits when serving.

instructions.1: Mix low-fat milk, ground shavings, cornstarch, raw cocoa powder, and cinnamon in a cold bowl.
instructions.2: Stir ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Transfer mixture to a saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and smooth with no lumps.
instructions.4: Add Sweetal sugar and stir well until completely dissolved.
instructions.5: Pour pudding into serving dishes and let cool.
instructions.6: Garnish pudding with unground shavings and crushed almonds.

fah-605.title: Trifle with Biscuits and Chocolate
fah-605.culturalNotes: Make sure the mixture is cool before adding it to the biscuits to prevent them from getting soggy. You can store the trifle in the freezer for a longer period.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix the curd, sugar, milk powder, cornstarch, and raw cocoa powder.
instructions.2: Place the mixture on low heat, stirring continuously until it thickens.
instructions.3: Add the grated chocolate and butter, and stir until the chocolate melts completely.
instructions.4: Let the mixture cool down.
instructions.5: Crush the biscuits into small pieces.
instructions.6: Mix the cooled mixture thoroughly with the crushed biscuits.
instructions.7: Transfer the mixture to a container, and add two tablespoons of oil.
instructions.8: Shape the trifle using a teaspoon, and place them on parchment paper.
instructions.9: Cover the trifle balls with melted chocolate, adding one teaspoon of oil to the chocolate for smooth coating.
instructions.10: Garnish the trifle with sprinkles if desired.
instructions.11: Serve with Arabic coffee.

fah-606.title: No-Bake Chocolate Cake
fah-606.culturalNotes: Cocoa or plain milk can be used instead of instant coffee according to preference. The cake can be left in the refrigerator longer for better results.

instructions.1: Prepare Chantilly cream: Mix one cup Chantilly cream with one cup cold water and half a cup powdered sugar. Whip thoroughly.
instructions.2: Prepare caramel: Make caramel at home or use ready-made caramel.
instructions.3: Mix cream cheese: Place cream cheese in a bowl and whip until smooth and creamy.
instructions.4: Add caramel: Add caramel to the cream cheese and mix together.
instructions.5: Add Chantilly cream: Add Chantilly cream to the mixture of cream cheese and caramel. Mix well.
instructions.6: Prepare coffee liquid: Mix one large spoon of instant coffee with one cup of milk until the coffee dissolves completely.
instructions.7: Soak the biscuits: Dip the tea biscuits into the coffee liquid and place them in a square or round mold.
instructions.8: Layer the cake: Place a layer of soaked biscuits, then a layer of cream cheese and caramel mixture. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
instructions.9: Top the cake: Cover the top of the cake with a final layer of cream cheese and caramel mixture.
instructions.10: Chill the cake: Cover the cake with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
instructions.11: Serve the cake: Remove the cake from the refrigerator and sprinkle cocoa on top before serving.

fah-607.title: No-Oven Cake
fah-607.culturalNotes: Make sure the heat is very low while cooking the cake, and use parchment paper to protect the serving surface from staining. You can change the decoration as desired, but strawberries and grated chocolate give a beautiful appearance.

instructions.1: Whisk the eggs and vanilla in a bowl using a handheld mixer.
instructions.2: Add the sugar and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the oil while continuing to mix.
instructions.4: Gradually add the yogurt while continuing to mix.
instructions.5: Sift and then add the flour, baking powder, salt, and cocoa powder.
instructions.6: Mix until you achieve a smooth and even batter.
instructions.7: Heat a pan over low heat and grease it with oil.
instructions.8: Pour a portion of the batter into the pan and cover it.
instructions.9: Flip the cake when steam appears under the lid.
instructions.10: Repeat the process until you have 4 layers of cake.
instructions.11: Let the cake cool for 4–5 hours.
instructions.12: Prepare the chantilly cream by mixing the cream, sugar, and frozen yogurt.
instructions.13: Add cocoa powder or melted chocolate as desired.
instructions.14: Place a cake layer, then drizzle it with a mixture of cocoa and yogurt.
instructions.15: Add a layer of chantilly cream and strawberry pieces.
instructions.16: Repeat until all layers are used.
instructions.17: Cover the cake entirely with chantilly cream.
instructions.18: Garnish the cake with melted chocolate and strawberries.
instructions.19: Refrigerate the cake for at least 4 hours before serving.

fah-608.title: Pineapple Jelly Cake
fah-608.culturalNotes: You can use any type of preserved or fresh fruit to add extra flavor to the cake. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Pour the contents of the pineapple jelly packets into a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 1 cup and 1/4 of boiling water and mix well until the jelly is completely dissolved.
instructions.3: Add 1 cup and 1/4 of cold water and mix again.
instructions.4: Lightly grease a cake pan with vegetable oil.
instructions.5: Arrange pineapple slices at the bottom of the pan, placing one cherry on each slice.
instructions.6: Pour the jelly mixture over the pineapple slices.
instructions.7: Place the pan in the refrigerator until set.
instructions.8: After about 4-5 hours, remove the pan from the refrigerator.
instructions.9: Pour half a cup of hot water over the surface of the pan to help release the cake.
instructions.10: Gently invert the pan onto a serving plate.
instructions.11: Place the cake slice on top of the cake and drizzle with pineapple jam.
instructions.12: Return the cake to the refrigerator until completely set.

fah-609.title: Tuna and Vegetable Layered Cake
fah-609.culturalNotes: You can decorate the cake with colorful vegetables as desired to make it more appealing. This dish can be served at various occasions such as Christmas or gatherings.

instructions.1: Prepare the vegetables: grate the carrots, finely chop the onion, finely chop the green pepper, and squeeze the lemon juice.
instructions.2: Drain the tuna and mix it with the vegetables and mayonnaise, then add the hot pepper paste and salt to taste.
instructions.3: Line a cheesecake pan with toast slices, then spread a layer of the tuna and vegetable mixture.
instructions.4: Add another layer of toast slices, followed by another layer of the tuna and vegetable mixture, and continue alternating until all ingredients are used.
instructions.5: Place a final layer of toast slices on top.
instructions.6: Spread cream cheese over the top of the cake and coat the sides with cream cheese.
instructions.7: Refrigerate the cake for at least two hours.
instructions.8: After removing the cake from the refrigerator, un-mold and serve.
instructions.9: Garnish the cake with grated carrots, cucumber cut into rose shapes, colorful bell peppers, and black olives.

fah-610.title: No-Oven Gateau
fah-610.culturalNotes: This gateau can be served at various occasions such as Christmas or family gatherings. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix liquid milk, raw cocoa powder, milk powder, powdered sugar, and vanilla in a bowl.
instructions.2: Place the mixture on the stove and stir continuously until well combined and thickened.
instructions.3: Add butter and stir until completely melted.
instructions.4: Add grated raw chocolate and stir until fully melted.
instructions.5: Sprinkle the mixture over crushed biscuits and mix until well combined.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture into cupcake molds or a large mold and press firmly.
instructions.7: Cover the molds with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
instructions.8: After chilling, remove from molds and decorate with white chocolate and cherries or strawberries.

fah-611.title: Cottage Cheese
fah-611.culturalNotes: You can use fresh yogurt instead of thickened yogurt to make cottage cheese. Cottage cheese is very beneficial for the stomach and can be served with honey or fruits.

instructions.1: Gently boil the yogurt in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: Cover the pot and leave it in a warm oven for 24 hours.
instructions.3: Strain the thickened yogurt through a colander and add one teaspoon of salt.
instructions.4: Let the cheese sit in the colander until it drains completely.
instructions.5: Cut the cheese into small pieces and serve.
instructions.6: You can use the leftover liquid (whey) to make a drink.

fah-612.title: Farmer Cheese
fah-612.culturalNotes: You can add pieces of red and green peppers to the cheese for a distinctive flavor. The cheese can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one month.

instructions.1: Place the yogurt in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: Add the salt and stir well.
instructions.3: Let the yogurt warm up (do not let it boil).
instructions.4: Remove the pot from the heat and add the rennet.
instructions.5: Stir well and cover the pot.
instructions.6: Let it sit for 4 hours or until completely cooled.
instructions.7: Strain the cheese using a colander and a cheesecloth.
instructions.8: Add salt to the liquid collected from straining and stir well.
instructions.9: Submerge the cheese in the salty water and cover it.
instructions.10: Store the cheese in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

fah-613.title: Fruit Jelly
fah-613.culturalNotes: Any type of fruit available at home can be used. The jelly can be served with a little honey or sugar according to preference.

instructions.1: Gather the available fruits, peel them, and cut into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the fruits into the jello mold.
instructions.3: Dissolve the jello in hot water until fully mixed.
instructions.4: Add the cold water to the dissolved jello and stir well.
instructions.5: Pour the jello mixture over the fruits in the mold.
instructions.6: Place the mold in the refrigerator for 4-5 hours until the jello sets.
instructions.7: Unmold the jello and serve.

fah-614.title: Kola Jelly
fah-614.culturalNotes: You can use different shaped and colored molds to make the jelly more appealing to children. The jelly can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Open the crystal jelly pack.
instructions.2: Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable gelatin powder.
instructions.3: Mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add 1 cup of boiling water and stir until completely dissolved.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into silicone molds.
instructions.6: Place the molds in the refrigerator until set.
instructions.7: Once set, remove from the molds and serve.

fah-615.title: Mango Jelly
fah-615.culturalNotes: Different types of fruit can be used in the jelly layer according to preference. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Prepare the cake: Place the eggs in a bowl, add the vanilla, vinegar, sugar, and salt. Mix well using an electric mixer until the mixture becomes fluffy.
instructions.2: Add the flour and baking powder, and mix on low speed until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into a 30 by 30 cm baking pan and bake in the oven for 10 minutes, or until the cake turns golden brown.
instructions.4: Remove the cake from the oven and flip it to pour the syrup over it.
instructions.5: Prepare the syrup: Mix 1 cup of warm water with 2 tablespoons of honey and stir well. Pour the syrup over the cake and let it absorb completely.
instructions.6: Prepare the pudding: In a bowl, combine the milk, sugar, cornstarch, and vanilla. Mix well. Place the mixture on the stove and stir continuously until it boils and thickens.
instructions.7: Add the crushed cardamom and butter, and mix thoroughly. Pour the pudding over the syrup-soaked cake and let it cool.
instructions.8: Prepare the jelly: In a bowl, add the two packets of Dream Mango Jelly and 1 1/2 cups of hot water. Mix well until the jelly dissolves completely.
instructions.9: Add 1 1/2 cups of ice and mix thoroughly. Cut the mango into medium-sized cubes and add them to the jelly mixture.
instructions.10: Pour the jelly mixture over the pudding layer and place the dish in the refrigerator for 3 hours, or until set.
instructions.11: Serve the dish cold and garnish with fresh mango.

fah-616.title: Sweet Spread
fah-616.culturalNotes: The sweet spread can be stored in jars in the refrigerator for over a month. Serve with sandwiches or as a light dessert.

instructions.1: Mix 1 cup powdered milk and 1 cup powdered sugar in the blender.
instructions.2: Add 1 cup flour and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
instructions.3: Add 1.5 cups of boiling water.
instructions.4: Mix ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into clean and dry jars.

fah-617.title: Sweet Yogurt (Yogurt Pancake with Sugar)
fah-617.culturalNotes: You can add a bit of vanilla for extra flavor if desired. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Place half a kilogram of yogurt in a pan over medium heat with 2 tablespoons of butter and 2 tablespoons of sugar. Stir the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add the phyllo dough and mix well with the yogurt, sugar, and butter.
instructions.3: When the mixture is ready, remove it from the heat and pour it into a serving dish.
instructions.4: Sprinkle with a pinch of powdered sugar and 1 teaspoon of butter.
instructions.5: Begin folding the phyllo dough in a napkin-like pattern.
instructions.6: Return the mixture to the heat for a few minutes until it becomes crispy.
instructions.7: Serve the sweet yogurt warm.

fah-618.title: Cookie Dessert with Jelly and Crème Caramel
fah-618.culturalNotes: Any type of plain tea biscuit or vanilla cake can be used if you don't have Eid biscuits. This dessert can be served in summer as a light treat or during special occasions.

instructions.1: Line the bottom of a pie dish or regular baking pan with biscuits.
instructions.2: Prepare the crème caramel: Mix 2 packets of crème caramel with 1 liter of milk in a pot over medium heat until boiling, then remove from heat.
instructions.3: Pour half of the hot crème caramel over the layer of biscuits.
instructions.4: Let the crème caramel cool slightly, then pour the remaining amount over the biscuits.
instructions.5: Prepare the jelly: Mix 2 packets of strawberry jelly with 1 liter of water in a pot over medium heat until boiling, then remove from heat.
instructions.6: Add 2 cups of cold water to the boiled jelly and stir well.
instructions.7: Let the jelly cool until it reaches room temperature.
instructions.8: Pour the jelly over the crème caramel in the dish.
instructions.9: Place the dish in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or until completely chilled.

fah-619.title: Happiness Dessert
fah-619.culturalNotes: Make sure the gelatin has completely set before pouring the mahlabia on top. The dessert can be served cold and decorated with fruit pieces or chocolate as desired.

instructions.1: Pour 1 cup of boiling water over the Dream Strawberry Gelatin pack and stir well.
instructions.2: Add 1 cup of cold water and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.3: Slice the banana and distribute it into the serving glasses.
instructions.4: Pour the gelatin over the banana after it has cooled slightly, then place the glasses in the refrigerator for a few minutes until the gelatin is fully set.
instructions.5: Mix 1/2 cup of milk with 2 tablespoons of cornstarch and stir well.
instructions.6: Add 2 cups of milk, 3 tablespoons of sugar, and vanilla to the cornstarch mixture, then cook over medium heat, stirring continuously until the mixture thickens.
instructions.7: Crush the Eid biscuits and spread a thin layer over the set gelatin.
instructions.8: Pour the mahlabia mixture over the layer of crushed biscuits.
instructions.9: Place the glasses in the refrigerator until completely chilled.

fah-620.title: Layered Jelly Dessert
fah-620.culturalNotes: Make sure each layer is completely cooled before adding the next layer to achieve clear and beautiful layers. This dessert can be served cold with a little cream or fresh fruit.

instructions.1: Crush the plain biscuits and place them in the mold to form the bottom layer.
instructions.2: Heat half a kilogram of milk on the stove and add one packet of mango pudding, stirring well until it boils, then remove from heat.
instructions.3: Slice the mango and place it on top of the biscuit layer.
instructions.4: Pour the pudding layer over the mango and let it cool completely.
instructions.5: Dissolve strawberry jelly in one cup of boiling water, then add one cup of cold water and let it set in the refrigerator.
instructions.6: Dissolve green apple jelly in one cup of boiling water, then add one cup of cold water and pour it over the set strawberry jelly layer.
instructions.7: Dissolve mango jelly in one cup of boiling water, then add one cup of cold water and pour it over the set green apple jelly layer.
instructions.8: Let the dessert chill in the refrigerator until all layers are fully set.

fah-621.title: Homemade Condensed Milk
fah-621.culturalNotes: Homemade condensed milk can be used in many desserts such as knafeh and baklava. Store condensed milk in an airtight container in the refrigerator for a long time without spoiling.

instructions.1: Prepare the blender or food processor.
instructions.2: Place all ingredients in the blender: 1 cup dried milk powder, 1 cup powdered sugar, 1/4 cup warm water, and 1 tablespoon butter.
instructions.3: Blend ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.4: If the consistency is too thick, you can add an additional tablespoon of water.
instructions.5: Ensure the consistency is smooth and evenly mixed.

fah-622.title: Dannet
fah-622.culturalNotes: Dannet can be served to children when they go to school or club as a light and healthy snack. It can also be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Add milk to a pot and place on the stove.
instructions.2: Add cornstarch and Chantilly cream, stirring continuously.
instructions.3: Add sugar and natural cocoa powder, and stir well.
instructions.4: Add shredded chocolate and stir until completely melted.
instructions.5: Add vanilla and stir once more.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into small cups or bowls.
instructions.7: Let it cool slightly before serving.

fah-623.title: Caramel Danishes
fah-623.culturalNotes: Sugar quantity can be reduced to half a cup or a quarter cup according to preference. Danishes can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one week.

instructions.1: In a saucepan, combine 1 cup sugar and 1/4 cup water, then place on medium heat.
instructions.2: Let the sugar dissolve and turn into caramel without stirring.
instructions.3: When the caramel begins to turn golden, gently shake the pan to ensure even heat distribution.
instructions.4: Add 1/2 cup milk to the caramel and stir gently.
instructions.5: In a separate bowl, mix cornstarch with the remaining cold milk until the starch is completely dissolved.
instructions.6: Gradually add the cornstarch and milk mixture to the saucepan while stirring continuously.
instructions.7: Add butter, heavy cream (if using), and vanilla, and stir until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.8: Cook over medium heat until the mixture boils and thickens.
instructions.9: Pour the mixture into danish molds and let cool.
instructions.10: Once cooled, remove the danishes from the molds and serve.

fah-624.title: Roz bel Laban with Peach Gelatin
fah-624.culturalNotes: You can use other fruits such as blueberries or strawberries instead of peaches. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Place 1 kilogram of whole milk in a pot and put it on the stove.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of well-rinsed rice and let them boil together for a few minutes.
instructions.3: Turn off the heat, cover the pot, and let it sit for one hour until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.4: After one hour, return the mixture to the stove and add half a cup of sugar and a small spoonful of vanilla.
instructions.5: When the rice is fully cooked, take half a cup of cold milk and mix it with a large spoonful of cornstarch until smooth.
instructions.6: Add the cornstarch mixture to the rice on the stove and stir well until thickened.
instructions.7: Prepare serving dishes and fill them halfway with the rice and milk mixture.
instructions.8: Place the dishes in the refrigerator to cool.
instructions.9: In another bowl, dissolve one packet of peach gelatin in a quarter cup of boiling water.
instructions.10: Add a quarter cup of cold, chilled water to cool the mixture.
instructions.11: Wash the peaches thoroughly, dry them, and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.12: Arrange the peach pieces on top of the rice and milk mixture in the dishes.
instructions.13: Pour the gelatin mixture over the peaches.
instructions.14: Place the dishes back in the refrigerator until the gelatin is fully set.
instructions.15: Serve the dish cold.

fah-625.title: Yogurt with Fruits
fah-625.culturalNotes: Different types of fruits such as mango, peach, apricot, carrot, or orange can be used. Jam can also be used instead of fresh fruits.

instructions.1: Chop the strawberries into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the strawberries in a pan and add sugar.
instructions.3: Place the pan on the stove and cook until the strawberries thicken and the liquid evaporates.
instructions.4: Add juice from half a lemon and let it boil for 3 minutes.
instructions.5: Remove the strawberries from the heat and let them cool.
instructions.6: Boil the milk in a pot and let it cool slightly until it becomes warm.
instructions.7: Take a cup of the warm milk and add one cup of yogurt, then mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Pour the yogurt-milk mixture back into the remaining warm milk and mix well.
instructions.9: Place a spoonful of the strawberry mixture at the bottom of each cup.
instructions.10: Fill the cups with the yogurt-milk mixture.
instructions.11: Arrange the cups in a baking dish and place hot water around them.
instructions.12: Place the dish in a preheated oven (closed) for 4 hours.
instructions.13: After 4 hours, remove the cups, cover them, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.

fah-626.title: Homemade Yogurt
fah-626.culturalNotes: Make sure to use high-quality milk and boil it thoroughly to ensure cleanliness. Yogurt can be served with fruits or honey as desired.

instructions.1: Boil 2 kilograms of milk over heat, stirring continuously to prevent dry skin formation.
instructions.2: Turn off the heat, cover the milk, and let it cool slightly until warm.
instructions.3: Add 2 jars of yogurt to the warm milk and stir well until fully mixed.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into serving dishes or bowls and cover them.
instructions.5: Place the dishes into a preheated oven (around 100 degrees Celsius) and bake for 4 hours.
instructions.6: After 4 hours, place the dishes in the refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight to stop bacterial activity.

fah-627.title: Lotus Butter
fah-627.culturalNotes: Butter can be stored in the jar for over a month in the refrigerator. Serve with sandwiches or as a spread.

instructions.1: Blend the cookies in the blender.
instructions.2: Add the cinnamon.
instructions.3: Add the caramel sauce.
instructions.4: Mix the ingredients thoroughly until you achieve a uniform consistency.
instructions.5: Transfer the mixture to a clean and dry jar.

fah-628.title: Clotted Cream Butter and Taameya Bread
fah-628.culturalNotes: Taameya bread can be stored in sealed bags in the freezer and used as needed. Serve the bread with cheese, honey, and clotted cream.

instructions.1: Take the clotted cream from the freezer and let it sit at room temperature.
instructions.2: Blend the clotted cream in a mixer until it turns into butter and oil separates.
instructions.3: Strain the oil and store the butter in a bowl.
instructions.4: Mix flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the remaining clotted cream (the curd) to the flour and knead until the dough becomes firm.
instructions.6: Let the dough rest for one minute.
instructions.7: Heat a taameya griddle on high heat.
instructions.8: Place the dough onto the hot griddle and flip it once.
instructions.9: Cover the bread after removing it from the griddle to keep it soft.

fah-629.title: Sabliya
fah-629.culturalNotes: You can shape sabliya into any form you like. You can also add cocoa to half of the dough to make chocolate sabliya. Sabliya can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Sift the flour twice.
instructions.2: Add the butter and powdered sugar and beat well until the mixture becomes light and creamy.
instructions.3: Add the egg and vanilla and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add the salt and mix.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour and mix until all ingredients are well combined.
instructions.6: Knead the dough lightly, but do not overwork it.
instructions.7: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
instructions.8: Clean and grease your work surface, then roll out the dough between two plastic bags to a thickness of less than half a centimeter.
instructions.9: Use different shaped cutters to cut the dough.
instructions.10: Place the pieces onto a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 12-15 minutes.
instructions.12: Remove from the oven and let cool.
instructions.13: You can decorate sabliya with caramel, jam, or chocolate as desired.

fah-630.title: Melted Chocolate
fah-630.culturalNotes: Make sure the water is warm, not too hot, to prevent chocolate from seizing. This method can be used to melt any type of chocolate easily and quickly.

instructions.1: Chop the white and dark chocolate into small pieces or grate them.
instructions.2: Add 100 grams of white chocolate to a plastic bag with one tablespoon of oil.
instructions.3: Spread the oil over the chocolate inside the bag.
instructions.4: Squeeze out the air from the bag and tie it tightly.
instructions.5: Add 100 grams of dark chocolate to another plastic bag with one tablespoon of oil.
instructions.6: Spread the oil over the chocolate inside the bag.
instructions.7: Squeeze out the air from the bag and tie it tightly.
instructions.8: Submerge both bags in warm water for 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Make sure the chocolate has completely melted.
instructions.10: Open the bag from the side to avoid water getting in.
instructions.11: Pour the melted chocolate into a bowl and use it for decorating.

fah-631.title: Toffee Sauce
fah-631.culturalNotes: The sauce can be used to garnish cakes, cinnamon rolls, and donuts. It can be stored in the refrigerator for a long time.

instructions.1: Place the cup of sugar and quarter cup of water in a saucepan over heat.
instructions.2: Gently shake the saucepan until the sugar dissolves and turns golden.
instructions.3: Once it turns golden, add the can of whipping cream and stir until well combined.
instructions.4: Gradually add half cup of yogurt according to desired consistency.
instructions.5: Simmer the sauce on low heat until it reaches the desired thickness.
instructions.6: Once cooled, transfer the sauce to a bowl, cover it, and refrigerate.

fah-632.title: Kunafa
fah-632.culturalNotes: You can add nuts, cream, or caramel sauce on top of kunafa before serving for extra flavor. Kunafa can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil the macaroni in hot water without oil or salt until cooked.
instructions.2: Add milk and sugar to the blender and mix well.
instructions.3: Mix cornstarch and Chantilly cream in a cup of milk.
instructions.4: Add the boiled macaroni to the milk and sugar mixture in the blender and blend together.
instructions.5: Transfer the mixture to a pot and cook over medium heat. Add egg yolks, vanilla, Chantilly cream, and cornstarch. Stir continuously until it boils and thickens.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a buttered baking dish and spread evenly.
instructions.7: Let it cool completely for 2 hours.
instructions.8: Bake in the oven at 180°C for 30 minutes or until the top turns golden brown.
instructions.9: Let the kunafa cool completely before cutting.
instructions.10: Add nuts, cream, or caramel sauce on top as desired.

fah-633.title: Making Labneh from Milk and Yogurt
fah-633.culturalNotes: Labneh can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 3-4 days. The liquid drained from labneh can be used in dough for pastries, sambosas, and pizza.

instructions.1: Place milk in a pot over heat and stir continuously until it boils.
instructions.2: Remove milk from heat and let it cool slightly until warm.
instructions.3: Add yogurt to the warm milk and stir well until fully combined.
instructions.4: Place the mixture in a closed, warm oven for 4 hours.
instructions.5: After 4 hours, transfer the mixture to the refrigerator for another 4 hours.
instructions.6: Strain the mixture through a clean cloth and let it drain completely; you can place a heavy plate on top of the cloth to speed up the straining process.
instructions.7: Add salt to the labneh after straining and mix well.
instructions.8: Serve labneh with thyme or tomatoes and olives as desired.

fah-634.title: French Toast with Pudding
fah-634.culturalNotes: Brown sugar can be used instead of white sugar, and one tablespoon of black honey can be added for flavor. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

fah-634-i1.name: Toast or croissant or French bread

instructions.1: Spread half the butter (1/4 cup) in the baking dish and sprinkle 1/2 cup of sugar on the bottom.
instructions.2: Arrange slices of toast, croissant, or French bread in the baking dish.
instructions.3: In a blender, mix the eggs with the milk, remaining sugar (1/4 cup), remaining butter (1/4 cup), vanilla, and salt until well combined.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture over the bread slices in the dish.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to 220°C and place the dish in the middle rack until golden and set (about 30 minutes).
instructions.6: Garnish the dish after removing from the oven with vanilla ice cream, strawberries, chopped nuts, and caramel sauce to taste.

fah-635.title: Qishra
fah-635.culturalNotes: Fresh yogurt can be used instead of dried yogurt for similar results. Qishra remains usable for up to two weeks if stored in the refrigerator.

instructions.1: Boil the yogurt in a pot over low heat until it simmers.
instructions.2: Cover the pot and leave it in a warm oven for 24 hours.
instructions.3: Strain the dried yogurt through a sieve and sprinkle 1 teaspoon of salt over it.
instructions.4: Let the strained yogurt (cottage cheese) sit in the sieve to dry for 24 hours.
instructions.5: Mix the red pepper and ground cumin with the dried yogurt in a blender.
instructions.6: Add the cottage cheese to the blended mixture.
instructions.7: Serve the qishra with honey to taste.

fah-636.title: Raisin and Nut Cupcakes
fah-636.culturalNotes: You can use regular milk instead of thick yogurt. When preparing the chantilly cream, make sure not to add too much liquid so the cream stays firm.

instructions.1: Mix sugar, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl and beat with an electric mixer until the mixture turns pale and creamy.
instructions.2: Add butter and oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add yogurt and mix again.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix flour with salt and baking powder.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg and oil mixture, stirring slowly until ingredients are well combined.
instructions.6: Mix raisins and nuts with one teaspoon of flour, then fold into the batter gently.
instructions.7: Fill cupcake molds with two-thirds of the batter.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Reduce temperature to 160°C and continue baking for 10 more minutes.
instructions.10: Remove cupcakes from the oven and let them cool.
instructions.11: Garnish cupcakes with chantilly cream as desired.

fah-637.title: Oat Cookies with Raisins
fah-637.culturalNotes: You can reduce the sugar amount according to preference. You can use different types of nuts depending on availability and personal taste. This recipe is very beneficial for both children and adults.

instructions.1: Mix sugar and butter in a bowl until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.2: Add eggs and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.3: Add black honey and mix again.
instructions.4: Add cinnamon, baking powder, and salt and mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add sifted flour and mix until the dough is well combined.
instructions.6: Add oats and mix gently.
instructions.7: Add raisins and nuts and mix until evenly distributed.
instructions.8: Preheat oven to 160 degrees Celsius.
instructions.9: Shape cookies onto a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.10: Bake cookies for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let cookies cool slightly before serving.

fah-638.title: Coconut Cookies
fah-638.culturalNotes: Cookies can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Cream the butter and powdered sugar in a bowl using an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla, and mix well until fully combined.
instructions.3: In a separate bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, and coconut.
instructions.4: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and mix until a uniform dough forms.
instructions.5: Dust your work surface with flour and roll out the dough to about 1/2 cm thickness.
instructions.6: Use a cookie cutter to shape the dough.
instructions.7: Place the cookies on a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.8: Sprinkle granulated sugar on top of each cookie.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.10: Let the cookies cool slightly before serving.

fah-639.title: Fruit Jelly Cake
fah-639.culturalNotes: Make sure the chantilly cream is well-set before spreading it on the cake to prevent the jelly from sinking. You can use any type of fruit according to preference.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
instructions.2: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.3: In another bowl, beat eggs with vanilla and sugar until the mixture turns white.
instructions.4: Add oil and yogurt and mix well.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture and mix until smooth.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into a greased and floured baking pan.
instructions.7: Bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.8: In a bowl, boil 2 cups of water and add two packets of jelly, stirring until dissolved.
instructions.9: Add 1 cup of cold water and mix well, then let the mixture cool.
instructions.10: Whip the chantilly cream and spread it over the cake.
instructions.11: Place chopped fruits on top of the chantilly cream.
instructions.12: Pour the cooled jelly over the fruits.
instructions.13: Refrigerate the cake for 4-5 hours until set.

fah-640.title: Hot Milk Cake
fah-640.culturalNotes: You can add dried fruits as desired. The cake can be served warm or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and baking powder thoroughly.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the oil, butter, and sugar for two minutes.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla, salt, and vinegar, and mix well.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture while continuing to mix.
instructions.6: Add the hot milk and mix until the batter is smooth and well combined.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.8: Wash a 26 cm baking pan, grease it with butter, and lightly dust with flour.
instructions.9: Pour the batter into the pan, making sure it does not exceed half the pan.
instructions.10: Place the pan in the middle rack of the oven and bake for 45 minutes.
instructions.11: Insert a wooden skewer into the center of the cake; if it comes out clean, the cake is done.

fah-641.title: Quick Chocolate Cake in the Microwave
fah-641.culturalNotes: The cake can be served with a glass of milk or tea.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and oil, and mix the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Add the baking powder and cocoa powder, and mix again.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.5: Dollop the center of the mixture with 1 large tablespoon of melted chocolate.
instructions.6: Place the bowl in the microwave and cook for 2 minutes.
instructions.7: Remove from the microwave and serve with a spoonful of chocolate.

fah-642.title: Ten-Minute Cake
fah-642.culturalNotes: Serve the cake with tea or coffee. Make sure the cake is completely cooled before slicing to avoid crumbling.

instructions.1: Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature.
instructions.2: Mix the eggs, yogurt, oil, vanilla, and salt in the blender.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and mix the ingredients thoroughly for 1 or 2 minutes.
instructions.4: Sift the flour with baking powder and gradually add it to the liquid mixture. Mix using a hand mixer in one direction.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius and grease a 26 cm cake pan.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into the pan and reserve two large spoonfuls of batter.
instructions.7: Mix the two large spoonfuls of batter with 1 tablespoon of raw cocoa powder. Add 2 tablespoons of milk if the mixture is too thick.
instructions.8: Transfer the mixture to a piping bag and pipe vertical and horizontal lines onto the cake surface.
instructions.9: Bake the cake in the middle rack of the oven for 45 minutes.
instructions.10: Check the cake after 35 minutes using a toothpick. If it comes out clean, the cake is ready.
instructions.11: Let the cake cool completely before slicing.

fah-643.title: Cold Crème Caramel Cake
fah-643.culturalNotes: You can use any type of biscuit you prefer. You can also add a little vanilla for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Crush the biscuits into large pieces.
instructions.2: Take 1 kilogram of cold milk and pour the crème caramel pack into it.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons of instant coffee, 2 tablespoons of raw cocoa, 2 tablespoons of cornstarch, and 2 tablespoons of sugar.
instructions.4: Stir the ingredients well into the cold milk.
instructions.5: Place the mixture on the stove and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and continue stirring until the consistency becomes thick.
instructions.6: Remove from heat and pour the mixture over the crushed biscuits in a glass dish.
instructions.7: Cover the dish and place it in the refrigerator until chilled.
instructions.8: Once chilled, invert the cake onto a serving plate and sprinkle raw cocoa on top.
instructions.9: Serve the cake cold.

fah-644.title: No-Oven Cake
fah-644.culturalNotes: You can serve the cake as is, or decorate it with chocolate sauce or any other sauce of your choice. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix the eggs with vanilla and sugar thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt and mix well until smooth.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder, cocoa powder, and salt. Mix dry ingredients with wet ingredients until fully combined.
instructions.5: Lightly grease the cake pan with oil. If using an aluminum pan, grease it with butter and lightly dust with flour.
instructions.6: Pour the cake batter into the pan, making sure it does not exceed half the pan's height.
instructions.7: Place the pan inside a larger pot filled with boiling water, ensuring the water level does not exceed one-third of the pan.
instructions.8: Cover the pot with a kitchen towel, then close with the lid. Cook over medium heat for 40 minutes.
instructions.9: After 40 minutes, check the cake's doneness by inserting a wooden skewer into the center. If it comes out clean, the cake is fully baked.
instructions.10: Remove the cake from the pot and let it cool slightly, then invert it onto a flat surface.
instructions.11: Serve the cake warm or cold, and decorate with chocolate sauce or any other sauce of your choice.

fah-645.title: Marbled Mousse Cake Without Oven
fah-645.culturalNotes: You can use different types of biscuits according to preference. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix milk, sugar, raw cocoa, cornstarch, caramel cream dream, raw chocolate, and instant coffee in a bowl.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Cook the mixture over medium heat until it starts boiling, stirring constantly.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into cake molds and place pieces of plain tea biscuits inside.
instructions.5: Cover the molds and refrigerate for 5-6 hours until set.
instructions.6: After setting, remove the molds and invert them onto a bowl of hot water to help release the cake easily.
instructions.7: Serve the cake chilled.

fah-646.title: Chocolate Oat Cake for Diet
fah-646.culturalNotes: Vegetable oil can be used instead of coconut oil. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix cocoa powder with oat flour, baking soda, baking powder, and Sweetal sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add low-fat yogurt, vinegar, and coconut oil to the dry ingredients and stir well.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into muffin cups until half full.
instructions.4: Place the muffin cups in a pot with boiling water, ensuring the water level does not exceed one-third of the muffin cups' height.
instructions.5: Cover the pot with a clean cloth, then with the lid.
instructions.6: Let the cake bake for 3 hours.
instructions.7: After 3 hours, check the cake's doneness with a wooden skewer.
instructions.8: Prepare the chocolate sauce by mixing 1 cup dark chocolate with ½ cup low-fat warm milk.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce over the baked cake.
instructions.10: Garnish the cake with sliced strawberries and kiwi as desired.

fah-647.title: Quick Biscuit Cake Without Oven
fah-647.culturalNotes: You can add chocolate chips or dried fruits as desired for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Crush the biscuits until finely ground.
instructions.2: Bring out the milk.
instructions.3: Add the flour to the crushed biscuit mixture.
instructions.4: Add the cocoa, sugar, and baking powder.
instructions.5: Mix the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture into a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.7: Heat the mixture in the microwave for exactly 1 minute.
instructions.8: Remove the cake from the microwave and serve warm.

fah-648.title: Mango Jelly Cake
fah-648.culturalNotes: The cake can be served with a little fresh mango or other fruits as desired. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with vanilla and sugar until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.2: Add the flour, baking powder, and salt, and stir until the flour is completely incorporated.
