instructions.4: Cover the dough with plastic wrap or a clean cloth and let it rise for 30 minutes, or until it doubles in size.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls and roll each into an oval shape.
instructions.6: Brush the dough with butter and place a spoonful of filling in the center.
instructions.7: Seal the filling well and roll the dough into a spiral.
instructions.8: Place the pancakes in an oiled baking tray or one lined with parchment paper, with the seam side down.
instructions.9: Let the pancakes rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the pancakes with a mixture of egg, milk, and vinegar.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 220 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove the pancakes from the oven, brush them with butter, and sprinkle with oregano.
instructions.13: Serve the pancakes hot with mint tea.

fah-719.title: Flaky Pastries with Various Fillings
fah-719.culturalNotes: You can use any filling you prefer, such as cheese and pastirma, ground meat, or vegetables. Make sure the filling is flat and free of liquid to prevent leakage during cooking. Serve these pastries for breakfast or dinner.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, sugar, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the vinegar, oil, and warm water, then knead until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes, or until it doubles in size.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into small balls and roll each ball out using a rolling pin.
instructions.5: Place the filling in the center of each pastry and seal the edges tightly.
instructions.6: Place the pastries in a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.7: Let the pastries rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Prepare a mixture of milk powder, instant coffee, sugar, and water, then brush it over the pastries.
instructions.9: Place a sesame seed, a piece of butter, or a stuffed olive in the center of each pastry.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.11: Remove the pastries from the oven and serve hot.

fah-720.title: Stuffed Chicken Pastries
fah-720.culturalNotes: You can use different fillings such as tuna or cheese according to preference. The pastries can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add yogurt and warm water, then knead until well combined.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for 5 minutes, then add oil and knead for an additional 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
instructions.5: In another bowl, heat oil and sauté onions until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add chopped chicken and spices, then stir until cooked through.
instructions.7: Add yogurt, mayonnaise, and ketchup, and mix well.
instructions.8: Let the filling cool slightly.
instructions.9: Divide the dough into 12 equal balls.
instructions.10: Roll each ball on a floured surface into a thin, round shape.
instructions.11: Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each round and fold to seal as desired.
instructions.12: Lightly grease a griddle with oil and cook the pastries until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.13: Serve hot.

fah-721.title: Puffed Cheese Pancakes
fah-721.culturalNotes: These pancakes can be served with yogurt tea or as a breakfast or dinner meal. The filling can be customized as desired, but must remain flat.

instructions.1: Mix the all-purpose flour, semolina flour, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm water until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for a few minutes until it becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into balls the size of a large lemon.
instructions.6: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each ball out with flour until very thin.
instructions.8: Brush the surface with melted butter.
instructions.9: Fold the top and bottom edges together and place the filling in the center.
instructions.10: Seal the edges tightly.
instructions.11: Heat the pan over medium heat and add a little oil.
instructions.12: Place the pancakes in the pan and cook, flipping occasionally, until puffed and golden brown on both sides.

fah-722.title: Quick Layered Pancakes
fah-722.culturalNotes: Make sure the butter is soft or slightly melted when spreading it on the dough, and ensure the dough is rolled out very thin to guarantee proper layering of the pancakes.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, oil, vanilla, vinegar, sugar, and egg in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the flour and salt while continuing to mix until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until it becomes soft and elastic.
instructions.4: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
instructions.5: After the dough has risen, roll it out into a very thin rectangle.
instructions.6: Brush the dough with soft or slightly melted butter.
instructions.7: Roll the dough into a log shape, then cut it into equal-sized pieces.
instructions.8: Cut each piece in half through the center and fold the two ends inward.
instructions.9: Arrange the pancakes in an oiled baking tray.
instructions.10: Let the pancakes rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush the tops of the pancakes with a mixture of egg, milk, vinegar, and sugar.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve the pancakes warm with tea, cheese, or jam.

fah-723.title: Crispy Cheese and Olive Pies
fah-723.culturalNotes: You can use different types of cheese according to preference. Serve the pies with mint tea or any other beverage.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, powdered milk, baking powder, salt, sugar, and yeast in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the oil and warm water, then knead until the dough becomes firm and soft.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour until it rises and doubles in size.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into small balls and roll each ball flat using a rolling pin.
instructions.5: Place the filling (cheddar cheese, grated cheese, double cream cheese, and green olives) in the center of each pie and seal them well.
instructions.6: Lightly grease the baking tray with oil and arrange the pies, leaving space between them.
instructions.7: Let the pies rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Whisk the egg and vinegar together in a bowl, then brush the mixture over the pies.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 15–20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.10: Sprinkle sesame seeds on the pies before placing them in the oven.

fah-724.title: Turkish Pide Fritters
fah-724.culturalNotes: You can add thyme or any other spices to taste. The fritters can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Prepare the starter: Mix 1 cup flour, 1 cup water, and 1 large spoon of yeast in a bowl. Cover the bowl and let it rest in the refrigerator for 4–5 hours or overnight.
instructions.2: After the resting period, mix the starter with 2 cups flour, 1 small spoon sugar, 1 small spoon salt, and 1/3 cup water. Knead until the dough becomes soft and smooth.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons olive oil to the dough and knead again until it becomes soft and elastic.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise until it doubles in size.
instructions.5: Prepare the filling: Cut the sausage into small pieces and sauté in 1 tablespoon oil for 2–3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.
instructions.6: Shape the fritters: Roll out the dough on a floured surface. Place the filling (sausage and cheese) in the center and seal tightly.
instructions.7: Place the fritters on an oiled baking tray and let them rest for a few minutes.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat (200°C) for 10–15 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Remove from oven and lightly brush with olive oil to give a shiny finish and rich flavor.

fah-725.title: Turkish Pocket Pastries
fah-725.culturalNotes: These pastries can be frozen for up to one month. Serve with your favorite fillings.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and half a teaspoon of sugar in warm water and let it sit for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, oil, eggs, vinegar, and remaining sugar to the water and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the flour, baking powder, and salt and knead until the dough becomes firm.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes until it rises.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into 20-24 pieces and shape them into balls.
instructions.6: Cover the balls and let them rest for 5 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each piece on a floured surface greased with oil and butter until thin.
instructions.8: Brush the top side with oil and butter, fold it in half, then fold it in half again.
instructions.9: Place the pastries in an oiled baking tray and let them rise again.
instructions.10: Prepare a mixture of dried yogurt powder, sugar, Nescafe, and water, and brush it onto the top of each pastry.
instructions.11: Sprinkle sesame seeds and poppy seeds on top of the pastries.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Cover the pastries with a towel after removing from the oven and store in a plastic bag in the freezer.

fah-726.title: Happy Fritters with Various Fillings
fah-726.culturalNotes: You can use other fillings as desired, such as cheese or ground meat. The fritters can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and water, and knead the ingredients until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into small balls, making an even number.
instructions.5: Roll out each ball and place the filling in the center, then fold to close.
instructions.6: Prepare the first filling: mash the boiled potatoes, add the hard-boiled egg, salt, spices, pepper, and parsley. Mix well.
instructions.7: For the second filling: wash the dates and black dates, add ghee and toasted sesame seeds, and cook over low heat until all moisture evaporates.
instructions.8: Heat a little oil in a pan and fry the fritters on both sides until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve the fritters hot.

fah-727.title: Fattaire el Tase
fah-727.culturalNotes: You can freeze the fattaire after cooling them and use later. You can also shape the fattaire into any form you prefer, whether round or square.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the warm water, warm yogurt, sugar, and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until bubbly.
instructions.3: Add the liquid mixture to the flour along with the vinegar, yogurt, and 1/2 cup of oil. Knead well until the dough becomes firm and smooth.
instructions.4: Let the dough rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small balls, about the size of an egg.
instructions.6: Roll each ball into a thin circle, about 1/2 centimeter thick.
instructions.7: Fill the fattaire with cheese, olives, leftover chicken, or any filling you prefer.
instructions.8: Close the fattaire and press the edges firmly with a fork.
instructions.9: Let the fattaire rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Heat the pan over medium heat and lightly grease with oil.
instructions.11: Fry the fattaire for 4 minutes on each side until golden brown.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-728.title: Amazing Pan-Fried Pockets
fah-728.culturalNotes: You can fill the pockets with cheese, olives, spiced chicken, nutella, or a mixture of sugar, cinnamon, and cocoa. You can also freeze the pockets after cooling them and use later.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the warm water, warm yogurt, sugar, and yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes until the yeast activates.
instructions.3: Add the water-yogurt mixture to the flour and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the plain yogurt, vinegar, and 1 cup of oil. Knead until the dough is smooth.
instructions.5: Let the dough rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into small balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each ball with a rolling pin until about 0.5 cm thick.
instructions.8: Fill the pockets with cheese or your favorite filling.
instructions.9: Close the pockets and make sure the edges are tightly sealed with a fork.
instructions.10: Heat the pan over medium heat and lightly grease with oil.
instructions.11: Fry the pockets for 4 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-729.title: Cheese and Cream Pastries
fah-729.culturalNotes: The pastries can be shaped into different sizes according to preference. Adding a pinch of salt and pepper on top before baking enhances the flavor. The pastries can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with sugar, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the yogurt while stirring until the dough comes together.
instructions.3: Add the butter and oil, then knead the dough for 7 minutes until soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 1 hour in a warm place.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into 6 pieces and roll each into a circle about 4 mm thick.
instructions.6: Place a spoonful of cream cheese in the center of each and fold the edges over to seal.
instructions.7: Place the pastries on a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.8: Brush the tops with beaten egg and bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 15–20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.9: Remove from the oven and serve warm with cream, honey, or jam as desired.

fah-730.title: Sausage Turnovers
fah-730.culturalNotes: You can add tomato and sweet pepper slices on top of the turnovers before baking to enhance their appearance.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add warm water and knead until the dough becomes soft and firm.
instructions.3: Add 1/2 cup of oil and mix thoroughly for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes until it doubles in size.
instructions.5: In another bowl, mix the onion, hot pepper, green pepper, garlic, and tomatoes.
instructions.6: Add the ground meat, lamb, flour, spices, and mix well.
instructions.7: Repeat the previous steps to prepare the sausage and chicken filling.
instructions.8: Divide the dough into small balls and roll them out.
instructions.9: Place the filling in the center of each turnover and seal tightly.
instructions.10: Arrange the turnovers in an oiled baking tray and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Sprinkle mixed cheese on top of the turnovers just before removing them from the oven.
instructions.12: Serve hot with red onion salad.

fah-731.title: Chicken Turnovers
fah-731.culturalNotes: Serve the turnovers with red onion salad, parsley, and tomatoes. The turnovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the warm water and knead until the dough becomes soft and firm.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of oil and mix thoroughly for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
instructions.5: In another bowl, mix the onion, hot pepper, green pepper, yellow pepper, garlic, and tomatoes.
instructions.6: Add the ground meat, tomato paste, salt, and spices, and mix well.
instructions.7: Repeat the previous steps to prepare the sausage and chicken fillings, adding the appropriate spices to each.
instructions.8: Divide the dough into small balls and roll them out.
instructions.9: Place the filling in the center of each turnover and seal tightly.
instructions.10: Arrange the turnovers on an oiled baking tray and bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Sprinkle the mixed cheese on top of the turnovers 2 minutes before the cooking time ends.

fah-732.title: Coffee-Filled Pastries
fah-732.culturalNotes: You can store the pastries in an airtight plastic bag for up to 3 days. You can serve the pastries with karak tea for a better taste.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the eggs, yogurt, and warm water, and knead the ingredients thoroughly for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Gradually add the butter and continue kneading for another 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with a clean cloth and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
instructions.5: While the dough rises, mix the powdered sugar, melted butter, vanilla, instant coffee, flour, and cornstarch to prepare the topping.
instructions.6: After the dough has risen, divide it into small balls (about 60 grams each).
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a circle, place a small piece of butter in the center, then fold the edges to form the pastries.
instructions.8: Cover the pastries with a clean cloth and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Place the pastries in a greased baking tray and let them rise again in a warm oven for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Bake the pastries in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 15–20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.11: Remove the pastries from the oven and serve them with caramel sauce.

fah-733.title: Kunafa Fritters
fah-733.culturalNotes: You can add cinnamon to the filling for a distinctive flavor. The fritters can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the water while stirring until you get a light dough.
instructions.3: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over medium heat and add 2 drops of oil.
instructions.5: Add a small amount of dough to the pan and let it set.
instructions.6: Flip the dough to the other side until golden brown.
instructions.7: Place the caramelized kunafa, butter, sugar, and nuts on half of the fritter.
instructions.8: Fold the other half of the fritter over the filling and gently press it down.
instructions.9: Cook until both sides are golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve hot.

fah-734.title: Meat Turnovers
fah-734.culturalNotes: Serve turnovers with red onion salad, parsley, and tomatoes. Turnovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: In a mixer, combine 2 kilograms of flour with 2 tablespoons of sugar, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 2 tablespoons of yeast.
instructions.2: Gradually add warm water until the dough comes together and becomes soft.
instructions.3: Add 1/2 cup of oil and knead for 10 minutes until well combined.
instructions.4: Place the dough in a large oiled bowl, turn to coat all sides, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: In a bowl, mix 1/2 kilogram of onion, 1 hot pepper, 2 green peppers, 6–7 garlic cloves, and 2 tomatoes.
instructions.6: Add 1/2 kilogram of ground beef, 1 tablespoon of tahini, salt, pepper, and meat spices. Mix well.
instructions.7: In another bowl, mix 1/2 kilogram of onion, 1 hot pepper, 2 green peppers, 1/2 cup of local sausage, 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of cumin, and 1/2 teaspoon of dried dill. Mix well.
instructions.8: In a separate bowl, mix 1/2 kilogram of onion, 1/4 kilogram of bell peppers, 6 garlic cloves, 1/2 kilogram of chicken breast, 1 tablespoon of salt, 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika, black pepper, and chicken spices. Mix well.
instructions.9: Divide the dough into small balls the size of a small orange, cover, and let rest for 5 minutes.
instructions.10: Roll each ball into a thin circle dusted with flour, place filling in the center, and seal the turnover tightly.
instructions.11: Arrange turnovers on an oiled baking tray and bake in a preheated hot oven for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Remove from oven, sprinkle cheese on top, and return to oven until cheese melts.

fah-735.title: Sweet and Savory Fattoush
fah-735.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is well-kneaded and smooth before shaping the pies. Bake the pies in a very hot oven to ensure they are flaky and soft on the inside.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add water until the dough becomes firm.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into 12 pieces and shape them into balls.
instructions.5: Place the balls in a greased tray and cover with plastic wrap. Let rest for 1 hour.
instructions.6: After one hour, roll each ball into a rectangle and cut each in half.
instructions.7: Place the filling (meat and cheese) on half of each rectangle and fold over.
instructions.8: Repeat the steps until all balls are used.
instructions.9: Place the pies on an ungreased baking tray and put them in the hot oven.
instructions.10: Bake until golden brown.
instructions.11: For sweet pies, mix yogurt with custard, vanilla, and raisins.
instructions.12: Roll out the dough, add the filling, and fold.
instructions.13: Place the pies in the oven and bake until golden brown.
instructions.14: After removing the pies from the oven, brush them with white honey or syrup.
instructions.15: Sprinkle powdered sugar over the sweet pies.

fah-736.title: Sham El Nessim Fatair (Mangauhina)
fah-736.culturalNotes: You can shape the fatair into various forms according to preference. You can also brush the fatair with white honey or jam after baking for a delicious taste.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with a little warm milk and 1 tablespoon of sugar, and let it sit until frothy.
instructions.2: In a bowl, mix the flour with baking powder, salt, and dried milk powder.
instructions.3: Add the butter and oil, and mix with the flour until it resembles sand grains.
instructions.4: Add the eggs, a pinch of vanilla, vinegar, the remaining sugar, and the rest of the warm milk, and knead thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add the yogurt or thick yogurt, and knead for 7 to 10 minutes until the dough becomes soft and smooth.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise for 1 to 2 hours.
instructions.7: After the first rise, punch down the dough to release air, cover again, and let it rise a second time for 1 hour.
instructions.8: Divide the dough into small portions and shape them into your preferred forms (such as round balls or spirals).
instructions.9: Place the shaped fatair into an oiled baking tray and let them rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Prepare the glaze by mixing the dried milk powder, Nescafe, sugar, and water, then brush it onto the tops of the fatair.
instructions.11: Bake the fatair in a preheated oven at 200°C until golden brown.
instructions.12: Turn off the oven and turn on the convection fan to help achieve even browning on top.
instructions.13: Leave the fatair in the oven for 7 to 10 minutes more until they become crispy and golden.

fah-737.title: Pizza-Style Triangle Pastries with Amazing Dough
fah-737.culturalNotes: You can use different types of cheese and fillings according to preference. Serve the pastries with a warm drink for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with yeast, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the egg and cream, and mix well.
instructions.3: Slowly add the warm water and knead until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into balls the size of a large egg.
instructions.6: Roll each ball into a thin circle.
instructions.7: Cut the circle into strips without reaching the edges.
instructions.8: Place the filling in the center of the circle and fold the strips to form a triangle.
instructions.9: Place the triangles on a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.10: Let the pastries rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush the tops of the pastries with a mixture of egg and milk.
instructions.12: Sprinkle sesame seeds as desired.
instructions.13: Bake in a preheated oven at 220 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes.
instructions.14: Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.

fah-738.title: Stuffed Cheese and Romano Fattoush
fah-738.culturalNotes: You can freeze the fattoush after cooling them in freezer bags and reheat in the oven or microwave as needed. You can also change the filling according to preference.

instructions.1: Mix salt, sugar, and yeast into the flour.
instructions.2: Add yogurt and oil, and mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add warm water until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until soft and elastic.
instructions.5: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rise until doubled in size.
instructions.6: Fill the fattoush with cheese, romano, and olives.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into small balls and roll each into a flat circle using a rolling pin.
instructions.8: Place the filling in the center of each dough circle and seal tightly.
instructions.9: Place the fattoush on a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.10: Brush the tops of the fattoush with the mixture of powdered milk, water, sugar, and Nescafe.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven on the bottom rack for 10–15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: Cut the fattoush with scissors after baking to create an attractive shape.

fah-739.title: Fattair Fried with Chicken and Cheese
fah-739.culturalNotes: The filling can be adjusted to preference, such as adding ground meat or cheese alone with peppers and parsley. Fattair can also be baked in the oven after lightly browning them on the bottom.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast, sugar, and salt in the warm milk and let sit for 10 minutes until the yeast begins to activate.
instructions.2: Add the oil to the yeast mixture and stir well.
instructions.3: Gradually add the flour and knead until you get a soft, non-sticky dough.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: In another bowl, sauté the onion and bell peppers in a little oil until the onion becomes translucent.
instructions.6: Add the chicken pieces and stir until cooked through.
instructions.7: Add salt, pepper, oregano, cinnamon, and hot sauce or ketchup, and mix well.
instructions.8: Let the filling cool down.
instructions.9: Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each piece out using a fork.
instructions.10: Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each piece and fold the fattair into the desired shape.
instructions.11: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the fattair until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.12: Serve the fattair hot.

fah-740.title: Eastern Flatbread
fah-740.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is very soft before rolling out, and use oil to prevent sticking. You can serve the flatbreads plain or stuffed with your favorite fillings.

instructions.1: Mix 1 kilogram of flour with a pinch of salt and a pinch of sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add water until the dough comes together and becomes firm.
instructions.3: Knead the dough on a floured surface until smooth.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into small balls, each about 100 grams.
instructions.5: Dip each ball in oil and place in a bowl, then let them rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll out the rested dough into thin, translucent circles, using oil on your hands and the surface.
instructions.7: Spread a spoonful of butter over each rolled-out piece, then cut and fold into easy-to-eat shapes.
instructions.8: Bake the flatbreads in a preheated oven at high heat until golden brown.
instructions.9: You can fill the flatbreads with your favorite fillings such as spinach, cheese, mozzarella, or feta.
instructions.10: Serve the flatbreads warm with honey or powdered sugar to taste.

fah-741.title: Shredded Fattoush Without Oven
fah-741.culturalNotes: Fattoush can be served with honey or aged cheese. The flatbreads can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix flour, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add water and knead until the dough becomes soft and elastic.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into 3 equal balls.
instructions.5: Roll each ball on a floured surface until very thin.
instructions.6: Prepare the brushing mixture by combining butter, oil, cornstarch, and baking powder, and mix well.
instructions.7: Brush the rolled-out dough with the mixture.
instructions.8: Cut the dough into 4 pieces using a knife.
instructions.9: Fold the dough as shown in the video.
instructions.10: Roll out the folded dough again until very thin.
instructions.11: Cook the flatbread on a hot skillet over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.12: Cover the flatbreads after cooking to retain moisture.

fah-742.title: Quick Crumbled Phyllo
fah-742.culturalNotes: Ftir Meshaltet can be served with honey or cucumber and honey, according to preference. The ftir can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: In a deep bowl, mix the cream, butter, and baking powder thoroughly.
instructions.2: Put two tablespoons of ghee into the baking dish and spread it evenly.
instructions.3: Start by laying one sheet of phyllo in the dish and brush it with the mixture.
instructions.4: Repeat the previous step with each phyllo sheet, making sure to brush every sheet or every other sheet.
instructions.5: After placing all the phyllo sheets, cover the top and bottom with intact sheets, and place one in the middle if any sheets are broken.
instructions.6: Brush the top with the remaining ghee.
instructions.7: Bake in the oven at 200°C for 10 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.8: Cover the ftir with aluminum foil for 5 minutes after removing it from the oven to help retain moisture.

fah-743.title: Spicy Rolled Phyllo Pie
fah-743.culturalNotes: The filling can be customized as desired, such as using meat, chicken, or custard with nuts. The pies can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Chop the cheese, bell peppers, olives, and pastirma to your preference.
instructions.2: Prepare the secret mixture: Mix the butter, sour cream, yogurt, and baking powder thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Roll out one phyllo sheet and brush half of it with the secret mixture.
instructions.4: Fold the sheet in half.
instructions.5: Place the filling on the open half of the sheet.
instructions.6: Fold the sheet over the filling and seal the edges tightly.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.8: Place the pie into the hot oil and fry on both sides until golden brown.
instructions.9: Repeat steps 3 to 7 to make additional pies.
instructions.10: Serve the pies hot.

fah-744.title: Sweet Stuffed Phyllo Pastry
fah-744.culturalNotes: Different fillings can be used based on preference, such as nuts or dates. The pastries can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Chop the cheese, parsley, olives, and colorful bell peppers into small pieces.
instructions.2: Mix the phyllo dough: Combine the butter, whipped cream, yogurt, and baking powder thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.3: Prepare the pastry: Unroll one sheet of phyllo dough and brush half of it with the mixture, then fold the other half over it.
instructions.4: Place the filling on the open half of the pastry and seal the edges tightly.
instructions.5: Repeat the previous steps to make additional pastries.
instructions.6: Fry the pastries: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the pastries until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.7: For the sweet version: Follow the same steps using a filling of custard, sugar, and cinnamon, then drizzle with white honey or sprinkle powdered sugar before serving.

fah-745.title: Abu Haty Fattoush
fah-745.culturalNotes: You can use any type of cheese and meat available in your fridge. You can add your favorite vegetables to the filling. The fattoush can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours before cooking.

instructions.1: Chop the pepper and tomatoes into small pieces and remove seeds from the tomatoes.
instructions.2: Add the chopped sausage and pastirma to the filling.
instructions.3: Add the chopped cheese and mozzarella to the filling.
instructions.4: Mix the butter, oil, sugar, salt, yogurt, and baking powder in a bowl to form the mixture.
instructions.5: Dip a phyllo sheet into the mixture and place it in the baking tray.
instructions.6: Repeat the previous step with the other sheets until the tray is fully covered.
instructions.7: Place the filling in the center of the sheets and fold the corners to close.
instructions.8: Place the fattoush in a pan over medium heat and cover.
instructions.9: Flip the fattoush after it turns golden on the bottom side.
instructions.10: Cook until the other side is fully done.

fah-746.title: Date Feta Pie
fah-746.culturalNotes: You can increase the sugar in the yogurt mixture to taste, but dates are usually sweet enough.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1 tablespoon of butter with the dates and sauté over medium heat for 3 minutes.
instructions.2: Carefully select phyllo sheets and grease the baking dish with butter and oil.
instructions.3: Place two phyllo sheets into the dish and brush them with butter and oil.
instructions.4: Add two more sheets and brush them in the same way.
instructions.5: Repeat the previous step until 4 sheets remain.
instructions.6: Place the filling (sautéed dates) in the center of the dish.
instructions.7: Add two more phyllo sheets and brush them with butter and oil.
instructions.8: Close the pie with the remaining sheets, making sure all edges are tightly sealed.
instructions.9: Brush the top of the pie with butter and oil.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat (about 200°C) until golden brown (approximately 10 minutes).
instructions.11: Mix 2 tablespoons of sugar with 1 cup of yogurt and pour the mixture over the pie.
instructions.12: Return the pie to the oven for an additional 10 minutes until the mixture is fully absorbed.
instructions.13: Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.

fah-747.title: Delicious Cheese Feteer
fah-747.culturalNotes: You can add different fillings such as pizza filling according to preference. This feteer is suitable for dinner or breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm milk, oil, and vinegar and mix all ingredients well.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and free of lumps.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: After rising, roll out the dough into a greased baking pan, about 0.5 cm thick.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into strips about 1.5 cm wide.
instructions.7: Take a plate, place it in the center of the dough, and cut the edges around it.
instructions.8: Spread cream cheese over the dough and cover it with the strips in a crisscross pattern.
instructions.9: Brush the edges with beaten egg mixed with milk, black pepper, sugar, and vinegar.
instructions.10: Bake the feteer in the oven on the lower rack for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: Cut the feteer and serve hot with a cup of tea.

fah-748.title: Phyllo Pie with Cheese and Pastirma
fah-748.culturalNotes: This pie can be served warm as breakfast, lunch, or dinner. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Lightly grease the baking dish with butter.
instructions.2: Layer the phyllo sheets in the dish, alternating directions—lengthwise and widthwise—brushing each sheet with butter.
instructions.3: Mix yogurt with black pepper, salt, and oil.
instructions.4: Dip the phyllo sheets into the mixture and arrange them in the center of the dish.
instructions.5: Place the filling (cheese, pepper, olives, pastirma) in the center of the sheets.
instructions.6: Dip additional phyllo sheets into the egg mixture and arrange them over the filling.
instructions.7: Complete the top layer with buttered phyllo sheets.
instructions.8: Fold the edges of the phyllo inward to shape the pie.
instructions.9: Brush the top surface with butter before baking.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20 minutes, until golden and crisp.

fah-749.title: Happiness Pie with Garlic and Basil
fah-749.culturalNotes: You can sprinkle some fresh basil on top of the pie before placing it in the oven for an extra aroma and flavor.

instructions.1: Mix sugar and yeast in warm water and let sit for 10 minutes until activated.
instructions.2: Add yogurt, baking powder, and salt to the previous mixture and stir well.
instructions.3: Gradually add flour while continuing to knead until you get a soft and elastic dough.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: In another bowl, mash the garlic with oil over low heat until golden.
instructions.6: Add oregano, parsley, butter, and salt to the mashed garlic and mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Prepare a baking pan, grease it with oil, and sprinkle with flour.
instructions.8: Roll out the dough in the pan and spread the garlic sauce evenly over the surface.
instructions.9: Sprinkle grated cheese over the sauce and distribute it evenly.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.11: Cut the pie into pieces and serve hot with a cup of tea or milk tea.

fah-750.title: Custard Fetair Without Oven
fah-750.culturalNotes: You can add nuts and fruits such as mousse, kiwi, and apple when serving. The fetair can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Prepare the fat mixture: Mix half a cup of melted butter, half a cup of yogurt, and one small spoon of baking powder.
instructions.2: Lay out a phyllo sheet and brush it with the mixture.
instructions.3: Place a second phyllo sheet on top and brush it with the mixture as well.
instructions.4: Place the custard filling in the center and fold the fetair into thirds.
instructions.5: Brush the fetair again with the mixture.
instructions.6: Heat a pan over medium heat and add one spoon of shortening or oil.
instructions.7: Fry the fetair until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.8: Serve the fetair warm with powdered sugar and warm milk or honey as desired.

fah-751.title: Fatteer Glaash in the Pan
fah-751.culturalNotes: You can use different types of cheese and fillings according to preference. The fatteer can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix 1/2 cup butter, 2 tablespoons oil, 3 tablespoons yogurt, and 1/2 teaspoon baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Grease a baking pan with butter.
instructions.3: Cut a glaash sheet in half and place one piece lengthwise and the other crosswise in the pan.
instructions.4: Brush each sheet with the prepared mixture.
instructions.5: Repeat the previous step until all glaash sheets are used.
instructions.6: Place the filling (cheese, pepper, tomato, bourekas, egg) in the center of the fatteer.
instructions.7: Cover the filling with another glaash sheet and brush it with butter.
instructions.8: Fold the excess edges from the pan to cover the filling.
instructions.9: Brush the top surface with butter.
instructions.10: Place the fatteer in the pan over medium heat for 4 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: Flip the fatteer and place it back in the pan, covering it for 2 minutes.
instructions.12: Add 1/2 cup milk and cover the fatteer for 2 minutes until it absorbs the milk.
instructions.13: Cut the fatteer and serve hot.

fah-752.title: Eastern Pie
fah-752.culturalNotes: You can add other spices such as chopped coriander or parsley for extra flavor. The pie can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Heat a pan and add 1 large spoon of butter.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until it changes color.
instructions.3: Add the ground meat and stir with the onion until the meat changes color.
instructions.4: Add salt, black pepper, and green pepper and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the yogurt can, 1 small spoon of baking powder, 1 small spoon of sugar, 1/4 cup of oil, and 1/2 cup of butter. Mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.6: Set the filling mixture aside.
instructions.7: Put 1 spoon of butter in the baking dish and spread it evenly on the bottom and sides.
instructions.8: Place 2 sheets of phyllo dough in the dish and brush them with the filling mixture.
instructions.9: Repeat the previous step until all phyllo sheets are used.
instructions.10: Place the cheese slice on top.
instructions.11: Fold the edges and brush them with the filling mixture.
instructions.12: Bake in the oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove the pie from the oven and drizzle with a little melted butter.
instructions.14: Return the pie to the oven for 10 more minutes until golden and the cheese is melted.
instructions.15: Remove from the oven and serve hot.

fah-753.title: Multiflavor Flatbread
fah-753.culturalNotes: Fried breads can be frozen and reheated as needed. Serve with mint tea for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Mix flour with sugar, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add yogurt and warm water, kneading until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Add olive oil and knead for an additional 10 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic.
instructions.4: Place the dough in an oiled bowl and let it rise until doubled in size.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to high heat.
instructions.6: Roll out the dough on a baking tray or sheet and distribute the different fillings across separate sections of the dough.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into squares and bake on the bottom rack for 5 minutes, then move to the top rack for an additional 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.8: Let the flatbreads cool slightly before serving.

fah-754.title: Olives Focaccia
fah-754.culturalNotes: You can serve focaccia with cheese and tea for a delicious breakfast. Focaccia can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water with sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of flour and 2 tablespoons of oil, then stir the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Cover the bowl and let it sit for 30 minutes until foam forms.
instructions.4: Gradually add 4 cups of flour and knead until the dough is smooth and well combined.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes to rise.
instructions.6: Roll out the dough on a surface lightly dampened with water and stretch it out.
instructions.7: Repeat this step 4 times, covering the dough and letting it rest for 30 minutes after each time.
instructions.8: Place olive slices on the dough and press them in.
instructions.9: Cover the dough and let it rest for another 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Place the dough in the refrigerator for 3 hours.
instructions.11: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
instructions.12: Lightly grease the baking tray with a tablespoon of oil and place the dough inside.
instructions.13: Brush the dough with 2 tablespoons of oil and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
instructions.14: Bake in the oven until golden brown.
instructions.15: Bake until golden brown on both the top and bottom.

fah-755.title: Chocolate Fiyunak
fah-755.culturalNotes: Fiyunak can be frozen after cooling and stored in a plastic bag. Serve with tea or milk for breakfast or as a snack.

instructions.1: Mix flour with powdered milk, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add yogurt and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add warm water until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Add oil and butter and knead for 10 minutes until the dough becomes firm and soft.
instructions.5: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour until risen.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small balls the size of a baladi egg or large lemon.
instructions.7: Dust flour on the work surface and roll each ball into the desired shape.
instructions.8: Place nutmeg on both sides of the dough and divide each ball into two halves.
instructions.9: Pinch the edges together and cut two slits in the center.
instructions.10: Cover the fiyunak with a towel and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Mix the egg with milk and instant coffee and brush the mixture over the top of the fiyunak.
instructions.12: Sprinkle sugar on top of the fiyunak.
instructions.13: Bake in a preheated oven at 220 degrees for 20 minutes until golden brown.

fah-756.title: Kourakish
fah-756.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is free of pebbles or sand before using. You can add a tablespoon of butter to the dough to make it softer. Serve kourakish with tea with milk and cheese for a perfect breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, toasted sesame seeds, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water, yogurt, sugar, and yeast, and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the melted ghee and oil, and knead the ingredients until the dough is soft and smooth.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
instructions.5: After the dough has risen, roll it out between two chilled rolling pins into a very thin layer.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into small squares.
instructions.7: Add the filling as a stuffing, and roll the dough into small rolls.
instructions.8: Cut the rolls into small pieces.
instructions.9: Place the kourakish on an oiled baking tray, and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15-20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.10: Let the kourakish cool slightly before serving.

fah-757.title: Sugar and Sesame Pastries
fah-757.culturalNotes: You can add nuts or raisins to the filling as desired. The pastries can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with sugar, yeast, salt, and baking powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the clotted cream, dried yogurt, butter, and oil, then knead thoroughly until the dough is smooth and no longer sticky.
instructions.3: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into small balls about the size of a lemon.
instructions.5: Fill each ball with the sugar and cinnamon mixture, then seal tightly.
instructions.6: Place the balls in a bowl coated with a mixture of sugar and toasted sesame seeds.
instructions.7: Arrange the pastries in a greased baking tray, and let them rest to rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve warm with tea or enjoy at breakfast or dinner.

fah-758.title: No-Knead Croissant
fah-758.culturalNotes: The croissant can be frozen for a long time and used as needed.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in the microwave.
instructions.2: Add the ricotta or yogurt and milk to the melted butter.
instructions.3: Add the baking powder, sugar, and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Soak two phyllo sheets in the mixture and coat them well.
instructions.5: Place a third phyllo sheet on top of the two coated sheets.
instructions.6: Put the filling (cream cheese or feta) in the center of the phyllo.
instructions.7: Cut the phyllo in half and roll each half to form a croissant.
instructions.8: Repeat the steps with the remaining sheets.
instructions.9: Arrange the croissants on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.10: Brush the tops of the croissants with a little butter.
instructions.11: Sprinkle with sesame seeds or nigella seeds as desired.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.13: Serve the croissants warm with your favorite drink.

fah-759.title: Quick Croissant Without Kneading
fah-759.culturalNotes: Make sure to generously grease each phyllo sheet with the mixture to ensure the croissants puff up properly. You can fill the croissants with sweet or savory fillings according to preference.

instructions.1: Mix the oil, cream or clotted cream, and soda water in a bowl.
instructions.2: Brush each phyllo sheet generously with the mixture.
instructions.3: Stack the brushed sheets on top of each other.
instructions.4: Cut the roll into small or large strips according to preference.
instructions.5: Fill each strip with your preferred filling (cottage cheese or Nutella).
instructions.6: Place the croissants in a greased baking pan or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.7: Brush the croissants with a mixture of half a cup oil and a quarter cup water.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.9: Bake for 30-40 minutes until golden and puffed.

fah-760.title: Eggless and Dairy-Free Crepe
fah-760.culturalNotes: You can store the crepes in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. You can also freeze them for up to one month. When serving, you can add various fillings according to your preference.

instructions.1: Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, sugar, and powdered milk in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add oil and water, then blend all ingredients thoroughly in a blender until smooth.
instructions.3: Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove lumps.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over medium heat. Add a small amount of oil and spread it evenly with a cloth.
instructions.5: Pour a ladle of batter into the pan and swirl it around in a circular motion to spread evenly.
instructions.6: Flip the crepe when the edges start to loosen from the pan.
instructions.7: Cook until lightly golden.
instructions.8: Remove the crepe from the pan and let it cool slightly.
instructions.9: Prepare your favorite filling (such as ketchup, mayonnaise, cheese, green pepper, or olives).
instructions.10: Place filling on half of the crepe and fold it over.
instructions.11: Reheat the crepe in the pan until crispy.
instructions.12: Serve the crepe warm.

fah-761.title: Vitello Tonnato Crepes
fah-761.culturalNotes: You can add a little melted chocolate or fresh fruit when serving.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the water while stirring continuously.
instructions.3: Add the egg and vanilla, and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the yogurt and mix until the batter is smooth.
instructions.5: Add the oil or butter and mix again.
instructions.6: Heat a pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.7: Pour a portion of the batter into the pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.8: Flip the crepe when the edges start turning golden.
instructions.9: Remove the crepe from the pan and repeat until all the batter is used.
instructions.10: Cut the crepes into thin strips.
instructions.11: Serve the vitello tonnato crepes with a little ice cream.

fah-762.title: Crispy Sugar-Coated Balls
fah-762.culturalNotes: Water can be used instead of milk if milk is unavailable. The balls can be shaped in different sizes according to preference, but the smaller the balls, the crispier they become.

fah-762-i9.name: Syrop or honey or powdered sugar or cinnamon

instructions.1: Mix flour, cornstarch, sugar, salt, baking powder, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add warm milk and knead until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into small pieces and shape them into small balls.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and add the balls.
instructions.6: Fry the balls continuously until they turn golden brown.
instructions.7: Cook until the outside is crispy and the inside is soft.
instructions.8: Drain the balls from oil and toss them in syrop or honey or powdered sugar or cinnamon as desired.

fah-763.title: Savory Olive and Cheese Cake
fah-763.culturalNotes: You can add an egg or labneh on top of the cake as desired. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Serve warm or cold, as preferred.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with vinegar and salt in a deep bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt or thick yogurt (labneh) and oil, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the flour and baking powder, and mix until a smooth batter forms.
instructions.4: Stir in half a cup of grated cheese.
instructions.5: Pour the batter into a 25x30 cm baking pan lined with parchment paper.
instructions.6: Sprinkle the olives, tomatoes, and oregano evenly over the top.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.8: Let the cake cool slightly before serving.

fah-764.title: Savory Egg Cake
fah-764.culturalNotes: Serve the cake with toast and pickled peppers or any other ingredients you prefer. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

fah-764-i6.name: 1/2 cup chopped green and black olives

fah-764-i7.name: 1/2 cup finely chopped colored bell peppers

instructions.1: Mix the eggs, milk, and butter together with salt, pepper, and paprika.
instructions.2: Gradually add the flour while continuing to mix until the batter is smooth.
instructions.3: Add the sausage, mixed cheese, bell peppers, olives, parsley, paprika, and chili peppers.
instructions.4: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.6: Grease the baking pan with butter and sprinkle with flour, or line it with parchment paper.
instructions.7: Pour the cake batter into the pan.
instructions.8: Place the pan in the middle rack of the oven.
instructions.9: Bake for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
instructions.10: Cut the cake and serve warm.

fah-765.title: Damietta Meshakib
fah-765.culturalNotes: Make sure the oil is hot and the heat is medium to ensure the meshakib fry well without turning dark. You can shape the meshakib larger or smaller according to your preference.

fah-765-i7.name: orange blossom water or rose water

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cornstarch, salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 1 tablespoon of orange blossom water or rose water.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm water and knead until you get a batter consistency similar to pancake batter.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes until risen.
instructions.5: In another bowl, mix the sugar, water, and lemon juice, and bring to a boil on the stove for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Add the white honey or glucose syrup and stir well, then let the syrup cool.
instructions.7: After the dough has risen, transfer it to a piping bag and cut a small hole at the tip.
instructions.8: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then begin shaping and frying the meshakib until golden brown.
instructions.9: Dip the fried meshakib into the cooled syrup.
instructions.10: Repeat until all the dough is used.

fah-766.title: Cookie in Bag and Machine
fah-766.culturalNotes: Keep the cookies in an airtight container away from moisture to keep them crisp and delicious. You can store the dough in the refrigerator if you're making a large batch.

instructions.1: Add the ghee to the mixer and beat until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the powdered sugar and beat the mixture for 4–5 minutes until smooth and creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
instructions.4: Add the orange vanilla, salt, and baking powder, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add the milk along with the ammonium bicarbonate and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the combined flour and cornstarch, and knead until the dough is smooth and even.
instructions.7: Wet your hands and shape the dough using the bag or machine.
instructions.8: Place the dough onto an oiled baking tray, leaving space between each piece.
instructions.9: Bake the cookies in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Let the cookies cool completely before serving.

fah-767.title: Quick Pan Manakeesh
fah-767.culturalNotes: You can use any filling you prefer, such as thyme and oil, various cheeses, or spiced minced meat with cheese. Manakeesh can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Mix flour, salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add oil, yogurt, and warm milk, then knead until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.3: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with an oiled plate and let it sit in a warm place for 30 minutes until risen.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls and roll each one out very thin using a rolling pin.
instructions.6: Heat the pan over medium heat and add 1 teaspoon of oil.
instructions.7: Place the dough in the pan and cook until golden brown on the bottom, then flip.
instructions.8: Add your preferred filling (thyme, cheese, spiced minced meat) and flip again until golden brown on the other side.
instructions.9: Serve manakeesh hot with tea or milk tea.

fah-768.title: Za'atar and Labneh Manakeesh
fah-768.culturalNotes: Serve the manakeesh warm with tea for the best flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, powdered milk, baking powder, salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the oil and warm water, mixing until the dough comes together smoothly.
instructions.3: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until puffed.
instructions.4: After the dough has risen, roll it out into a rectangle on a floured surface.
instructions.5: Spread the labneh over the dough and cut it into 2 cm thick slices.
instructions.6: Roll each slice into a spiral and place them in an oiled baking pan, leaving space between them.
instructions.7: Cover the rolls and let them rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Brush the rolls with a mixture of egg and milk, then bake in the oven for 15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.9: Remove the rolls from the oven and cover them for 5 minutes before serving.

fah-769.title: Cinnamon and sugar doughnuts
fah-769.culturalNotes: The doughnuts can be frozen in sealed bags or containers and used as needed.

instructions.1: Mix 1/2 cup oil, 1/2 cup ghee, 1/2 cup cream, 1/2 cup water, and 1/2 cup yogurt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 teaspoons yeast, 1 tablespoon vanilla, 1 tablespoon vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1 tablespoon baking powder. Mix well.
instructions.3: Add 5 cups sifted flour and knead until the dough is smooth and soft.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Prepare the filling by mixing 1 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon cinnamon, 1 teaspoon cocoa, 1 tablespoon butter, and nuts to taste.
instructions.6: Prepare the topping by mixing 1 cup toasted sesame, 2 tablespoons sugar, and 1 tablespoon ghee.
instructions.7: Shape the dough into equal-sized balls and fill them with the filling.
instructions.8: Dip the dough balls into the topping and arrange them in a baking tray.
instructions.9: Let the dough balls rise again for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Preheat the oven to high heat (maximum temperature) and bake for 15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: Serve warm with a cup of tea.

fah-770.title: Waffles and Pancakes
fah-770.culturalNotes: You can use homemade or store-bought caramel sauce. You can also add any other fruits as desired.

instructions.1: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add 1.5 cups of yogurt and beat the mixture with a mixer.
instructions.3: Add the egg, vanilla, and 1 tablespoon of melted butter or oil. Mix until smooth.
instructions.4: Let the dough rest.
instructions.5: In another bowl, mix powdered sugar and yogurt. Beat until smooth.
instructions.6: Gradually add 0.5 cup of oil and beat until well combined.
instructions.7: Whisk half of the chocolate syrup with 4 tablespoons of yogurt to make a light sauce.
instructions.8: Preheat the waffle maker and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.9: Pour the batter into the waffle maker and cook for 7 to 10 minutes until golden and cooked through.
instructions.10: If you don't have a waffle maker, you can use a greased skillet on medium heat.
instructions.11: Pour the batter to make pancakes.
instructions.12: Serve waffles and pancakes with chocolate syrup, strawberries, bananas, caramel sauce, and ice cream as desired.

fah-771.title: Very Crispy Date Flowers for Breakfast and Evening Snacks
fah-771.culturalNotes: Make sure the date paste is cold when filling to prevent melting. You can serve the flowers with different beverages such as tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with yeast, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the oil, milk, and warm water, and knead until the dough becomes soft and not sticky.
instructions.3: Let the dough rest for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into balls the size of an egg.
instructions.5: Roll each ball flat with a rolling pin and fill with date paste.
instructions.6: Divide the rolled dough into sections and cut with a knife to form the flower shape.
instructions.7: Lightly brush some oil on the baking tray and place the flowers on it.
instructions.8: Let the flowers rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Prepare the coating mixture using milk powder, coffee, sugar, and water, then brush it over the flowers.
instructions.10: Sprinkle sesame seeds on the flowers as desired.
instructions.11: Place the tray in a preheated oven at 220 degrees Celsius.
instructions.12: Bake the flowers for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve hot with tea, Nescafé, or cappuccino.

fah-772.title: Milk-Caramel Macchiato
fah-772.culturalNotes: Coffee grounds can be used instead of an espresso machine if unavailable. Brown sugar can also be used to make homemade caramel syrup.

instructions.1: Prepare espresso: Make 2 shots of espresso using an espresso machine, or mix 1 tablespoon of coffee grounds with half a cup of hot water as a substitute.
instructions.2: Prepare whipped cream: Add 1 tablespoon of whipped cream to the cup.
instructions.3: Add syrup: Pour 1 tablespoon of caramel syrup into the cup.
instructions.4: Mix ingredients: Stir the espresso, whipped cream, and caramel syrup together thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add ice: Add ice to taste into the cup.
instructions.6: Add milk: Pour in milk to taste.
instructions.7: Add cream: Top with cream for the final touch.
instructions.8: Serve: Serve the drink immediately, chilled.

fah-773.title: Cactus Pear Ice Cream
fah-773.culturalNotes: You can try adding small pieces of fresh cactus pear for a stronger flavor. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: Add 3 cups of cactus pear juice to a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 1 cup of heavy cream.
instructions.3: Add 1/2 cup of powdered sugar.
instructions.4: Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla.
instructions.5: Add 1 small drop of yellow food coloring.
instructions.6: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.7: Place the mixture in a container and cover it.
instructions.8: Put the container in the freezer for at least 4 hours.
instructions.9: After 4 hours, remove the container and make sure the consistency has become thick.

fah-774.title: Umm Ali Ice Cream
fah-774.culturalNotes: You can add other flavors like strawberry or vanilla to the basic ice cream mixture. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: In a bowl, beat the whipping cream well until thick.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk and beat the ingredients together until well combined.
instructions.3: Fry the Umm Ali in a pan over low heat with the semolina until golden brown.
instructions.4: Add the honey, raisins, and dried apricots and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Fold the toasted Umm Ali into the ice cream mixture and mix well.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a container and freeze for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: Before serving, dip the spoon in hot water to make it easier to scoop the ice cream.

fah-775.title: Fruit Ice Cream (Kiwi, Chocolate Banana, Strawberry)
fah-775.culturalNotes: You can use any type of fruit you prefer. You can also add other flavors like vanilla or almond as desired.

instructions.1: Peel the fruit and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the fruit in bags and freeze them.
instructions.3: Choose your favorite type of fruit (kiwi, chocolate banana, strawberry).
instructions.4: Blend the fruit with yogurt and cream chantilly in a blender.
instructions.5: Add honey if you want to increase sweetness.
instructions.6: Add cocoa if you want a chocolate flavor.
instructions.7: Blend the ingredients thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture into a container and freeze for 2 to 3 hours.
instructions.9: Stir the mixture once or twice during freezing to achieve a smooth texture.
instructions.10: Serve the ice cream immediately after freezing.

fah-776.title: Affordable Fruit Ice Cream
fah-776.culturalNotes: Various frozen fruits such as strawberries, mango, and bananas can be used. Alternatively, Middle Eastern sweet syrup can be used instead of honey if honey is unavailable.

instructions.1: Blend frozen fruit, Chantilly cream, yogurt, lemon juice, and sour milk in a blender.
instructions.2: Add honey to taste and blend for 5 minutes until ingredients are well combined.
instructions.3: Add food coloring if you wish to enhance the color.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into clean, dry containers and cover them.
instructions.5: Place containers in the freezer for at least 8 hours.
instructions.6: After freezing, serve the ice cream in cups and decorate as desired.

fah-777.title: Cantaloupe Ice Cream
fah-777.culturalNotes: You can use any fruit of your choice to make this ice cream. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Peel the cantaloupe and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the pieces in a bag and freeze until solid.
instructions.3: In a mixing bowl, add the frozen cantaloupe, yogurt, and white honey.
instructions.4: Add the dissolved pineapple gelatin pack and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.5: If desired, add a pinch of natural flavoring color and mix well to achieve an attractive color.
instructions.6: Cover the mixture and freeze for at least 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Before serving, mix the mixture again to achieve a smooth texture.
instructions.8: Serve the ice cream in small cups or bowls.

fah-778.title: Kunafa Ice Cream
fah-778.culturalNotes: You can use any type of frozen fruit instead of mango according to preference. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: Blend the frozen mango, liquid milk, and Chantilly cream in a blender until smooth.
instructions.2: Pour the mixture into a bowl and place in the freezer for 3 hours.
instructions.3: Remove the kunafa from the freezer and chop it into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add half a cup of ghee to the kunafa and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature and bake the kunafa until crispy.
instructions.6: Add two tablespoons of honey to the baked kunafa and stir well.
instructions.7: Remove the mango ice cream from the freezer and place the crispy kunafa on top.
instructions.8: Return the ice cream to the freezer for an additional two hours.
instructions.9: Serve the ice cream in cups and enjoy the delicious taste.

fah-779.title: Lotus Ice Cream
fah-779.culturalNotes: You can add other flavors such as strawberry or vanilla according to preference. For best results, make sure the cream and sweetened condensed milk are cold before mixing.

instructions.1: In a bowl, add the whipping cream and beat it well.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk and mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Add 4 tablespoons of raw shmytik cream and mix into the previous mixture.
instructions.4: Add 3 tablespoons of lotus cream and mix well.
instructions.5: Transfer the mixture into a container and sprinkle crushed lotus cookies on top.
instructions.6: Cover the container and freeze for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: Before serving, dip a spoon into hot water to make it easier to scoop the ice cream.

fah-780.title: Oreo Ice Cream
fah-780.culturalNotes: The ice cream can be served in regular cups or coated with melted chocolate to create a crunchy outer layer. Alternatively, a spoon can be used to eat the ice cream if you don't want to use sticks.

fah-780-i3.name: Dessert cream
fah-780-i3.standardAmount: one and a half cups (or a container of clotted cream with half a cup of milk)

instructions.1: Crush the six Oreo packs into small pieces.
instructions.2: Beat the cream in a bowl for two minutes.
instructions.3: Add the sweetened condensed milk and beat the mixture for another two minutes.
instructions.4: Fold in the crushed Oreo pieces and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into ice cream cups.
instructions.6: Place the cups in the freezer for at least 6 hours until the ice cream is fully frozen.
instructions.7: Serve the ice cream as is or coat it with melted chocolate.

fah-781.title: Ice Cream Without Eggs or Machine
fah-781.culturalNotes: You can add other ingredients such as packaged fruits or nuts according to preference. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for a long time.

instructions.1: Mix 1 cup of heavy cream with 2.5 cups of frozen milk in a bowl and beat for 5 minutes until the consistency becomes thick.
instructions.2: Add 1 can of whipping cream and beat for 1 minute.
instructions.3: Add 1 cup of sweetened condensed milk and beat for another minute until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.4: Divide the mixture into 4 airtight containers.
instructions.5: Add 3 tablespoons of caramel sauce to one container and stir well.
instructions.6: Add 1/2 teaspoon of liquid vanilla to another container and stir well.
instructions.7: Add 1 packet of Nescafé Fil Black to a third container and stir well.
instructions.8: Add 3 tablespoons of chocolate syrup and 1 tablespoon of raw cocoa powder to the last container and stir well.
instructions.9: Place the containers in the freezer for at least 8 hours.
instructions.10: After 8 hours, remove the containers from the freezer and serve the ice cream in cups or bowls.
instructions.11: You can decorate the ice cream with caramel sauce and nuts according to preference.

fah-782.title: Healthy and Economical Strawberry Ice Cream
fah-782.culturalNotes: You can add a little natural strawberry juice for a stronger flavor. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the chopped strawberries with sugar, milk, and whipping cream in a bowl.
instructions.2: Place the mixture in the freezer for one hour.
instructions.3: Remove from the freezer and transfer to a blender, then blend thoroughly.
instructions.4: Return the mixture to the freezer for another 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Remove again and blend once more.
instructions.6: Serve in small cups or bowls.

fah-783.title: Homemade Ice Cream with Three Flavors: Vanilla, Caramel, and Chocolate
fah-783.culturalNotes: You can use any type of crushed biscuit according to preference. You can also add other ingredients such as dried fruits or walnuts to enhance the flavor.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix the milk, sugar, and cornstarch thoroughly.
instructions.2: Place the mixture over medium heat and stir until it begins to boil and thickens.
instructions.3: Add the butter and continue stirring until it melts.
instructions.4: Remove from heat and let it cool slightly.
instructions.5: Add 3 packets of dried cream, 1 tablespoon of vanilla, and 1 cup of frozen milk. Mix thoroughly for 7 minutes.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture to a container and refrigerate for 2 hours until completely chilled.
instructions.7: After chilling, divide the mixture into three equal parts.
instructions.8: For vanilla flavor: Mix one portion thoroughly.
instructions.9: For caramel flavor: Add 3 tablespoons of caramel and 1/2 cup of crushed biscuit. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.10: For chocolate flavor: Add 2 tablespoons of cocoa, 2 tablespoons of chocolate chips, and 3 tablespoons of melted chocolate. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.11: Pour the flavors into trays and freeze for 4–6 hours until fully frozen.
instructions.12: Before serving, let the ice cream sit out to slightly soften for 10 minutes, then serve.

fah-784.title: Ice Cream Cake
fah-784.culturalNotes: You can use different types of ice cream according to preference. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Prepare the cake: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add eggs and vanilla, and mix ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Pour cake batter into a buttered and floured baking pan.
instructions.4: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.5: Remove cake from oven and let it cool.
instructions.6: Prepare vanilla ice cream: Mix vanilla ice cream with frozen milk in a bowl and beat for 7 minutes.
instructions.7: Prepare chocolate ice cream: Mix chocolate ice cream with frozen milk in a bowl and beat for 7 minutes.
instructions.8: Pour a light layer of syrup onto the cooled cake.
instructions.9: Place chocolate ice cream on the cake and spread evenly.
instructions.10: Place vanilla ice cream on top of the chocolate ice cream and spread evenly.
instructions.11: Gently shake the mold to smooth the ice cream.
instructions.12: Place the cake in the refrigerator for 5-6 hours until fully frozen.
instructions.13: Remove the cake from the refrigerator and decorate with ice cream balls and chocolate sauce.

fah-785.title: 3 Healthy and Delicious Drinks
fah-785.culturalNotes: Chocolate syrup can be used instead of caramel syrup in the Oreo milkshake. The amount of honey can be reduced or increased to taste in the spinach and strawberry drink. A personal blender can be used to serve the juice anywhere.

instructions.1: Prepare Oreo milkshake
instructions.2: Add ice to the blender jar
instructions.3: Add 1 cup of vanilla ice cream
instructions.4: Add 1 cup of milk
instructions.5: Add 2 packs of chocolate cookies
instructions.6: Blend ingredients for 30 seconds
instructions.7: Pour the drink into glasses
instructions.8: Add caramel syrup to taste
instructions.9: Prepare spinach and strawberry drink
instructions.10: Add 1 cup of spinach leaves
instructions.11: Add 1 cup of strawberries
instructions.12: Add 1 large piece of beetroot or 2 small pieces
instructions.13: Add 1 cup of orange juice
instructions.14: Add 2 tablespoons of white honey
instructions.15: Add 1 cup of water
instructions.16: Blend ingredients thoroughly
instructions.17: Pour the drink into glasses

fah-786.title: 4 Easy and Quick Winter Drinks
fah-786.culturalNotes: Store sahlab powder and hot chocolate mix in clean, dry, airtight containers. You can sprinkle nuts on top of sahlab for a crunchy texture.

instructions.1: Prepare hot cider: Mix apple juice, cinnamon sticks, star anise, and orange slices in a pot. Bring to a boil and simmer until flavors are well blended.
instructions.2: Prepare sahlab powder: In a large bowl, combine rice flour, powdered sugar, milk powder, finely ground nuts, cornstarch, toasted sesame seeds, raisins, and vanilla powder. Store the mixture in an airtight container.
instructions.3: Prepare sahlab: Mix 1 cup of milk with 1 tablespoon of sahlab powder at room temperature. Heat the mixture over medium heat and stir until it boils. Pour into cups and serve.
instructions.4: Prepare hot chocolate mix: In a bowl, combine powdered sugar, cocoa powder, milk powder, cornstarch, and chocolate chips. Store the mixture in an airtight container.
instructions.5: Prepare hot chocolate: Mix 1 cup of milk with 1 tablespoon of hot chocolate mix at room temperature. Heat over medium heat and stir until it boils. Pour into cups and serve with marshmallows.
instructions.6: Prepare custard: Mix 1 cup of milk with 1 tablespoon of custard powder, 1 teaspoon of sugar, and 2 cloves in a pot. Heat over medium heat and stir until it boils and thickens. Pour into cups and garnish with ginger powder.

fah-787.title: Iced Coffee
fah-787.culturalNotes: You can add a little caramel syrup for a stronger and sweeter taste.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix half a cup of instant coffee with a quarter cup of sugar and one tablespoon of vanilla ice cream powder.
instructions.2: Add two tablespoons of frozen water and beat the mixture well with an electric mixer until thick and frothy.
instructions.3: Add ice to two cups, then pour the frothy coffee over the ice.
instructions.4: Stir well and serve the iced coffee cold.

fah-788.title: Spanish Latte
fah-788.culturalNotes: You can add a little caramel sugar for a sweeter taste and richer flavor.

instructions.1: Dissolve the instant coffee in hot water.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk to the cup.
instructions.3: Add ice to taste.
instructions.4: Pour the dissolved coffee.
instructions.5: Complete the cup with cold liquid milk.
instructions.6: Stir the ingredients well.
instructions.7: Serve the drink cold, enjoy!

fah-789.title: Espresso and Foul White
fah-789.culturalNotes: Espresso and foul white can be served hot or cold according to preference. A little cinnamon or ground cocoa can be sprinkled on top for garnish.

instructions.1: Prepare espresso using an espresso machine.
instructions.2: Pour the espresso into the cup.
instructions.3: Steam the milk to create a foamy texture using the steam wand.
instructions.4: Pour the foamy milk over the espresso.
instructions.5: Add sugar to taste.

fah-790.title: Nubian Tea
fah-790.culturalNotes: You can adjust the sugar quantity to taste. You can also add some cucumber and olives when serving.

instructions.1: Add 1 cup of water and 1 cup of milk to a pot.
instructions.2: Add 2 tea packets and 1 teaspoon of sugar.
instructions.3: Let the mixture simmer on low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix 1/2 cup of flour with 1/4 cup of water, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of sugar.
instructions.5: Add the egg and 1 teaspoon of oil, and mix thoroughly until no lumps remain.
instructions.6: Heat a pan on the stove and add a small amount of oil, spreading it evenly.
instructions.7: Add a small amount of the flour mixture and stir in the pan until it forms a soft dough.
instructions.8: Fry the dough until lightly golden.
